Software Architect
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Software Architect within Axon Product Development to shape the architecture of our SaaS platform as we build new functionality and improve existing systems. If you enjoy making technical decisions, guiding engineers and working in an agile team, we’d like to meet you!

**Key about your role**


As a Software Architect within Axon Product Development, you shape the technical direction of our software and help teams translate complex business needs into sustainable solutions. You work closely with software engineers, product owners, business analysts, test engineers and fellow architects to ensure that architectural decisions support both our customers’ needs and the long\-term evolution of the Axon platform.


You take ownership of the architectural integrity of key areas of the product. You analyse complex challenges, identify dependencies and technical risks, and guide teams towards solutions that are scalable, secure, maintainable and fit for purpose. By combining insights from different disciplines and teams, you establish clear architectural direction while allowing teams sufficient autonomy in implementation.


You are a hands\-on architect who remains close to software development. You support teams with solution design, review critical implementations and help resolve complex technical challenges. You document important decisions and their trade\-offs, promote consistency across the platform and ensure that architectural principles are translated into practical engineering standards.


You balance short\-term delivery needs with the long\-term health of the product. This includes guiding modernisation initiatives, reducing technical debt and improving performance, reliability, testability, operability and developer experience. You communicate architectural choices clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders and help create alignment across Scrum teams and functional clusters.


We also embrace AI\-assisted software engineering as part of our development lifecycle. As a Software Architect, you explore how tools such as Claude, ChatGPT and Codex can support architecture and engineering activities—from analysing requirements and exploring solution options to understanding complex codebases, documenting decisions, identifying risks and supporting implementation and review.


AI is an aid, not a substitute for architectural or engineering judgement. You critically assess AI\-generated suggestions, validate their assumptions and implications, and remain accountable for the security, correctness, performance and maintainability of the resulting solutions. You also help teams adopt these tools responsibly and effectively.


As part of a large engineering community, you actively share knowledge, coach engineers and contribute to architectural practices across the organisation. You encourage experimentation, constructive technical debate and continuous improvement of our software, architecture and ways of working.


**Key About Your Team**

The Axon Product Development department consists of more than 120 colleagues, organised across 9 functional clusters, such as Claims, Contracts, Financials and Request, and 16 Scrum teams.


As architect you will be part of one of those clusters. In addition, as member of the Axon Architecture Community, you work closely with fellow architects and share responsibility for the overall architecture, technical coherence and sustainable evolution of the Axon product. Together, you establish architectural direction, align decisions across teams and continuously improve our architectural practices. You also collaborate with architects working on other Keylane products to align architectural principles, standards and strategic technology choices across the organisation.


Together, they extend Axon’s functionality and continuously improve the product, ensuring it evolves in line with the changing needs of insurance companies and continues to deliver lasting value to our customers and their policyholders.


In this environment, you collaborate across team and cluster boundaries. You help teams understand how their solutions fit into the wider platform and work with engineering and product stakeholders to maintain coherence while enabling continuous delivery.


Check out our blog posts and videos to see what it is like to work at Keylane.


**About Keylane Property \& Casualty**

As a leading European supplier of robust, highly configurable and customer\-centric SaaS platforms to the insurance industry, Keylane offers solutions that optimise today’s business processes, unburden our clients and empower them to become future\-fit and agile.


We provide and implement continuous upgrades, ensuring that our customers can comply with the latest rules and regulations. Combined with our commitment to backwards compatibility, this makes us a reliable long\-term partner, providing a platform that continues to deliver value as customer needs and technology evolve.  



  

  

**Requirements**  

* You are passionate about software architecture and engineering and enjoy turning complex business and technical challenges into clear, sustainable solutions.
* You have substantial software\-engineering experience and have contributed to the design and evolution of large, business\-critical systems.
* You have a strong understanding of software\-architecture principles, design patterns, modularity, integration patterns, APIs and data architecture. You stay up to date with technological developments and assess how they could benefit the organisation and its products.
* You combine strategic architectural thinking with a pragmatic, hands\-on approach and are comfortable working closely with engineering teams and source code.
* You can evaluate architectural decisions in terms of scalability, performance, security, reliability, maintainability, testability and operational impact. You identify architectural risks, dependencies and technical debt and translate them into practical recommendations and achievable improvement plans.
* You have experience with large technical ecosystems and technologies such as Java, IntelliJ, Git, Gradle, Angular and Docker, as well as relational databases and SQL, including DB2 and PostgreSQL.
* You communicate complex technical subjects clearly, create alignment across disciplines and document architectural decisions—including their context, alternatives and trade\-offs.
* You enjoy coaching engineers and providing architectural guidance within an Agile environment without unnecessarily limiting team autonomy.

**Using AI**

* You have used AI\-assisted development tools, such as Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, GitHub Copilot or Cursor, in your work or your own projects. You can explain how you have used them to explore solutions, understand unfamiliar code, develop or improve code and tests, troubleshoot issues, or support code reviews.
* You understand how AI\-assisted development fits into the broader software development lifecycle. You can guide coding assistants with clear requirements and context, including through reusable instructions, skills or agents where relevant.
* You critically review, test and debug AI\-generated code. You can identify incorrect assumptions, security vulnerabilities and maintainability issues, and you remain accountable for the logic, architecture, quality and security of what you deliver.
* Experience with CI/CD practices and integrating AI\-assisted development into those workflows is a plus.

* *A Certificate of Conduct (VOG) and reference check are part of the application process.*
* *Each employee within Keylane must follow training on information security and irrespective to the role basic information security responsibilities apply*

 **Benefits**  

* Starting with a monthly gross salary for a junior candidate between €5,200 and € 7,000 (medior) and between €4,300 and € 6,200 (senior) based on 40 hours per week;
* 8% holiday allowance of your total gross salary;
* A profit share;
* A pension scheme, with the option to save extra;
* Travel reimbursement: Receive a mileage allowance of €0\.23 per km or an NS Business Card, which can also be used for personal travel;
* 24 holiday days (with the option to buy extra) and 7 inclusion days, which can be exchanged with fixed Dutch national holidays, allowing you to take them when you like;
* Flexibility in working environment. As part of a hybrid working team, you will work partly from home and partly from the office. If you work in the office, a free lunch is waiting for you every day. If you work from home, you will receive a working from home allowance (€ 4 net per day) and internet allowance (€ 35 net per month);
* The possibility of working remotely from abroad for up to 2 months per year;
* The possibility to lease a bike through our bike leasing program;
* A one\-year contract that, subject to satisfactory performance, will be converted into a permanent contract;
* The opportunity to develop yourself at our Academy through courses and training, both professionally and personally;
* A comprehensive vitality offer to help you stay healthy. Read more here;
* An active and fun community of ‘Keylaners’. We also have after work drinks at our in\-house pub every Thursday.

jobs.title: Hardware Engineer
jobs.description:
### **HIGHLIGHTS VAN DEZE VACATURE**


✔ Werken aan hightech sorteer\- en verpakkingsmachines binnen de internationale machinebouw voor food. ✔ Ontwerpen van elektrotechnische hardware in EPLAN, dicht op assemblage en service. ✔ Profiteren van ontwikkelruimte met opleidingen, flexibele werktijden en thuiswerkmogelijkheid.
### **DIT GA JE DOEN**


Als Hardware Engineer werk je aan de elektrotechnische hardware van hightech sorteer\- en verpakkingsmachines voor groente en fruit binnen de machinebouw. Jij zorgt voor betrouwbare besturingstechniek en overzichtelijke elektrotechnische schema’s, zodat machines in de praktijk doen wat er op papier staat. Je ontwerpt, ontwikkelt en beheert de hardware in een professionele omgeving met paneelbouw, assemblage, service en R\&D onder één dak. Je werkt nauw samen met collega\-engineers en monteurs en vertaalt verkooporders naar concrete oplossingen in elektrotechniek en industriële automatisering. Aan het einde van de dag zie je je eigen schakelkasten en kabelbomen letterlijk in de productiehal staan, wat testen met echte machines net iets leuker maakt dan alleen simuleren. In deze rol pak je de volgende kerntaken op:  

* Opstellen en uitwerken van elektrotechnische schema’s in EPLAN voor paneelbouw en schakelkasten, zowel voor interne als externe toepassingen.
* Doorvoeren van revisies in elektraschema’s en stuklijsten op basis van feedback vanuit Assemblage, Installatie en Service.
* Vertalen van verkooporders naar besturingstechnische oplossingen die aansluiten op de functionele eisen en performance van de sorteer\- en verpakkingslijnen.
* Ontwikkelen, beheren en standaardiseren van elektrotechnische tekeningen en stuklijsten in het PDM\-systeem ePDM voor hergebruik en kwaliteit.
* Bepalen van benodigde materialen voor verkoop\- en voorraadorders, inclusief technische documentatie en werkinstructies voor Paneelbouw, Assemblage en leveranciers.


Daarnaast ondersteun je Service en Installatie bij technische vraagstukken, lever je technische specificaties aan Inkoop en R\&D en onderhoud je contact met leveranciers over voortgang en kwaliteit van uitbestede werkzaamheden. Soms voorkom je met één goed schema een hele middag discussie aan de machinelijn.
### **DIT BRENG JE MEE**


Je werkt gestructureerd, denkt in oplossingen en neemt eigenaarschap over je ontwerpen. Je schakelt makkelijk met collega’s van paneelbouw, assemblage, service en verkoop en blijft ook onder tijdsdruk nauwkeurig in je schema’s en stuklijsten.  

* Een mbo\- of hbo\-diploma in Elektrotechniek of een vergelijkbare technische richting.
* Minimaal 3 jaar werkervaring als Hardware Engineer, bij voorkeur in de machinebouw.
* Ervaring met EPLAN of een vergelijkbaar elektrisch ontwerppakket voor elektrotechnische schema’s.


### **HIER KUN JE OP REKENEN**


Voor een 40\-urige werkweek als Hardware Engineer kun je rekenen op de volgende arbeidsvoorwaarden:  

* € 3\.500,00 tot € 5\.500,00 bruto per maand.
* 40 vakantiedagen per jaar.
* Reiskostenvergoeding volgens staffel: vanaf 10 km enkele reis ontvang je een vaste maandelijkse vergoeding, oplopend van € 90 tot maximaal € 363 per maand, afhankelijk van de afstand.
* Uitstekende onkostenvergoedingen voor werkgerelateerde kosten en gebruik van middelen.
* Winstdelingsregeling van ongeveer 6% per jaar.
* 8% vakantiegeld.
* Werkgeversbijdrage van 2/3de aan het pensioen.


Daarnaast zijn er flexibele werktijden, mogelijkheden om deels thuis te werken, veel ruimte voor extra trainingen en opleidingen en een jaarcontract dat bij goed functioneren wordt omgezet in een vast contract. Reageer direct als deze rol als Hardware Engineer inhoudelijk past bij jouw ervaring en wensen. Je krijgt altijd binnen 1 werkdag een reactie. Bel of mail met Henri van de Glind via 06 \- 53 93 64 37\.
### **HIER GA JE WERKEN**


Je komt terecht bij een machinebouwer die wereldwijd sorteer\- en verpakkingssystemen voor groente en fruit ontwikkelt en bouwt. De organisatie telt ongeveer 300 medewerkers, met meerdere vestigingen internationaal, en investeert continu in R\&D, vision\-technieken en hardware\-innovaties om de marktpositie te versterken.
  

  

In Pijnacker werk je met circa 60 collega’s in een modern pand met eigen productiehal, waar engineering en assemblage fysiek dicht bij elkaar zitten. Je schakelt direct met andere hardware\- en software\-engineers, paneelbouw, assemblage, Service en Installatie, in een praktijkgerichte cultuur waarin kennisdeling belangrijk is en leidinggevenden goed benaderbaar zijn. Het is de plek waar je ontwerp niet in een la verdwijnt, maar letterlijk een paar deuren verder wordt opgebouwd en getest.

jobs.title: Software Engineer (Java/C#)
jobs.description:
**Introduction to the job**
---------------------------

Are you energized by solving complex engineering challenges in a multidisciplinary team? Do you enjoy applying modern software engineering practices to create solutions that make a difference for customers?


Would you like to contribute to advanced metrology systems and help improve equipment throughput, automation, and integration with customer manufacturing environments?

  

  

If so, we have an exciting opportunity for you as a **Software Engineer** .

  

  

**Role and responsibilities**

As a Software Engineer, you will develop software for complex machine and algorithm\-based solutions. You will take end\-to\-end ownership of software development in **Java and/or C\#** , directly contributing to the evolution of metrology solutions.

  

  

You will join a team that develops automated data\-analysis workflows to improve the performance of advanced metrology systems. Your work will focus on implementing sophisticated machine and algorithm functionality.


You will work closely with software engineers and multidisciplinary stakeholders to deliver high\-quality, production\-ready functionality. You will also collaborate with Customer Support and Manufacturing teams to ensure smooth integration and practical usability.

  

  

Your responsibilities will cover the full software development lifecycle, including:


* Refining requirements and user stories
* Designing software solutions and evaluating technical trade\-offs
* Planning and estimating development work
* Defining and executing test strategies
* Developing and maintaining software
* Supporting CI/CD pipelines
* Troubleshooting technical issues
* Preparing software releases
* Communicating progress and technical decisions
  

  

You will demonstrate strong Java and/or C\# engineering practices and contribute to team discussions and design decisions.

  

  

**Main responsibilities**

* Take end\-to\-end ownership of feature and story\-based software development, from refinement through delivery.
* Align specifications with relevant stakeholders to establish shared understanding and technical consistency.
* Safeguard software and product quality through robust engineering practices and peer reviews.
* Deliver high\-quality software through disciplined design, thorough testing, and clear, maintainable documentation.
* Share technical knowledge with colleagues and customer\-facing teams to support successful integration and operation.
  

  

**Education and experience**

* A master’s degree in computer science, computer engineering, software engineering, informatics, or a related technical field.
* At least five years of professional experience developing technical, object\-oriented software solutions using Java and/or C\#.
* Experience working in a high\-tech, algorithm\-driven, or complex systems environment is preferred.
* Strong knowledge of software design patterns and the ability to create robust, scalable, and maintainable software.
* Practical experience with Test\-Driven Development and automated testing.
* Strong mathematical and analytical skills, with the ability to translate advanced algorithms into production\-ready software.
* Experience with image processing or numerical algorithms is preferred.
* Experience with Python or React is an advantage.
* Willingness to work with different technologies, including Java, C\#, Python, and React, depending on project needs.
* Experience with large\-scale data processing, data\-storage design, or query\-performance optimization is an advantage.
  

  

**Skills**

To thrive in this role, you:


* Work effectively as part of a collaborative and multidisciplinary team.
* Are comfortable in a dynamic, high\-tech product\-development environment.
* Combine strong analytical thinking with a pragmatic and flexible approach to problem\-solving.
* Take ownership and remain accountable for results.
* Focus on business and customer value and prioritize work effectively.
* Are curious, learn quickly, and apply new knowledge effectively.
* Communicate clearly and confidently in written and spoken English.
  

  

**Other information**

ASML is a leading provider of lithography systems for the semiconductor industry, enabling the production of integrated circuits and microchips. Our software engineers play an important role in optimizing semiconductor manufacturing processes and improving quality and efficiency.


In this role, you will contribute to the development of advanced metrology solutions that help customers improve process control, accelerate production ramp\-up, and optimize output.

  

*This position requires access to controlled technology, as defined in the* *United States* *Export Administration Regulations (15 C.F.R. § 730, et seq.). Qualified candidates must be legally authorized to access such controlled technology prior to beginning work. Business demands may require ASML to proceed with candidates who are immediately eligible to access controlled technology.*

**Inclusion and diversity**
---------------------------

ASML is an Equal Opportunity Employer that values and respects the importance of a diverse and inclusive workforce. It is the policy of the company to recruit, hire, train and promote persons in all job titles without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, or gender identity. We recognize that inclusion and diversity is a driving force in the success of our company.


Need to know more about applying for a job at ASML? Read our frequently asked questions .

jobs.title: Software Engineer Crypto Services
jobs.description:
Software Engineer Crypto Services**At a glance**
---------------


Are you a **Software Engineer** with a passion for security, cloud\-native technologies, and solving complex technical challenges? Join our **Crypto Services** team and help build and maintain the critical platforms that safeguard our customers, enable secure banking, and protect the bank's digital infrastructure. Whether you're already experienced in cryptography or eager to grow into the field, you'll have the opportunity to work with modern technologies while making a real impact.

**Your job**
------------


As a Software Engineer, you will be part of an agile DevOps team responsible for designing, developing, testing, deploying, and maintaining secure, resilient, and high\-performing solutions. You will contribute throughout the entire software development lifecycle, from requirements analysis and solution design to implementation and operational support.

  

You take ownership of your work, actively contribute ideas, share knowledge with your teammates, and continuously improve both the software and the way of working. Together with your colleagues, you will build high\-quality, maintainable, and future\-proof solutions using modern technologies and platforms, including Microsoft Azure.

  

You will primarily develop secure backend services and APIs supporting key management, certificate lifecycle management, and Hardware Security Module (HSM) integrations. Working closely with security specialists, platform engineers, and product owners, you will help deliver critical security services that are used throughout the bank.

**Working environment**
-----------------------


At ABN AMRO, we believe in creating an open and supportive environment where you can learn, experiment, make mistakes, and celebrate successes. We value feedback, collaboration, and continuous improvement, and we are committed to your professional and personal growth. As part of Platforms \& Technology, the foundation of ABN AMRO's digital landscape, you'll work on meaningful challenges that help shape the future of secure banking. We encourage you to take ownership, seize opportunities, and make an impact.

 **About IT Platforms \& Technology.** Within ABN AMRO, IT Platforms \& Technology (P\&T) provides the foundational platforms and services that enable the bank to operate securely, reliably, and efficiently. This includes our cloud platforms, network infrastructure, data centers, developer platforms, and the tools that support the entire software development lifecycle.

 **About Service Integration \& Orchestration.** The Service Integration \& Orchestration (SI\&O) department plays a key role in ensuring the stability, security, and continuous availability of the bank's IT landscape. Alongside governance and operational responsibilities, SI\&O is home to several DevOps teams that build and operate critical services used across the organization.

 **About Crypto Services.** The Crypto Services team develops and operates the platforms that enable secure banking across ABN AMRO. Our services include key management, certificate lifecycle management, and Hardware Security Module (HSM) solutions that support critical applications and infrastructure throughout the bank.


As part of the Crypto Services team, you will contribute to the platforms that form the foundation of secure banking. From key management and certificate lifecycle management to Hardware Security Modules (HSMs), the services you build and maintain are essential for protecting customers, securing critical business processes, and enabling the bank to operate safely and reliably every day.

**Your profile**
----------------


We're looking for a Software Engineer who enjoys building secure, reliable, and maintainable solutions and is eager to grow within the cryptographic domain.

 **What you'll bring**

* Hands\-on experience writing clean, maintainable, and efficient code in Java, C\#, or comparable programming languages, with a strong focus on engineering best practices and code quality.
* Hands\-on experience with Python, particularly in developing, securing, and optimizing APIs.
* Experience designing and implementing RESTful APIs, with a focus on clean architecture and maintainable codebases.
* Ability to analyze, optimize, and improve API performance in distributed systems.
* Curiosity and willingness to learn and grow within the cryptographic domain.

 **Don't tick every box?**

Previous experience in cryptography is not required. We are looking for a software engineer with a solid technical foundation, a security\-minded mindset, and the motivation to learn and grow within the cryptographic domain. **If you're excited about the role but don't meet every qualification, we'd still love to hear from you.**

**We are offering**
-------------------


We believe it is important to be a good employer. Joining us means stepping into a role with impact, supported by excellent employment conditions that foster your job satisfaction, development, and wellbeing.


In addition, we offer:

* An attractive gross monthly salary in Hay 9 based on a 36\-hour work week, including holiday allowance and a flexible benefit budget.
* An excellent pension scheme, ensuring that you are well prepared for the future.
* Flexibility in working: working from home is possible in consultation with your team and depending on your role. We will provide an ergonomic home office setup for you.
* Plenty of room for relaxation with five weeks of vacation per year, supplemented by two mandatory days off. You can also purchase up to four additional weeks of vacation annually.
* Five “Banking for better days”: extra days off that you can use for personal development or volunteer work.
* Personal development is key: you receive a development budget of €1,000 per year, which can accumulate up to €3,000\.
* An annual public transport pass with free public transportation throughout the Netherlands for both business and private use.


You can find more information about our employment conditions and salary scales in our Collective Labour Agreement (CLA), which applies to this vacancy.

**Interested?**
---------------


If you believe this role matches your experience and ambitions, we'd love to hear from you. Please apply online. If you'd like to learn more about the team or the role, feel free to contact Patrick Haak (patrick.haak@nl.abnamro.com)

**Your Future: Inclusive, Innovative, Sustainable**
---------------------------------------------------


At ABN AMRO, we believe in "**Banking for better, for generations to come.**" Equal opportunities for everyone are a crucial foundation, as we strive for an inclusive culture where all employees feel seen, heard, and valued. Our vision of **being a personal bank in the digital age** aligns perfectly with the demand for surprising insights and innovative solutions, born from a diverse interplay of cultures and experiences. We focus on customer experience, sustainability, and building a future\-proof bank, conducting annual reviews to ensure equal pay for equal work. Join a bank that embraces ingenuity and ambition, and make an impact with us for a better future.

 *If you want to apply for the B\-Able or Reboot program, make sure to mention it both in the title and the content of your resume.*

**Disclaimer external recruitment agencies**
--------------------------------------------


External recruitment agencies need to have a signed agreement with ABN AMRO BANK N.V., executed by a Talent Acquisition Specialist, when submitting a resume to a vacancy. In addition, a recruitment agency can only submit a resume when invited by a Talent Acquisition Specialist to join the search for a right candidate. All unsolicited resumes sent to us will be considered property of ABN AMRO BANK N.V. In this case, ABN AMRO will not be held liable to pay a placement fee.

jobs.title: Senior Back-end Developer
jobs.description:
*Over een paar jaar draait ons platform in gebouwen door heel Europa. Hoe de back\-end daaronder in elkaar zit, bepaal jij.*

*Je komt als senior binnen bij de marktleider in AI\-SaaS voor commercieel vastgoed, precies nu we uitrollen naar België, Luxemburg en Duitsland. Jouw architectuurkeuzes verdwijnen niet in een comité: ze worden de basis waar het hele team op bouwt.*

**Over Healthy Workers**


Healthy Workers is AI\-SaaS\-marktleider binnen gebouwoptimalisatie voor commercieel vastgoed. Eigenaren van commercieel vastgoed staan onder flinke druk om hun gebouwen te verduurzamen. Ons platform helpt ze daarbij: we verbinden de installaties en data van een gebouw en laten het slimmer draaien, met minder energieverbruik en meer comfort tot gevolg. We zitten direct aan tafel met die eigenaren. Na Nederland rollen we nu uit in België, Luxemburg en Duitsland, en daarna volgt de rest van Europa.


We zijn een scale\-up: informeel, korte lijnen, en direct contact met onze founders Jonatan en Guus.

**Wat ga je doen?**


Je komt in team Product als senior back\-end developer. Je bouwt zelf mee, en je zorgt dat het team en het platform de volgende groeistap aankunnen als het gaat om de back\-end.


* Je bepaalt de architectuur van de back\-end en legt besluiten vast, zodat niemand over een jaar hoeft te raden waarom iets zo gebouwd is
* Je maakt het platform klaar voor Europa: schaalbaar, snel en betrouwbaar, van API tot infrastructuur
* Je bouwt mee aan AI\-features die gebouwinstallaties slimmer aansturen
* Samen met ons Data\-team en SkySpark (ons platform voor gebouwanalyse) maak je Healthy Workers dé plek voor alle gebouw\- en klantdata
* Je houdt de productie gezond en de bug\-backlog onder controle
* Je coacht collega's, reviewt code binnen één werkdag en zorgt dat geen enkele service aan één persoon hangt


Zo ziet je week er ongeveer uit:


\~60% bouwen: API's, datamodellen, integraties en AI\-features


\~20% maintenance, devops en infra: bugs, monitoring, CI/CD en schaalbaarheid


\~10% code reviews en security (pentests en ISO)


\~10% stand\-ups, refinement, sprintplanning en retro

**Onze stack**


Kotlin, Micronaut, MySQL, BigQuery, Docker, Kubernetes, GitLab CI, Terraform, Google Cloud Platform en SkySpark. We plannen in Linear.

**Kom je uit Java?** Perfect! Kotlin voelt al snel vertrouwd, en met jouw JVM\-ervaring zit je er binnen een paar weken in.

**Wat neem je mee?**


Must\-haves:

* Ruime ervaring als back\-end developer met Java of Kotlin
* Je hebt API's en datamodellen ontworpen voor systemen die groeien, en je hebt architectuurkeuzes gemaakt waar je daarna zelf mee verder moest
* Je bent gewend eigenaar te zijn van productie: debuggen, monitoren en incidenten oplossen
* Je werkt vanzelfsprekend met Docker, Kubernetes en CI/CD
* Je maakt anderen beter met constructieve reviews, kennis delen en goede documentatie
* Je spreekt vloeiend Engels en woont in Nederland

**Mooi meegenomen:**

* Ervaring met Terraform, GitLab CI of Google Cloud Platform
* Kennis van C\#
* Ervaring met security en certificering, zoals ISO
* Affiniteit met gebouw\-, energie\- of sensordata

**Wat krijg je terug?**

* Een salaris dat past bij je ervaring. Dat bespreken we open in het eerste gesprek
* Een SAR\-regeling, zodat je meedeelt in de groei van Healthy Workers
* 30 vakantiedagen
* Een opleidings\- en conferentiebudget
* Reiskostenvergoeding voor woon\-werkverkeer
* Geen piketdienst
* Echt mandaat: je spart direct met onze Founders Jonatan en Guus over waar de back\-end naartoe gaat

**Het proces**


Van eerste gesprek tot beslissing duurt het maximaal 2 weken. Na elk gesprek hoor je de volgende dag van ons, zonder weken stilte.

**Klinkt dit als jouw volgende stap?**


Solliciteer via onderstaande button of stuur me een berichtje. Je cv of gewoon je LinkedIn\-profiel is genoeg, een motivatiebrief is niet nodig. Wil je eerst sparren of dit iets voor je is? Neem gerust contact op, dan hebben we het erover: Maarten Wolters maarten@healthyworkers.com of \+31 6 13392042\.

jobs.title: Junior PLC Control Engineer
jobs.description:
**What do we offer**
--------------------

* A pleasant and dynamic working environment within a collaborative and ambitious team, offering a high degree of autonomy;
* A competitive salary ranging from €3\.900 to €5\.000 gross per month, depending on your experience;
* A challenging and innovative work environment where you can develop yourself and make a directly visible impact: your software controls physical systems used around the world;
* An attractive benefits package in accordance with the Dutch Collective Labour Agreement for the Metalektro industry (CAO Metalektro), including 27 vacation days and 13 additional leave (ADV) days.

**What do we expect**
---------------------

* A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Industrial Automation, Control Engineering, or a related field;
* Experience in industrial automation and/or machine building, preferably in a logistics or intralogistics environment, with knowledge of PLC programming and industrial control systems (including Siemens and Allen Bradley);
* Affinity with C\#, Python or similar programming languages and a willingness to further develop in other programming languages. Interest in working on diverse projects and the ability to switch flexibly between different technical challenges;
* Ambition to broaden your field of expertise, for example towards Robot and AI vision alongside PLC programming;
* Affinity with complex logistics processes and automated systems;
* Willingness to travel, both nationally and internationally.

**About this vacancy**
----------------------


As a Junior PLC Control Engineer, you will develop, implement and test software for customer\-specific intralogistics solutions. You will work on control software for, among other things, conveyors, shuttles, sorting systems, and robotic applications, all of which together ensure an optimally functioning logistics process.


You will be part of multidisciplinary project teams and work closely with colleagues from other disciplines, such as Robot Programmers. In addition to software development, you will have an important coordinating and advisory role within projects.

**About the team**  

Within our Business Unit Intralogistics, we are working to take automation in warehouses and distribution centers to the next level. In a market where speed, efficiency, and flexibility are becoming increasingly important, we use automated robots and vision technology to make logistics processes more efficient, faster, and smarter. As a Junior PLC Control Engineer, you play a key role in this.

**Application process**
-----------------------

* Your application  

Great that you’ve applied! We’ll review your application carefully and get back to you within a week.
* First interview

jobs.title: Senior Test Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
**Bedrijfsomschrijving**  

Een duurzame, winstgevende en aangename toekomst voor een melkveehouder door robotisering, engineering en boerenkennis te combineren, daar geloven we in.


Dat begon ruim 75 jaar geleden met een droom van twee broers in Maassluis. Sindsdien zijn we innovatieve koploper in geautomatiseerde systemen voor melkveehouders over de hele wereld. Met meer dan 2\.800 gespecialiseerde professionals werken we continu aan nieuwe agrarische innovaties. Dat doen we vanuit onze Campus in Maassluis, het gebouw met de hoogst haalbare duurzaamheidsprestaties van Nederland, maar ook wereldwijd. Met als doel melkveehouden voor een volgende generatie (ook) interessant te maken.

 **Vacatureomschrijving**  

Bij Lely speelt software een cruciale rol in de prestaties, betrouwbaarheid en veiligheid van onze robotica en farm management oplossingen. Iedere dag helpen onze producten melkveehouders over de hele wereld om efficiënter te werken, het dierenwelzijn te verbeteren en bij te dragen aan duurzame voedselproductie.


Als **Senior Test Automation Engineer** geef je mede vorm aan de quality engineering en testautomatiseringsstrategie voor Horizon, het farm management platform van Lely. Je geeft technische richting, stimuleert verbeteringen over meerdere teams heen en helpt onze manier van testen verder te professionaliseren. Je rol gaat verder dan het bouwen en onderhouden van geautomatiseerde tests. Je creëert de technische en organisatorische voorwaarden waarmee teams met vertrouwen software van hoge kwaliteit kunnen leveren.


Je neemt eigenaarschap over strategische kwaliteitsinitiatieven, signaleert mogelijkheden voor verbetering en helpt teams om onderbouwde beslissingen te nemen op basis van objectieve kwaliteitsdata. Je speelt een leidende rol in het verder ontwikkelen van onze testautomatisering op verschillende testniveaus, waaronder componenttests, API tests en end to end tests.


Daarbij werk je onder andere aan het verder ontwikkelen van onze mogelijkheden voor componenttesten en aan het ontwerpen, implementeren en onderhouden van de onderliggende testinfrastructuur. Denk hierbij aan CI/CD testpipelines, testomgevingen en CI/CD runners. Je zorgt voor continue verbetering van het testplatform, zodat teams gedurende de volledige software delivery lifecycle snel en betrouwbaar feedback krijgen en met vertrouwen software van hoge kwaliteit kunnen opleveren.


Als senior lid van het Test Automation Chapter help je standaarden te bepalen, deel je best practices, coach je collega engineers en draag je bij aan de langetermijnrichting van testautomatisering binnen Digital Farming. Veel verbeteringen gaan verder dan één developmentteam. Daarom zorg je voor afstemming en werk je nauw samen met stakeholders en engineeringteams in Nederland, Turkije en Portugal.


Naast deze verantwoordelijkheden binnen het chapter maak je ook deel uit van een Scrumteam. Binnen dit team werk je zelf actief mee aan het ontwerpen, implementeren en onderhouden van geautomatiseerde tests en kwaliteitsprocessen binnen Horizon.


Je werkt voornamelijk vanaf onze campus in Maassluis. Incidenteel reis je naar Turkije om de samenwerking tussen teams te ondersteunen en ervoor te zorgen dat verbeteringen succesvol worden geïmplementeerd.


Jouw belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden

* Bepalen en verder ontwikkelen van de testautomatiseringsstrategie voor componenttests, API tests en end to end tests.
* Leiden van kwaliteitsverbeteringen en zorgen dat deze binnen meerdere teams worden toegepast.
* Geven van technische richting en coaching aan collega test automation engineers binnen het Test Automation Chapter.
* Eigenaarschap nemen over het domein componenttesten, waaronder het bepalen van de aanpak, uitbreiden van de testdekking en integreren van componenttests in de CI/CD pipeline.
* Stimuleren van samenwerking tussen testing, software development, architectuur en andere technische disciplines in Nederland en Turkije.
* Bieden van objectieve inzichten in productkwaliteit, risico’s en de mate waarin een release klaar is voor uitrol.


Hands on verantwoordelijkheden

* Ontwerpen, implementeren en onderhouden van geautomatiseerde end to end en API tests met TypeScript en Playwright.
* Ontwerpen, implementeren en onderhouden van componenttests met C\# en Testcontainers.
* Ondersteunen van de migratie van Cucumber naar Playwright.
* Beheren en verbeteren van CI/CD testpipelines in GitLab.
* Eigenaarschap nemen over de geautomatiseerde quality gates die bepalen of software gereed is om te mergen.
* Beheren van het Windows VM testlab en de bijbehorende infrastructuur.
* Onderhouden van dashboards, reporting pipelines en kwaliteitsmetrics.
* Onderhouden van ondersteunende tooling en scripts voor testuitvoering en infrastructuurautomatisering binnen PowerShell, Python, Azure, Windows en Kubernetes omgevingen.

  

**Functie\-eisen**  

Je bent een mensgerichte senior engineer met een sterke technische basis en een passie voor productkwaliteit. Je haalt energie uit het helpen groeien van andere engineers, het verbinden van teams en het creëren van duidelijkheid binnen complexe ontwikkelomgevingen.


Daarnaast breng je het volgende mee:

* Een bachelor of masteropleiding in Software Engineering of een andere relevante technische richting, of een vergelijkbaar werk en denkniveau.
* Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring met testautomatisering, verificatie of quality engineering binnen een technische productontwikkelomgeving.
* Ervaring met het begeleiden, coachen of mentoren van engineers binnen technische initiatieven.
* Een brede technische interesse en affiniteit met multidisciplinaire systemen, software en robotica.
* Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en stakeholdermanagement, waarbij je in staat bent om verschillende teams en disciplines op één lijn te brengen.
* Goede beheersing van de Engelse taal.

  

**Aanvullende informatie**  

Werken bij Lely betekent bijdragen aan duurzame vooruitgang binnen een van de meest innovatieve organisaties van Nederland. Jij draagt bij aan het toekomstbestendig maken van de agrarische sector – en wij zorgen dat jij daar alle ruimte, middelen en ondersteuning voor krijgt.

* Een internationale werkomgeving waar samenwerking, initiatief en diverse perspectieven worden gewaardeerd
* Een cultuur die leren, experimenteren en eigenaarschap van ideeën stimuleert
* Uitstekende arbeidsvoorwaarden, waaronder tot 8 weken vakantie per jaar en een goede pensioenregeling.
* Een salaris binnen de schaal van € 6\.000 \- € 8\.000 bruto per maand, waarin we graag zien dat er vanaf je startsalaris nog groeiruimte is richting de toekomst
* Regie over je eigen ontwikkeling, met toegang tot een breed aanbod aan cursussen via de Lely Academy
* Dagelijkse toegang tot uitstekende sportfaciliteiten op de Lely Campus: een indoor gym, outdoor padelbanen, basketbal\- en volleybalvelden, tafeltennis en tafelvoetbal. Je kunt deelnemen aan Hyrox\-workouts of je inschrijven voor personal training en je collega’s uitdagen tijdens een actieve pauze.
* Verse koffie en thee van onze eigen barista (met melk van onze eigen boerderij) en een gezond, betaalbaar bedrijfsrestaurant


Werk\-privébalans

* Een gezonde werk\-privébalans dankzij ons hybride werkbeleid: je werkt minimaal drie dagen per week op de Campus, met flexibele werktijden en veel ruimte om extra tijd op locatie door te brengen (tussen 06:00 en 20:00 uur).
* Een gratis shuttlebus brengt je van en naar de metro in Maassluis, zodat je werkdag soepel begint en eindigt.
* En bovendien: we vieren graag! Of het nu een jubileum is of het kerstfeest, bij Lely weten we hoe we moeten vieren! Voor een sfeerimpressie kun je deze video bekijken: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v\=6WA3e0WHbxE


Ook zijn we trots dat onze inzet en visie zijn bekroond met het winnen van de Rotterdamse Ondernemersprijs 2025!

jobs.title: Senior Test Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
**Company Description**  

Lely, founded in 1948, is committed to creating a sustainable, profitable, and enjoyable future in agriculture. Driven by the challenges farmers face and the needs of cows, we develop high\-quality robots and data systems that improve animal welfare, flexibility, and productivity on dairy farms. Our mission is to support sustainable food production.


For more than 30 years, we have been a global leader in the sales and service of automated systems for successive generations of dairy farmers. Every day, we inspire our colleagues to provide customers with innovative solutions and to be a reliable partner for long\-term advice and support. With our state\-of\-the\-art Lely Campus in Maassluis and a worldwide network of dedicated Lely Centers offering tailored sales and service, Lely operates in more than fifty countries.

 **Job Description**  

At Lely, software plays a crucial role in the performance, reliability, and safety of our robotic and farm management solutions. Every day, our products help dairy farmers around the world work more efficiently while improving animal welfare and supporting sustainable food production.


As a Senior Test Automation Engineer, you help shape the quality engineering and test automation strategy for Horizon, Lely's farm management platform. You provide technical direction, drive improvements across multiple teams, and help elevate the maturity of our testing practices. Your focus goes beyond building and maintaining automated tests; you create the conditions that enable teams to deliver high\-quality software with confidence.


You take ownership of strategic quality initiatives, identify opportunities for improvement, and help teams make informed decisions based on objective quality data. You play a leading role in advancing our automation approach across multiple test levels, including component, API, and end\-to\-end testing. This includes further developing our component testing capabilities, designing, implementing, and maintaining the underlying test infrastructure, such as CI/CD test pipelines, test execution environments, and CI/CD runners. You drive continuous improvements to the test platform, ensuring fast, reliable feedback throughout the software delivery lifecycle and enabling teams to deliver high\-quality software with confidence.


As a senior member of the Test Automation Chapter, you help define standards, share best practices, coach fellow engineers, and contribute to the long\-term direction of test automation within Digital Farming. Many improvements extend beyond a single development team, requiring you to build alignment and collaborate effectively with stakeholders and engineering teams in the Netherlands, Turkey and Portugal.


Alongside these chapter\-wide responsibilities, you are also part of a Scrum team, where you contribute hands\-on to the design, implementation, and maintenance of automated tests and quality practices within Horizon.


The work is carried out primarily from our campus in Maassluis. Occasional travel to Turkey is expected to support collaboration and successful implementation of improvements across teams.

**Your main responsibilities include:**

* Defining and evolving the test automation strategy across component, API, and end\-to\-end testing.
* Leading quality improvement initiatives and driving adoption across multiple teams.
* Providing technical direction and coaching to fellow test automation engineers within the Test Automation Chapter.
* Taking ownership of the component testing domain, including defining the approach, expanding component test coverage, and integrating it into the CI/CD pipeline.
* Driving collaboration between testing, software development, architecture, and other technical disciplines across the Netherlands and Turkey.
* Providing objective insights on product quality, risk, and release readiness.

**Hands\-on responsibilities**

* Designing, implementing, and maintaining automated E2E and API tests using TypeScript and Playwright.
* Designing, implementing, and maintaining component tests using C\# and Testcontainers.
* Supporting the migration from Cucumber to Playwright.
* Managing and improving CI/CD test pipelines in GitLab.
* Owning the automated quality gates that determine merge readiness.
* Managing the Windows VM test lab and associated infrastructure.
* Maintaining dashboards, reporting pipelines, and quality metrics.
* Maintaining the supporting tooling and scripts used for test execution and infrastructure automation in PowerShell, Python, Azure, Windows, and Kubernetes environments.

  

**Qualifications**  

You are a people\-oriented senior engineer with a strong technical foundation and a passion for product quality. You enjoy helping engineers grow, bringing teams together, and creating clarity in complex development environments.


In addition, you bring:

* A bachelor's or master's degree in Software Engineering or another relevant technical discipline, or equivalent working and thinking ability.
* AT least 5 years of experience in test automation, verification, or quality engineering within a technical product development environment.
* Experience guiding, coaching, or mentoring engineers in technical initiatives.
* A broad technical interest and affinity with multidisciplinary systems, software, and robotics.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build alignment across different teams and disciplines.
* Fluency in English.

  

**Additional Information**  

Working at Lely means contributing to sustainable progress within one of the most innovative organizations in the Netherlands. You help make the agricultural sector more futureproof, and we ensure you have the space, resources, and support to do so.

* An international work environment that values collaboration, initiative, and diverse perspectives.
* A culture that encourages learning, experimentation, and ownership of ideas.
* Excellent employment conditions, including up to 8 weeks of vacation per year and a strong pension scheme.
* A salary range of € 6\.000 – € 8\.000 gross per month, with clear opportunities for growth within the scale.
* Full ownership of your own development, with access to a wide range of courses through the Lely Academy.
* Daily access to outstanding sports facilities at the Lely Campus: an indoor gym, outdoor padel courts, basketball and volleyball courts, table tennis, and table football. You can join Hyrox workouts or sign up for personal training and challenge your colleagues during an active break.
* Fresh coffee and tea from our own barista (with milk from our own farm) and a healthy, affordable company restaurant.


Work\-life balance

* A healthy work\-life balance thanks to our hybrid working policy: you work at least three days a week on Campus, with flexible hours and plenty of opportunity to spend additional time onsite (between 06:00 and 20:00\).
* A free shuttle bus that takes you to and from the metro station in Maassluis, ensuring your workday starts and ends smoothly.
* And of course: we love to celebrate! Whether it’s an anniversary or the annual Christmas party. At Lely, we know how to do it. For an impression of our events, take a look at this video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v\=6WA3e0WHbxE


We are also proud that our vision and efforts have been recognized with the Rotterdam Entrepreneurs Award 2025\.


Recruitment \& selection agency, consultancy, and/or staffing agency?


We appreciate the interest, but we recruit all our candidates directly. We understand that as intermediaries, you want to present candidates for our great positions and contribute to our ambitions, but this is not how we have set up our recruitment process. This means that all unsolicited profiles offered on Lely vacancies will be treated as direct applications.

jobs.title: Back-end Developer
jobs.description:
*Gebouwen produceren de hele dag data. Jij zorgt dat daar iets slims mee gebeurt: jouw code maakt er inzichten van waar eigenaren van commercieel vastgoed hun beslissingen op baseren.*

*Bij Healthy Workers bouw je aan ons platform dat met AI en machine learning het energieverbruik van elk gebouw in kaart brengt, en dat vertaalt naar heldere aandachtspunten. Je werkt in een klein team waar jouw features er vanaf dag één toe doen.*

**Over Healthy Workers**


Healthy Workers is AI\-SaaS\-marktleider binnen gebouwoptimalisatie voor commercieel vastgoed. Eigenaren van commercieel vastgoed staan onder flinke druk om hun gebouwen te verduurzamen. Ons platform helpt ze daarbij: we verbinden de installaties en data van een gebouw en laten het slimmer draaien, met minder energieverbruik en meer comfort tot gevolg. We zitten direct aan tafel met die eigenaren. Na Nederland rollen we nu uit in België, Luxemburg en Duitsland, en daarna volgt de rest van Europa.


We zijn een scale\-up: informeel, korte lijnen, en direct contact met onze founders Jonatan en Guus.

**Wat ga je doen?**


Je komt in team Product en je bouwt features van begin tot eind: van een idee tot draaiend in productie.

* Je bouwt API's, datamodellen en integraties in Kotlin
* Je bouwt mee aan AI\-features die gebouwinstallaties slimmer aansturen
* Samen met ons Data\-team koppel je nieuwe databronnen aan het platform, zodat Healthy Workers dé plek is voor alle gebouw\- en klantdata
* Je lost bugs op en houdt de productie gezond
* Je reviewt code van anderen en krijgt zelf ook reviews, altijd binnen één werkdag
* Je leert ons domein kennen, inclusief SkySpark, ons platform voor gebouwanalyse


Zo ziet je week er ongeveer uit:


\~60% bouwen: API's, datamodellen, integraties en AI\-features


\~20% maintenance, devops en infra: bugs, monitoring, CI/CD en infrastructuur


\~10% code reviews en security (pentests en ISO)


\~10% stand\-ups, refinement, sprintplanning en retro

**Onze stack**


Kotlin, Micronaut, MySQL, BigQuery, Docker, Kubernetes, GitLab CI, Terraform, Google Cloud Platform en SkySpark. We plannen in Linear.

**Kom je uit Java**? Perfect! Kotlin voelt al snel vertrouwd, en de rest leer je hier van collega's die het dagelijks schrijven.

**Wat neem je mee?**


Must\-haves:

* Een paar jaar ervaring als back\-end developer met Java of Kotlin
* Je kunt goed overweg met SQL en je hebt REST API's gebouwd die in productie draaien
* Je hebt met Docker en CI/CD gewerkt. Kubernetes ken je al of leer je hier
* Je bent leergierig en geïnteresseerd in nieuwe technologie
* Je legt technische keuzes helder uit aan collega's van Product, Data en Technical Customer Success
* Je spreekt vloeiend Engels.

Mooi meegenomen:

* Ervaring met Terraform, GitLab CI of Google Cloud Platform
* Kennis van C\#
* Ervaring in een klein productteam bij een scale\-up
* Affiniteit met gebouw\-, energie\- of sensordata

**Wat krijg je terug?**

* Een salaris dat past bij je ervaring. Dat bespreken we open in het eerste gesprek
* Een SAR\-regeling, zodat je meedeelt in de groei van Healthy Workers
* 30 vakantiedagen
* Een opleidings\- en conferentiebudget
* Reiskostenvergoeding voor woon\-werkverkeer
* Geen piketdienst
* Een direct lijntje naar onze Founders Jonatan en Guus

**Het proces**


Van eerste gesprek tot beslissing duurt het maximaal 2 weken. Na elk gesprek hoor je de volgende dag van ons, zonder weken stilte.

**Klinkt dit als jouw volgende stap?**


Solliciteer via onderstaande button of stuur me een berichtje. Je cv of gewoon je LinkedIn\-profiel is genoeg, een motivatiebrief is niet nodig. Wil je eerst sparren of dit iets voor je is? Neem gerust contact op, dan hebben we het erover: Maarten Wolters maarten@healthyworkers.com of \+31 6 13392042\.

jobs.description:
**Company Description**  

Ubisoft is a global leader in gaming with teams across the world creating original and memorable gaming experiences, from Assassin’s Creed, Rainbow Six, to Just Dance and more. We believe diverse perspectives help both players and teams thrive. If you’re passionate about innovation and pushing entertainment boundaries, join our journey and help us create the unknown!

 **Job Description** **Develop at Ubisoft** is a mentorship program for students and recent graduates (with less than two years of experience) looking to grow their skills in Game Design, Audio, Programming, or Cybersecurity.


This initiative supports individuals from genders historically underrepresented in gaming and STEM.

 **Develop at Ubisoft** is one of several talent programs we offer to engage and support different audiences across the industry.

**Please note: this program is a mentorship program and is not tied to any hiring process.**


From January to May 2027, selected mentees will work on a project based on a given theme. They will be mentored by volunteer Ubisoft developers, including from our mobile studios, who will provide feedback and guidance throughout the mentorship to help them develop their own personal project.


In the **Programming track**, you will develop and submit a game using either C\+\+ or C\# with a freely available development tool, such as Unity for mobile.

 **Qualifications** **Eligibility criteria:**

* At least 18 years old
* Currently enrolled in studies, or graduated in Spring 2024 or later
* Fewer than 2 years of professional experience
* Legally entitled to work in the country of application
* Applications may be submitted to only one location
* Individual entries only – team entries will not be considered

**Additional criteria for Toronto applicants:**

* Must be a student or recent graduate
* Must be a resident of Ontario
* Must have attended a recognized school, college or university in Ontario

**This program is designed to support early\-career professionals from underrepresented genders – female and nonbinary – in the industry. By submitting an application, you confirm that you meet and accept the eligibility criteria outlined above.**


Apply with your **resume, cover letter** and, if available, a **portfolio**. Please also select your **preferred track and location**.

 **Additional Information** **Application period:** **October 1st – October 31st**

**We are looking for mentees in the locations where our participating studios are based:**

**Canada** (Montreal, Saguenay,Toronto);

**France** (Bordeaux, Lyon \- Ivory Tower, Montpellier, Paris);

**Germany** (Berlin, Kolibri Games (mobile) \- Berlin, Düsseldorf, Mainz);

**Italy** (Milan)**;**

**Singapore;**

**Sweden** (Malmö \- Massive Entertainment);

Our technologies inspire people to develop and produce things that are currently unimaginable. Im Rahmen eines industrieweiten Forschungsprojekts wirken Sie aktiv mit  
*

* Erste Erfahrungen im Bereich Simulation, Modellerstellung oder Programmierung bringen Sie mit

* Gute Deutsch\- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift ermöglichen Ihnen einen sicheren Austausch
Mit einer strukturierten und selbständigen Arbeitsweise verbinden Sie analytische und konzeptionelle Fähigkeiten mit Kommunikationsstärke  
*

------------------------

  

* Pflichtpraktikum oder freiwilliges Praktikum (auch im Gap Year zwischen Bachelor und Master)
* Attraktive Vergütung (auch für Pflichtpraktika)
* Flexible Arbeitszeiten (Gleitzeit)
* Vor Ort oder teilweise mobil nach Absprache

Gute Anbindung an öffentliche Verkehrsmittel

**Ort:** Ditzingen


**Beginn:** Sommersemester 2027


**Dauer:** 6 Monate

Auf unserer Karriereseite finden Sie alle FAQs rund um Ihre Bewerbung bei uns.

jobs.title: European Patent Examiner in Electrical Engineering (Electric Power Distribution & Protection)
jobs.description:
**European Patent Examiner in Electrical Engineering (Electric Power Distribution \& Protection) (22637\)**

  

**Duration of contract:** Five years, renewable (full\-time)
  

**Location:** Germany (Munich/Berlin) or the Netherlands (The Hague)
  

**Application deadline:** 2 November 2026

  

  

**At the European Patent Office (EPO), we explore breakthrough technologies before they reach the public.** As a patent examiner, you'll assess whether inventions meet the criteria for patent protection, and in doing so support innovation that improves lives, drives industries and shapes the future.  

We are an inclusive, purpose\-driven organisation committed to sustainability, fairness and excellence – diversity is part of our DNA. Whether you come from research, academia or industry, if you're curious, open to learning and looking for a meaningful intellectual challenge you'll find your place at the EPO.  

**Your role and impact**
As a Patent Examiner, you will:
* **examine patent applications** – including technical documentation and drawings – in one of our official languages (English, French or German)
* **analyse new inventions** to evaluate their novelty and inventive step
* **conduct in\-depth research** using digital search tools, scientific databases and patent information sources to identify the most relevant prior art
* **apply legal and procedural frameworks** to make clear, high\-quality decisions on whether a patent should be granted
* **communicate your findings** clearly and constructively with applicants and other parties
* **collaborate with international colleagues** in a diverse and inclusive environment
* **maintain high\-quality standards** with strong attention to detail and scientific rigour
* **contribute to Europe's innovation ecosystem** by ensuring fair and consistent application of the European Patent Convention (EPC) and related legal texts
  

**Your profile**
**We're looking for expertise in at least one of these fields:**
* Electric Power Distribution \& Protection: background as electrical engineer or physicist with similar expertise, preferably with background in electric power distribution (e.g. from renewable energy sources, such as photovoltaic systems, wind turbines, hydropower plants etc, to grid/power networks) via AC and/or DC lines (including HVDC), power conversion, energy storage, wireless power transfer and battery charging technologies (e.g. EVs/HEVs charging) and preferably Emergency Protective Circuit Arrangements.
  

**You will thrive with us if you**
* have a solid background and relevant expertise in the specified fields, built up during your studies, in projects, and/or as a result of professional experience
* enjoy deep technical analysis, reading technical drawings and solving intellectual puzzles
* are genuinely curious about technology and enjoy continuously learning about new scientific developments, emerging technologies and patent law
* are analytical, detail\-oriented and open\-minded
* are confident using digital technologies and AI\-supported tools to analyse information while applying own critical thinking
* value both independent work and team collaboration
* are comfortable making structured, evidence\-based decisions
  

No prior IP(intellectual property) experience? No problem.
We provide full legal and procedural training to get you started.  

  

**Our minimum requirements for this post**
* Diploma of completed studies at master's level covering one or more technical fields mentioned above
* Excellent knowledge (at least C1\) of one of our official languages (English, French and German) and the ability to understand the other two; alternatively, excellent knowledge (at least C1\) of English (in such cases, the willingness to learn the missing languages and to reach level B2 within a set time frame would be required)
* Work experience in industry would be an advantage
* Citizenship of one of the member states of the European Patent Organisation
  

**What we offer**
* competitive salary: €7 076 to €10 164 net/month (depending on location and experience)
* 30\+ days of annual leave \+ flexible working arrangements
* generous remote work policy: work from anywhere in the country of employment; up to 60 days from abroad (EPC states)
* family\-friendly policies: childcare, education and relocation support
* pension and insurance: excellent social security coverage
* examiner training: a comprehensive two\-year development programme covering all aspects of patent search and examination, starting with a six\-week Academy programme on\-site and delivered in English
* inclusive culture: 35\+ nationalities, supportive networks and a strong DEI commitment
* facilities: on\-site gym, health services, staff clubs and more (depending on location)
* top locations: high quality of life and a thriving international community
* (see full list of benefits)
  

**What to expect next**
We are recruiting for positions starting from 2027 and are already building a talent pool for upcoming roles in 2028\. If selected to join our talent pool, you'll get:  

* priority access to future vacancies
* exclusive access to learning offers and resources to enhance your IP awareness and your readiness to become a patent examiner
* regular updates and insights
  

Being a member of the talent pool gives you a chance to join our journey from the very beginning and to be fully prepared for when the next positions go live.  

**Ready to apply?**
Click **Apply** and take the first step towards a meaningful role in which science, innovation and purpose come together.  

For tips on how to prepare your application, and to read more about our recruitment process, visit our Careers page.  

**Process**  

The successful candidate will be selected on the basis of qualifications, competencies, professional experience and language knowledge, supplemented as appropriate by technical assessments, interviews and/or a personality questionnaire.

  

A talent pool (reserve list) will be constituted should more candidates than required at this time be considered suitable following the selection procedure. Such talent pools are valid for a period of 24 months and talent pool candidates may be contacted should a vacancy with substantially the same profile arise during that period.

  

In line with the EPO's values and the standards of honesty and integrity expected of its employees, candidates are expected to uphold these same principles throughout the selection process.

  

We recognise that AI tools may be used to support the preparation of job applications. Candidates nevertheless remain responsible for the content of their application and for the accuracy of the information submitted – and we encourage candidates to ensure that their job application remains an authentic reflection of their own qualifications, skills and experience.

  

During interviews and assessments, candidates are expected to rely on their own knowledge, experience and judgement, without the use of AI tools or other forms of real\-time assistance, unless explicitly stated otherwise.

  

  

**Ready to apply?**Click **Apply** and take the first step towards a meaningful role in which science, innovation and purpose come together.  

For tips on how to prepare your application, and to read more about our recruitment process, visit our Careers page.  

  

  



**Key information**


**Job group:** 4


**Grade:** G7 to G10 (net (basic) monthly salary\* for this vacancy: EUR 7 076 to 10 164, depending on experience and location)


**Career path:** Technical


**Working mode:** Hybrid \*\*


**Pre\-selection outcome communicated by**: end December 2026


**Technical Interviews estimated for:** October 2026 – January 2027


**Final interviews planned for:** November 2026 – February 2027

  

* *After deduction of EPO\-internal tax (no other national income tax applies) and before deduction of staff contributions to the social security and pension schemes.*

*\*\*The position will require relocation to the country of one of the following EPO sites: Germany (Munich/Berlin) or The Netherlands (The Hague). The final location will be discussed later and depends also on team\-specific needs.*  

We welcome all applications for vacant positions. We consider each on its professional merits – regardless of your nationality, ethnic origin, gender, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, parental responsibilities, age, religion or belief.


  
Information at a Glance  

  

  

\> Work as a patent examiner


**Why join us?**
  

✓ See the latest inventions and enable innovation
  

✓ Work with inspiring people from a variety of cultures
  

✓ Develop yourself and take on an intellectual challenge


**What's in it for you?**
  

✓ A competitive salary
  

✓ Family\-friendly benefits
  

✓ A good work\-life balance
  

✓ Generous flexibility options
  

✓ Relocation benefits and various allowances
  

✓ Contributory medical insurance and pension schemes
  

✓ 30 days' leave per year
  

✓ Free gym access
  

✓ Social activities and clubs


**Who we are**
  

We are the patent office for Europe. We are proud to deliver high\-quality patents and efficient services that foster innovation, competitiveness and economic growth.


**Our vision**
  

We will empower and motivate our staff to set worldwide standards in intellectual property. Our Office will be effective and transparent, respond to the needs of our users and be agile in managing the changing demands and conditions of a dynamic global patent system. Our work will contribute to a safer, smarter and more sustainable world.


**Our values**
  

All our relationships within our Office and with partners around the world will prosper through trust, fairness, mutual respect, adaptability, collaboration and a commitment to excellence.


**Our work environment**
  

We believe that diversity is fundamental to our success. Our inclusive work environment respects, values and celebrates our individual differences. We want you to be yourself at work.Join us on this exciting journey to a more digital, collaborative and sustainable organisation.


\>

Stellenbeschreibung
**Software Developer Intranet (m/w/d)**
=======================================


Unternehmen: Bundesdruckerei GmbH
Standort: Berlin
Vertragsart: Unbefristet
Gestalten Sie mit uns die digitale Zukunft! Freuen Sie sich auf spannende Aufgaben, eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten und persönliches Wachstum. -----------------------

  

* Entwicklung und Weiterentwicklung moderner Intranet\- und Webanwendungen auf Basis von SharePoint, M365, .NET sowie Microsoft Power Platform \& Azure
* Konzeption und Umsetzung innovativer Softwarelösungen innerhalb unseres Development\-Stacks
* Erweiterung bestehender Anwendungen mit Bordmitteln und/oder C\# sowie JavaScript
* Mitgestaltung einer zukunftsfähigen Applikationslandschaft zur Optimierung interner Prozesse und Produktivität
* Zusammenarbeit in einem agilen Umfeld mit modernen Tools und Methoden wie Jira, GitLab, CI/CD sowie Retrospektiven

* Förderung einer offenen, wertschätzenden Teamkultur mit Fokus auf Zusammenarbeit, Eigenverantwortung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung

--------------

  

* Abgeschlossenes Studium der (Wirtschafts\-)Informatik oder einer IT\-technischen Ausbildung
* Einschlägige Berufserfahrung im Bereich Software Development
* Programmierkenntnisse im .NET\-Umfeld sowie Kenntnisse gängiger Frameworks
* Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Lösungen mit der Microsoft Power Platform (insbesondere Power Automate und Power Apps) und / oder auf Microsoft Azure (Functions, Logik Apps)
* Erfahrung mit Testautomatisierung und Tools bzw. Frameworks
* Kundenorientierung, Teamfähigkeit sowie Bereitschaft zur kontinuierlichen Weiterbildung
* Kommunikationskompetenz auf Deutsch mind. B2\-Niveau und Englisch mind. B1\-Niveau

-------------------------------


Die Bundesdruckerei\-Gruppe leistet mit ihrer Digital\- und Sicherheitskompetenz als Technologieunternehmen des Bundes einen Beitrag für die digitale Souveränität Deutschlands und Europas. Zur Muttergesellschaft Bundesdruckerei Gruppe GmbH gehören die Bundesdruckerei GmbH mit ihrer Tochter Maurer Electronics GmbH, zudem die D\-Trust GmbH, genua GmbH, Xecuro GmbH sowie Inco Spółka z o.o.

  


**Bundesdruckerei GmbH**
------------------------


Hightech\-Innovationen brauchen Macher und Macherinnen: Ein Job bei der Bundesdruckerei GmbH überträgt ihnen gesellschaftliche Verantwortung. Im Herzen Berlins entstehen Lösungen rund um Sichere Identitäten, eine moderne Verwaltung und KI. Damit schafft die Bundesdruckerei GmbH die Basis für eine moderne und resiliente Gesellschaft.

Standort: Berlin
Vertragsart: Unbefristet

------------


**Gemeinsam mehr erreichen:**
  

Toller Teamspirit in einem kompetenten und zukunftssicheren Arbeitsumfeld mit einzigartigen Projekten

Top Equipment, agile Entwicklungsmethoden mit modernem Tech Stack und innovativen Kollaborationstools

Individuelle Weiterbildungs\-möglichkeiten sowie Fach\- und Führungskräfteprogramme
