jobs.title: Partner Solution Engineer – EMEA Central
jobs.description:
**Company Description**  

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI\-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.


Join us to put AI to work for people.

 **Job Description**  

The ServiceNow Partner Design Studio is looking for a Partner Solution Engineer with a passion for innovation, design standards, and cutting\-edge architecture practices. This is a unique opportunity to shape partner\-branded solutions using an AI\-first approach — where AI is embedded into every step of design and solutioning. You will help partners design, validate, and accelerate differentiated solutions on the Now Platform through design thinking, deep technical architecture, and go\-to\-market alignment, ensuring every solution is AI\-ready, scalable, and outcome\-driven.


As a pooled, forward\-deployed engineering authority, you will work across partners as a force multiplier focused on standards, reuse, and quality, certifying into Practices to bring domain depth where it’s needed. By applying the FLIGHT design thinking framework and maintaining architectural rigor, you will accelerate partner time\-to\-value by up to 2x while establishing reusable patterns and reference architectures that scale across the entire partner ecosystem.

**What You’ll Do**


As a Partner Solution Engineer, you will define the reference architectures, design standards, and validated patterns that partners build to — serving as the forward\-deployed technical authority for AI\-infused ServiceNow solutions that address real\-world business challenges.

**AI\-First Solution Blueprints \& Design Workshops**

* Lead design workshops using the FLIGHT framework to define AI\-native reference patterns and set the solution standards partners build to on the Now Platform.
* Apply an AI\-first mindset in all partner engagements — from design workshops to solution architecture — ensuring partners are equipped to lead in an AI\-driven market.
* Translate partner ideas and industry opportunities into actionable blueprints, validated architectures, and minimum viable product specifications.
* Drive conversations around market positioning, industry opportunities, and how AI can create differentiated solutions.

**Technical Architecture \& Validation**

* Provide expert architecture and AI readiness guidance ensuring partner solutions meet ServiceNow standards for quality, performance, and simplicity.
* Conduct deep architectural reviews for net\-new patterns, complex multi\-product integrations, and advanced AI/agentic scenarios.
* Evaluate solution architectures against the Partner Co\-Innovation Framework including upgrade survivability, security posture, and scalability.
* Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to align partner innovations with ServiceNow platform priorities and AI strategy.

**Reusable Patterns \& Standards**

* Capture, document, and publish repeatable patterns, architectures, and design frameworks (Orbital, FLIGHT) to scale partner innovation across the ecosystem.
* Develop industry\-specific reference architectures for verticals including Financial Services, Healthcare, Manufacturing, and Public Sector.
* Contribute validated patterns to the Pattern Library for use by partners across all Co\-Innovation Maturity Tiers.
* Continuously refine design frameworks and delivery methods to enhance partner experience and measurable business outcomes.

**Partner Enablement \& Strategic Alignment**

* Mentor partner design and solution teams, building capability in AI\-native solution development and Now Platform extensibility.
* Provide educational design reviews for Foundation\-tier partners to accelerate learning and capability development.
* Support partners in defining go\-to\-market strategies, technical goals, and measurable outcomes through the lens of AI\-enhanced capabilities.
* Promote partner success stories, highlighting business impact and thought leadership through structured design and standards engagements.

 **Qualifications** **Required**:

* 8\+ years in solution architecture, technical sales, pre\-sales, or similar roles with deep platform architecture experience.
* Significant experience working with technology partners at either a partner or OEM level, including solution design and reference\-architecture definition.
* Strong grasp of cloud platform architecture including SaaS, PaaS, automation, and multi\-tenancy patterns.
* Proven ability to guide partners through complex solution designs and business strategy discussions.
* Deep curiosity and expertise in AI technologies, emerging trends, and design thinking methodologies.
* Clear communicator comfortable engaging at the CxO level, translating complex technical topics into actionable business insights.
* Experience facilitating workshops, design sessions, and collaborative innovation exercises that produce tangible outcomes.
* Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision\-making, or problem\-solving.

**Preferred \& Standout Experience:**

* ServiceNow platform development experience and/or ServiceNow certifications (CSA, CAD, CIS, architectural certifications).
* Design Thinking training or certification; experience applying human\-centered design principles in partner\-facing design and standards work.
* AI and automation expertise: knowledge of generative AI, predictive analytics, or automation tools in enterprise solutions.
* Business development background: experience developing partner go\-to\-market plans or new solution plays.
* Industry experience in Financial Services, Healthcare, Manufacturing, or Public Sector.
* Familiarity with competitive cloud or enterprise software platforms.

**What This Role Does Not Do**

* Perform platform configuration, development, or solution delivery for partners (guides architecture, does not build).
* Own commercial contracts, pricing, or financial program management.
* Serve as dedicated partner\-assigned resource (operates as pooled, forward\-deployed engineering authority).
* Replace Partner Technology Architects for holistic partner strategy or business development.
* Manage day\-to\-day partner relationships (pooled resource; forward\-deployed where solution\-engineering depth is required).

**Travel for partner, customer, and organizational activities up to 25%.**

 **Additional Information** **Work Personas**


We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third\-party service.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**


ServiceNow is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or any other category protected by law. In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements.

**Accommodations**


We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact globaltalentss@servicenow.com for assistance.

**Export Control Regulations**


For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ServiceNow may be required to obtain export control approval from government authorities for certain individuals. All employment is contingent upon ServiceNow obtaining any export license or other approval that may be required by relevant export control authorities.

jobs.title: Unity Gameplay Developer - Mobile (iOS & Android) (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
#### **Context and Focus**

### **About Us**


We are headraft. Since 2016, we have been pioneers in the conception and production of interactive brand content. Our team unites creative talents from the fields of gaming, 3D, XR technologies, film, and design – all bringing their unique expertise to the table. We build immersive stories, mobile games, and spatial experiences that stand out and deeply engage users.


To help us push the boundaries of mobile interactive experiences, we are looking for a passionate **Unity Gameplay Developer** with a strong focus on iOS and Android platforms to join our agile team.

### **Your Responsibilities**

* **Gameplay Engineering:** Develop, implement, and iterate on core gameplay mechanics, interactive systems, and game logic for mobile platforms using Unity3D and C\#.
* **Mobile Optimization:** Ensure our mobile experiences run flawlessly. You will profile, debug, and optimize game performance, memory usage, and battery consumption across a wide spectrum of iOS and Android devices.
* **Platform Integration:** Handle mobile\-specific implementations, including touch and gesture controls, mobile UI scaling, and native device feature integration.
* **Cross\-functional Collaboration:** Work hand\-in\-hand with our UX/UI designers, 3D artists, and creative directors to ensure the technical feasibility of creative concepts and translate them into a polished mobile experience.
* **Prototyping:** Rapidly prototype new gameplay ideas and immersive mechanics to pitch ideas internally and to clients.

#### **Your background**

**What you bring to the table**
-------------------------------

* **Experience:** You have 3\+ years of professional experience as a Game Developer using Unity, with a solid focus on mobile platforms (iOS/Android).
* **Tech Skills:** Excellent command of C\# and deep knowledge of the Unity Engine, including URP (Universal Render Pipeline), physics, and animation systems.
* **Mobile Expertise:** Strong understanding of mobile hardware constraints. You are comfortable using tools like the Unity Profiler and Frame Debugger to squeeze out performance.
* **Agile Mindset:** Experience with version control (Git) and working in agile, collaborative team environments.
* **Game Feel:** You have a strong sense of game feel, timing, and mobile UX, ensuring our projects aren't just functional, but fun to interact with.
* **Language:** Fluent in English.

#### **Bonus points for**

* **Deployment \& Native Knowledge:** Experience with native iOS (Swift/Objective\-C) and Android (Java/Kotlin) build environments, as well as familiarity with App Store Connect and Google Play Console release management.
* **Languages:** German language skills are a plus.


This role is remote\-friendly. Most of your work happens wherever you're most productive, in the office or at home. What we do need is the flexibility to join us in the office for project\-related tests and setups, depending on each project's scope. That's why being based in the Hamburg metropolitan region is a must.

#### **Why us?**

### **At headraft, we foster a culture that's as innovative as the projects we create.**
**We believe in:**

* Bold Innovation: "We've always done it this way" is not part of our mindset. We experiment, learn, and grow together.
* Creative Freedom: Your ideas matter. The best innovations happen when people are free to think differently.
* Diversity \& Team Spirit: We value diverse identities, backgrounds, and perspectives as the foundation of innovation. We're committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive authentically.

### **What makes us special**

* A state\-of\-the\-art tech stack and access to the latest XR devices
* True work\-life integration with flexible hours and remote/office options
* A growth\-oriented environment with mentoring, feedback, and challenging projects
* Hands\-on involvement in all project phases \- from concept to launch
* Flat hierarchies, open communication, and a strong team spirit
* International projects and a global network of partners and clients
* A team that supports each other and celebrates success together

### **Here's the process**

* Apply: send us your CV. No cover letter needed, but we'd love a few lines on what drives you.
* First chat: if it looks like a match, we'll reach out within 10 business days for a quick intro call (about 30 min).
* Deep dive: we get into the details: Your projects, how you work, what you're looking for. About 60 min, remote or at our Hamburg studio.
* A small pre\-employment assessment along the way
* Meet some of the team \- an honest conversation to see if we click.

**About the opportunity**


Join our innovative Test System Development team, a vital part of our R\&D organization. We are responsible for designing and developing cutting\-edge test systems used globally in R\&D and Production. These systems are crucial in delivering state\-of\-the\-art products. We are looking to bolster our team with a software developer who thrives in a Lean and Agile environment. Our cross\-functional development teams focus on continuous improvement, innovation, and knowledge sharing.

 **What you will do**

* Develop and maintain our globally used software for test systems in C\#, including controlling high\-frequency measuring devices via GPIB, LAN, and USB, and storing measurement results in databases for future evaluations.
* Develop new software to interface with emerging test hardware
* Continuously analyze requirements and perform necessary adjustments
* Drive product and process improvements
* Design and oversee the architecture of complex software for test systems, ensuring they meet business requirements and are scalable, maintainable, and secure.
* Evaluate and recommend appropriate technologies, tools, and frameworks for the software development process
* Drive interface requirements and definitions to other software components from other departments

 **You will bring**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering or a related qualification
* Proficiency in C\# programming languages, knowledge in C\+\+ would be beneficial
* Expertise in software development methodologies, design patterns, and best practices
* Experience with DevOps practices, pipeline handling, and continuous integration/continuous testing (CI/CD)
* Basic understanding of radio frequency technology is a plus
* Team collaboration skills, with high social competence
* Excellent problem\-solving skills, attention to detail and time management abilities
* Structured, result\-oriented work approach

jobs.title: DevOps/Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description:
At Freshfields, technology and innovation are embedded into how we work with our clients. We’re a global law firm with more than 5,500 people across 33 offices, and we are continuing to advance our innovation strategy including investment in key technology. Our partnerships with Anthropic and Google as well as the investment in Freshfields Lab and AI Academy are but a few examples.

  

Join us to work on some of the most exciting challenges at the intersection of law, technology and business.

 **Responsibilities**

  

* Design, build, deploy, and support secure, scalable and resilient AI and cloud\-based solutions on Azure.
* Engineer and maintain AI application infrastructure, including Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), containers, and cloud\-native services.
* Develop and manage Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) to provision and maintain secure, reliable environments.
* Build, optimize, and maintain CI/CD pipelines for AI, data, and application deployment using Azure DevOps.
* Implement automated testing, monitoring, alerting, and observability capabilities to ensure platform reliability and performance.
* Automate operational processes, configuration management, and environment provisioning using modern DevOps practices and tools.
* Collaborate with product, data, and engineering teams to transition new AI solutions into production environments.
* Monitor platform health, troubleshoot incidents, and drive root cause resolution and continuous improvement.
* Ensure all solutions are documented, secure, supportable, and aligned with engineering standards and best practices.

 **Key Experience \& Skills**

  

* 5\+ years of experience designing and implementing cloud\-native solutions, preferably on Microsoft Azure.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Kubernetes (AKS), Docker, and containerized application deployment.
* Expertise in Infrastructure as Code using Terraform and related automation frameworks.
* Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines with Azure DevOps and YAML\-based workflows.
* Strong programming and scripting skills in Python, plus shell scripting (PowerShell or Bash); C\# or Go a plus. Experience deploying and supporting AI, machine learning, API, and cloud application workloads in production environments.
* Experience operating LLM\-based workloads in production, including multi\-provider routing, capacity and quota management, rate limiting, streaming and asynchronous job patterns, retries and backpressure, cost attribution, and AI\-specific tracing and observability.
* Strong understanding of Linux administration, networking, security, and cloud architecture principles.
* Experience with enterprise Azure security patterns, including private networking and private endpoints, Entra ID and managed identities, RBAC, and secrets management with Key Vault.
* Experience operating PostgreSQL, Redis, Azure Service Bus and Azure storage services in production..
* Proficiency with Git, automated testing frameworks, and modern software engineering practices.
* Strong problem\-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with experience working in Agile engineering environments.
* Experience hosting and operating Django or comparable ASGI web applications, background workers, event\-driven services and server\-sent event or similar streaming workloads on Kubernetes.

 **Inclusion**

 *Freshfields is an equal opportunities employer and all applications received by the firm will be considered by the firm on the basis of their merit alone and we welcome applications from all suitably qualified individuals regardless of background. All offers of employment will be conditional on the candidate having/securing the right to work in the UK and providing the firm with evidence of that right (as required by the Immigration, Asylum and Nationality Act 2006\) prior to employment commencing.*

 *Freshfields is a Ban the Box employer. We ask applicants to disclose criminal convictions only when a conditional job offer is made. A conviction does not automatically lead to withdrawal of the offer: we make decisions on a case by case basis and take a number of factors into account (eg the role you are applying for and the circumstances of the offence). You would have the opportunity to discuss the matter with us before we make a decision.*

jobs.title: IT Developer Graduate Programme
jobs.description:
* **Location(s):**
* Swindon, Wiltshire, GB, SN5 6PB
**RWE Supply \& Trading GmbH**


**Start date:** September 2027  

**Salary:** starting at £41,000 p.a


Are you looking to kickstart your career at a company where you can truly make an impact? Whether we’re delivering power to millions, trading in new markets around the globe, or driving the rapid growth of renewable energy, RWE is at the forefront of the industry. But we wouldn’t be there without world\-class IT.

  

  

**About the role**


The IT Developer Graduate Programme is designed for graduates who want to build a career in software engineering and application development, placing you at the heart of our commercial business.


Through a series of hands\-on technical rotations, you’ll work closely with analysts and business support teams to deliver solutions for our energy trading and commercial operations teams, while developing expertise in programming, cloud\-native technologies and DevOps practices.


Along the way, you’ll broaden your technical stack and business knowledge, gain experience across a range of programming languages and working environments, and build an understanding of different teams and cultures, providing a strong foundation for your permanent role and long\-term career development.


You’ll learn about our global business from the inside – working on meaningful projects in areas including:


* Application development.
* Embedded IT for our commercial business such as trading of energy commodities, freight and logistics, commercial asset optimisation or sales and origination.
* Enterprise Integration focus on the transport layer within RWEST’s application landscape and works closely together with other IT and business teams to optimise the systems.
* Market Data Solutions are the fuel for decision\-making, automated trading, and fundamental analysis within the Energy Trading industry.
* Central Services are positioned in middle layer (Integration) applications connecting to various other departments like BackOffice, Risk and Front Office etc. involving incident management, automated standard service requests, working with concepts of DevOps and Squad model and migration of application to cloud based infrastructure.
* IT projects with business attention such as “Lead in Data” or “Lead in Cloud”.

Digital technologies, including AI\-enabled tools, are becoming an integral part of how we work at RWE. Throughout the programme, you will have opportunities to use these tools responsibly to enhance productivity, support decision\-making, foster innovation and improve ways of working, always in line with RWE policies and responsible use principles.


Whichever team you join, you’ll be welcomed as an equal. Your perspective will be valued. You’ll be trusted to deliver the work you’re given. And with each new rotation, you’ll develop the skills and knowledge you need to become an industry expert.

  

  

**Job requirements and experiences**

Are you passionate about IT, digital technologies, and innovative solutions? Committed to building a career in the energy industry? Keen to learn, grow and take ownership and accountability? Then you could be just the kind of exceptional person we’re looking for. Some relevant work experience would be an advantage but is not essential.

  

  

As well as a keen interest in the energy industry and the readiness to explore our markets and our business, you’ll need:


* A degree (BSc, MSc or PhD) in IT or a similar statistical or numerate subject such as Mathematics, Engineering or Economics.
* Knowledge of at least one of the following programming languages \- C\#, Java or Python.
* Passion for IT development and working in a DevOps environment.
* Interest in AI, Automation, and other emerging technologies.
* A positive, team\-oriented approach to work.
* Motivation to take on new challenges.
* A commercial and analytical mindset.
* Adaptability and the ability to learn quickly.
* Enthusiasm for developing your skills and exploring new opportunities.
* Fluent English.
  

  

**From here, you’ll have a community of support**


While you’re on our graduate journey, we’re committed to providing you with a range of opportunities to grow and develop your skills. Alongside job rotations and technical training, you’ll be provided with comprehensive behavioural skills training with our expert partner, Cappfinity. This will enable you to harness your strengths from day one and identify new ways to utilise the key Skills That Build Skills. This will support you to reach your potential and goals, shaping your career path. The behavioural skills training is immersive, including interactive sessions where you can learn from our facilitators and your own peers, and self\-led elements to support your application of learning back in your day\-to\-day role.


Our graduate programmes have been designed to give you the chance to shape your own career path and personal development, with the support you need to succeed. You’ll have access to a graduate buddy and a senior mentor within your field who can advise you on rotations and introduce you to key people within the business.


RWE is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment – we value your passion, your willingness to learn and your desire to thrive. Even if you don't have all the above skills, need flexible working arrangements or other adjustments not yet listed here, we'd love to hear from you.

  

  

**Your benefits**


At RWE, we’ll do everything we can to support you in fulfilling your potential. Our benefits include:


* Competitive salary plus annual discretionary bonus.
* Company pension and discounted employee share scheme.
* 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays, with the option to buy 5 extra days.
* Two paid annual volunteer days for a charity or initiative of your choice.
* International rotations with financial support for relocation.
* Enhanced family\-friendly policies, including maternity support.
* Free on\-site healthcare and access to AXA Private Healthcare Scheme.
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with confidential support for work, health, or life matters.
* Access to modern offices, state\-of\-the\-art IT and diverse employee networks.
* Flexible benefits, including retail discounts.

 ad code **93668,** application period: **14/10/2026**
  

Any questions? **Contact HR:** Early Careers Recruitment Team, rwest\_early\_careers\_recruitment@rwe.com


Please upload your resume and cover letter in English as one document. Should you progress through the interview process, you will be asked to share a copy of your transcript.


Find out more on rwe.com/graduates

  

  

We look forward to meeting you. Of course, you can find us on LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube and Xing, too.
  

  

We value diversity and therefore welcome all applications \- regardless of gender, disability, nationality, ethnic and social origin, religion/belief, age, sexual orientation, and identity. \#inclusionmatters
  

  

RWE Supply \& Trading is our connection to the world’s energy markets. Headquartered in Essen, Germany, the company operates one of Europe’s largest and most advanced energy trading floors. A diverse team of over 2,300 professionals from around 90 countries trades electricity, gas, commodities, and CO2 emission allowances. With precise market analysis and a strong customer focus, we create innovative energy supply solutions and tailored risk management concepts for industrial clients.
  

  

We also ensure the commercial optimisation of RWE’s power plant portfolio and market the electricity generated by RWE. In addition, legally independent RWE gas storage companies operate in Germany, contributing to a secure energy supply.

**About the job:**


We are recruiting for a Graduate Civil / Structural Engineer to be based in Kent’s Woking office.


Are you looking for an opportunity to make a difference and engineer solutions that make not only the UK’s energy security stronger but actively impact the way in which the world drives towards a net zero future?


Our Civil and Structural engineering team in Woking UK operates globally in both the Onshore and Offshore energy sectors and are working towards energy supply, sustainability and reducing carbon emissions. As a graduate in our engineering team you will be contributing to a variety of technically challenging and exciting projects, designing new onshore and potentially offshore energy projects, developing carbon capture and energy storage solutions, developing sustainable fuel facilities which may involve site visits to our client’s global installations.


The successful candidate(s) will join our Graduate Development Programme within our engineering team in Woking with duties including, but not limited to, those outlined below.


**About our Graduate Scheme**


Our people are our power. At Kent, diverse perspectives and talents are the backbone of our strength. We’re building an environment where everyone, from engineers to scientists, from all walks of life, can thrive and reach their full potential.


If you’re passionate about making an impact and pushing boundaries, Kent is where you belong. We are a future\-focused company, reimagining energy with ambition and innovation.


Our global graduate program offers hands\-on experience, mentorship from industry leaders, and the opportunity to grow as part of a diverse and driven team. We’re building the next generation of leaders in engineering, science, and technology, and we want you to be a part of it.


**Application Process**


As part of the application process, candidates will be required to provide confirmation of the academic modules completed during their university studies. This information will help us assess the relevance of your academic background to the role. Please ensure that confirmation of your completed modules is submitted alongside your CV as part of your application.


**Application Deadline**


All applications must be received by **Friday 23****rd** **October 2026**.


**Recruitment Timeline**


Shortlisting and pre\-screening of applications will commence in early November. Candidates selected to progress to the next stage will be invited to interview, with interviews scheduled to take place from late November to early December 2026\.


**Eligibility**


Please note that candidates must have the right to work in the UK to be considered for this opportunity.


**Hybrid Working**


We follow a hybrid working model that combines office and remote work, with a requirement to be in the offices three days a week. This approach supports the development of a strong and effective team dynamic.


**Power the future with us. Unleash your energy**

jobs.title: UK Senior Technical Advisor – Fintech Marketplace Platform (3-Month Contract)
jobs.description:
We are an early stage fintech startup building a cross\-border lending marketplace connecting emerging\-market financial institutions (seeking foreign\-currency funding) with lenders in developed markets. Think of us as connecting Tier 1/2 banks in Africa/Asia with mid Tier lenders in the UK and Europe and China.

We are pre\-revenue, validating product\-market fit with anchor users, and now ready to build the MVP. This is a ground\-floor opportunity to shape the technical foundation of a marketplace that could scale to billions in annual deal flow.

**LOCATION:**  
United Kingdom (Remote, flexible hours)

**THE ROLE**

We need an experienced senior technologist to design the core architecture of our marketplace platform and ensure a junior/mid\-level UK engineer can execute the MVP independently.

You will own six concrete deliverables over 12 weeks:

* **Technical architecture document** – technology stack, system design, rationale
* **Development framework** – Git repo, CI/CD, coding standards, environment setup
* **Data models \& APIs** – entity design, marketplace workflows, third\-party integrations
* **Security \& compliance baseline** – GDPR, KYC/AML, encryption, audit logging
* **Code reviews \& iteration** – bi\-weekly syncs with UK engineer, unblock decisions
* **Hand\-off documentation** – runbook, architecture decisions, next steps

**Not** full\-time leadership or hands\-on coding. **Yes** architectural validation, decision support, and ensuring the UK engineer stays on the right path.

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

**Essential**

* 10\+ years professional software engineering experience
* You have personally built back\-end services (Node/Python/Java/C\#) and modern front ends (React/Vue)
* Comfortable designing systems from scratch and owning technical decisions
* UK\-based, available for video calls during UK hours
* Able to work asynchronously and communicate clearly in writing

**Highly desirable**

* Fintech or banking platform experience
* Understanding of marketplace/B2B platform architecture
* Familiarity with KYC/AML, data protection, and financial\-services compliance
* Startup experience – pragmatic, MVP\-focused thinking
* Comfort with ambiguity and rapid iteration

**Nice to have**

* Experience with distributed or offshore teams
* Azure/ AWS or cloud infrastructure knowledge

**WHO THIS SUITS**

You're likely:

* Between full\-time roles and want a meaningful project
* Semi\-retired and interested in fintech/emerging markets
* A fractional/advisory consultant looking for a case study
* Someone who values the mission and learning opportunity over maximum hourly rate

If you're seeking traditional consulting rates (£80\+/hour), this isn't the right fit. If you want to shape the technical direction of an ambitious startup and work with a capable UK engineer, we'd love to hear from you.

**COMPENSATION**

£200 per week, paid monthly \| Fixed 3\-month contract \| \~120 hours total

**No equity in this engagement.** If it leads to ongoing CTO\-level advisory, we will discuss equity then.

Tell us:

* Your background: 3–4 highlights from your software engineering career
* Why you're interested: What appeals about this project
* Fintech/marketplace experience: Any relevant examples
* Availability: Can you commit \~10 hours/week and possible start date.

Pay: £200\.00 per week

Work Location: Remote

**Never settle –** We think of ourselves as ‘embedded hero\-makers’ for our customers. We put them first, and if we say we’ll do something, we’ll move heaven and earth to do it. We think boldly and embrace change.

**Take ownership \-** We think rigorously and deeply about a problem, but then charge at it, acting with and urgency and speed that sets us apart. But we never lose sight of quality or long\-term scalability.

**Be generous \& candid \-** We encourage our people – and our customers – to challenge us and never shy away from tough conversations. We have a flat and inclusive culture where everyone can be themselves – and speak up.


Check out our Glassdoor page for the latest reviews or our LinkedIn for company updates and insights from the team.  




**Our engineering ways of working:**
------------------------------------

* Our Product and Engineering organisation is structured into four tribes: Custody, Accounts, Experience, and Cloud \& Security. Each tribe contains multiple autonomous squads, with clear full ownership over specific product domains.
* The squads are intentionally small and cross\-functional, typically made up of an Engineering Manager, Product Manager, and 3–5 engineers with complementary skills aligned to the domain they own.
* We operate in a build\-and\-run model, with teams responsible for the full software lifecycle, from architecture and delivery through to operational support and incident management.
* Our core platform is built on AWS serverless technologies including Lambda, SQS, EventBridge, API Gateway, S3, and ECS. We primarily develop in **TypeScript and Node.js,** with **MongoDB** as our primary document database. We also have a small number of C\# services and are continuing to evolve our platform architecture, including expanding our use of ECS Fargate.
* Infrastructure is managed through a combination of Terraform and Serverless Framework. We use GitHub Actions for CI/CD and incident.io to support our incident management processes and operational workflows.
* We care deeply about engineering quality, pragmatic architecture, and continuous improvement. If you’d like to go deeper, we’re happy to share more about our engineering practices and technology radar during the interview process.

  

**The role**
------------


As an engineer at Seccl you will design, build and operate reliable and scalable, testable and maintainable software solutions, building new functionalities and products using **Typescript and Node.js.** You play a key role in our software development and have a hands\-on approach throughout the development process supporting resilient financial workflow systems and regulated investment operations. As a senior member of the team, you are the ‘go\-to’ person for queries.  




**On a typical day you will…**
------------------------------

* Work collaboratively in a domain aligned cross\-functional squad made up of engineers and product along with colleagues from customer\-facing and operations teams
* Design, implement and operate your services within your domain
* Be accountable for the SLAs of your products and iterative improvements
* Maintain and extend documentation for your services
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement and technical excellence while understanding when “good enough for now” is appropriate
* Provide guidance and mentorship for other engineers
* Communicate with non\-technical colleagues to answer queries about the Seccl system

  

**What you need…**
------------------

* To own your services from design to operation. We operate a build\-and\-run model where engineers have autonomy but full accountability.
* We care deeply about correctness, resilience and operational excellence because our systems underpin real customer investments.
* Engineers are not passengers in their products but champions. Drive improvements and features while collaborating openly with product, operations and engineering colleagues, challenging ideas constructively and focusing on delivering the best outcomes for customers.
* Have a strong ability to understand business and customer problems and turn them into efficient, scalable solutions. Be curious about how investment and custody products operate, and pragmatic in balancing customer value, operational correctness, engineering quality and long\-term scalability.
* Experience building financial systems with multi\-region, multi\-currency or trading\-related complexity would be advantageous.
* Experience in a strongly/statically typed language.
* Have a strong understanding of designing, building, and running high\-quality, standards\-compliant workflow APIs, with a focus on testing, observability, and performance.
* Have worked with a cloud provider (AWS/Azure/GCP). We use AWS.
* Have worked with distributed systems and are comfortable debugging through tracing and observability.
* Willing to be on\-call for your services.

  

**Core technical skills you must have:**
----------------------------------------

* Strong commercial experience with **Node.js**, specifically **TypeScript**
* Experience with **Amazon Web Services**
* Experience with Serverless products
* Experience with document databases, ideally **MongoDB**
* Experience mentoring engineers
* Experience leading technical delivery in a build\-and\-run engineering model
* Experience in a structured on\-call process and incident management
* Experience working in regulated industries, ideally financial services or FinTech.

  

**This role isn’t for you if...**
---------------------------------

* **You rely on a lot of top\-down direction.** Here, you’ll have a lot of freedom and ownership of your role, and you’ll be expected to shape your own progression, bring forward ideas, and spot opportunities to improve
* **You’re not comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment.** Our speed and scalability are what set us apart; you need to be able to act quickly and think on your feet
* **You struggle to follow through on ideas.** We value people who do what they say they will. If you care about something, you have the freedom here to make it happen
* **You don’t like change**. You’ll get on great here if you relish the ambiguity of rapid growth and are willing to embrace uncertainty

**Location** : Edinburgh, Hybrid.


In this position, you’ll be based in the Edinburgh offices for a minimum of three days a week, with the flexibility to work from home for some of your working week. If you have a remote location recorded in Fusion this arrangement will continue to be honoured if you are successful in your application, provided that


* You have a formal accommodation due to a disability, medical or legal reason that enables you to work remotely

You were moved to a remote contract as your office closed, and you don't live near any of our current offices  
* 

  

**We give you a world of potential**

We're looking for a Full Stack Developer who enjoys working in a team of developers, testers and business analysts to build high\-quality software solutions.


You will have experience designing, developing, testing, and delivering new features while continuously enhancing existing applications and tools.


You will also be comfortable supporting and maintaining existing systems, assessing the impact of changes, troubleshooting issues, and implementing effective resolutions.

Other key responsibilities include:

* Strong understanding of engineering principles and practices for design, build, test and deployment.

**Health and wellbeing** rewards that can be tailored to support you and your family


**Invest in our business** by setting aside salary to purchase shares in our company, and you’ll receive a company contribution as well.


**Extra rewards** ranging from recognition awards and team get togethers to helping you invest in your future


**And more.** Ours is a welcoming and close\-knit community, with experienced colleagues ready to help you grow. Our careers hub will help you find out more about our rewards and life at Computershare, visit computershare.com/careershub .

jobs.title: Protective Design Engineer (Structural / Blast Engineering)
jobs.description:
Security
UKIMEA Region

LON000596 Requisition \#  

**Joining Arup**


Arup’s purpose, shared values and collaborative approach has set us apart for over 80 years, guiding how we shape a better world.


Watch this short clip to discover how Arup are shaping a better world and how you could be a part of it!


**The Opportunity**


Our risk, security and resilience practice has helped organisations to understand their exposure to threats and make better risk\-informed decisions since it was formed in the mid\-1990s. Our team of experts are trusted advisors to private and public\-sector clients, providing strategic risk management, technical risk assessment, operational planning, security engineering and counter\-terrorism design measures that suit their business needs. Our team apply their knowledge, critical thinking and experience to help our clients to understand and anticipate what could go wrong, and we help with finding better solutions to ensure that risks are effectively managed and controlled. Our team has consistently delivered high\-quality advisory and engineering services to clients across a range of markets and industries, including Rail, Energy, Data Centres, Highways, Healthcare, Property and Scientific research facilities.


You will join Arup as a Consultant working in our protective design engineering team with a focus on sustainable development across a range of market and industries. The types of projects you will be involved range from advisory to engineering solution based blast engineering and hostile vehicle mitigation across a range of project lifecycle stages (such as research \& development, feasibility to concept and detailed design).


At Arup, you belong to an extraordinary collective\- in which we encourage individuality to thrive. Our strength comes from how we respect, share and connect our diverse experiences, perspectives and ideas. You will have the opportunity to do socially useful work that has meaning \- to Arup, to your career, to our members, and to the clients and communities we serve.


In this role you will:


* Utilise your knowledge of mainstream structural engineering design practice and develop your understanding of how to model such structures against transient dynamic loading
* Provide technical input across a broad range of projects across the resilience, security and risk practice
* Support the preparation of threat and vulnerability risk assessments for malicious threats (including terrorism, crime and civil disruption)
* Develop coherent, risk\-based security strategies and integrate protective design and/or blast engineering measures from concept through detailed design to construction
* Carry out blast modelling using engineering software including computational fluid dynamic modelling and finite element methods
* Undertake the structural blast engineering design of a wide range of structures in common and novel engineering materials
* Undertake the façade blast engineering design of a wide range of glazed and non\-glazed façade systems
* Undertake the design of Hostile Vehicle Mitigation measures

**Is this role right for you?**


We are seeking talented structural engineers who have a broad knowledge of structural engineering design and an interest in specialising in resilient structural design, to join our team but possibly to be deployed to projects being led from other centres and to further the development of our blast engineering services globally. Arup has one of the most significant protective design teams globally, with teams in London, Manchester, New York, San Francisco, Melbourne and Singapore working together as one global team.


Unlike traditional codified design, blast engineering requires a very different approach to the design but requires a designer’s empathy with regard to aesthetic, form and function of any proposed facility. As such, this is a great opportunity for an existing practitioner to build their professional and tactical position in the industry, or for a talented structural engineer to provide strategic input and undertake first\-principles design as traditional forms of mainstream structural engineering design are increasingly being automated and undertaken by code\-compliant software.


The successful candidate will be able to confidently and articulately communicate concepts of threat, risk and risk mitigation, supported by our threat specialists, will be able to develop and present conceptual ideas, understand the planning, design and construction process in the development of design solutions in a multi\-disciplinary design environment and will be able to manage the detailed analysis, design and specification of structures and façade subject to blast loads. Furthermore, the role will involve the development of Hostile Vehicle Mitigation measures as an essential part of protective design strategies. Experience in blast engineering or a related discipline is desirable but not essential.


You will work closely with design team disciplines both within and outside Arup on a regular basis including architecture, SMEP, façade engineering, transport and logistics, civil and highways engineering, fire engineering and computational structural mechanics. The candidate has an opportunity to gain a breadth of experience from a broad range of projects in a range of geographic locations, including opportunities for travel where desired.


You will undertake the blast engineering design of a variety of projects, and will quickly developing both technical and business\-orientated competencies. Our priority is to attract quality staff who have the ability to work in a collaborative, challenging environment, and who show the potential for technical excellence in their field.


The candidate will be based in the Arup London or Manchester offices and travel out of the UK to meet project requirements will be necessary upon occasion.


You will be a Structural Engineer with a strong background in mainstream structural design. You will be working towards chartership with the Institution of Civil Engineers, the Institution of Structural Engineers or an equivalent professional institution. UK Security Clearance (or equivalent in home country) or eligibility to apply for UK Security Clearance is an essential prerequisite. Eligibility requires a background check and usually requires a minimum period of residency in the UK, but is not limited to UK nationals.

  

We're seeking candidates with:


* Masters degree in civil/structural engineering with a strong track record in mainstream structural engineering design
* UK Security Clearance (or equivalent in home country), or eligibility to apply for UK Security Clearance
* Experience in the design of structures in steel, reinforced concrete, timber and/or masonry in accordance with British Standards and Eurocodes
* Experience in the use of a structural analysis software packages
* Coding skills such as Python, JavaScript, C\#
* Ability of using Rhino/Grasshopper
* An understanding of construction methodologies and consideration of buildability issues within the design process
* Knowledge of relevant legislation, regulations, codes of practice and guidelines.

\*\*\*Unfortunately, we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role. Applicants must have the right to work in the UK at the time of application and for the duration of employment. Any offer made will be subject to satisfactory proof of immigration status.\*\*\*


Not ready to apply just yet, or have a few questions? Contact **Marek Mazurowski** (marek.mazurowski@arup.com). Please note, to ensure we remain GDPR compliant do not send your CV directly to us via this email.

  

**What we offer you**

  

  

At Arup, we care about each member’s success, so we can grow together.  



  

Guided by our values, we provide an attractive total reward package that recognises the contribution of each of our members to our shared success. As well as competitive, fair and equitable pay, we offer a career in which all of our members can belong, grow and thrive – through benefits that support health and wellbeing, a wide range of learning opportunities and many possibilities to have an impact through the work they do.  



  

We are owned in trust on behalf of our members, giving us the freedom, with personal responsibility, to set our own direction and choose work that aligns with our purpose and adds to Arup’s legacy. Our members collaborate on ambitious projects to deliver remarkable outcomes for our clients and communities. Profit Share is a key part of our reward, enabling members to share in the results of our collective efforts.  



  

We also provide Private medical insurance, Life assurance, Accident insurance and Income protection cover. In addition, you’ll have access to flexible benefits to help you look after all aspects of your wellbeing and give you the freedom and flexibility to find the best solutions for you, your family, and your individual needs.  



**Different People, Shared Values**


Arup is an equal opportunity employer that actively promotes and nurtures a diverse and inclusive workforce. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of age (within legal limits), gender identity or expression, marital status, disability, neurotype or mental health, race or ethnicity, faith or belief, sexual orientation, socioeconomic background, and whether you’re pregnant or on family leave. We are an open environment that embraces diverse experiences, perspectives, and ideas – this drives our excellence.


Guided by our values and alignment with the UN Sustainable Development Goals, we create and contribute to equitable spaces and systems, while cultivating a sense of belonging for all. Our internal employee networks support our inclusive culture: from race, ethnicity and cross\-cultural working to gender equity and LGBTQ\+ and disability inclusion – we aim to create a space for you to express yourself and make a positive difference.


Discover more about life at Arup at www.arup.com/careers/your\-life\-at\-arup.


We are committed to making our recruitment process and workplaces accessible to all candidates. Please contact **Marek Mazurowski** (marek.mazurowski@arup.com) to let us know if you need any assistance or reasonable adjustments throughout your application or interview process, and/or to perform the essential functions of the role. We will do everything we can to support you.

  

**Our Application Process**


To understand what to expect next, please visit our https://www.arup.com/careers/arup\-careers\-uk\-application\-process.


Stay safe online \- Arup will never ask for payment or your bank details as part of our recruitment process.


**Recruitment Agencies** \- We have a Preferred Supplier List of trusted partners to assist us when required and do not acknowledge any speculative CVs or unsolicited candidate introductions from agencies not on the list


Closing date: 30th October 2026


*We may close the role earlier than the advertised date should we receive a large number of applications, so please ensure you apply early.*

jobs.title: Power Platform Architect
jobs.description:
**About the job you're considering**
------------------------------------


Our Solution Architects bring a mix of technical skills, industry insight, business acumen and leadership. They shape and define solution architectures for our clients which are used to lead the delivery, define project plans, manage the detailed design, inform technical risk analysis and support estimation.


They work with a client from the earliest stages of a project (potentially in a presales capacity) through to delivery and ‘go live’. And they ensure solutions are secure, can scale and are fit for purpose, using their knowledge of the wider Microsoft technology stack.


We put a lot of time and effort into the Microsoft community; we invest in doing things right and have plenty to say on the subject. We’re active on social media and for those that want to find out more, take a look at our blogs – written by Microsoft enthusiasts, for everyone: https://medium.com/capgemini\-microsoft\-team


You will join a community of over 170 people that deliver some of the biggest and most exciting IT programmes, all built on Microsoft technology across Power Platform, Dynamics 365 and Azure. Join a team that is delivering projects with a positive social impact at the forefront of technology trends with a comprehensive delivery methodology and technical accelerators. You’ll be working with people ranging in experience, from early and emerging talent to specialists. With training and development support all the way through your career and clients across multiple industries (Retail, Utilities, Manufacturing, Transport and Health) you’ll never have a dull moment or find yourself short of challenges!


**Your Role**
-------------


The role is delivery focused, working on a single client project at a time (with the opportunity to support sales and pre\-sales activities if of interest).


* Oversee and shape user needs gathering to ensure technical fit, helping inform the wider architecture of the solution to meet client objectives and goals as well as user needs.
* Own the high level and low\-level solution design of end to end Microsoft Power Platform projects.
* Design solutions with focus on security, accessibility and performance to ensure safety and scalability.
* Design the integration architecture and interfaces required using the full capabilities of the Microsoft technology stack.
* Support estimation, planning and delivery as a technical leader.
* Be a key person interacting with client stakeholders, building relationships and customer trust in the capabilities of Dynamics 365 and the Power Platform and demonstrate the art of the possible that inspires clients and colleagues to deliver the best technical solution possible
**Your Skills and Experience**
------------------------------


We are looking for individuals who can bring the following to our team:


* Energy and excitement about the technologies and capabilities provided by the Power Platform. With knowledge of its capabilities and limitations. As well as a wider understanding of the Microsoft technology stack, including but not limited to Dynamics 365, Azure and SharePoint.
* Knowledge of software engineering best practices as well as Microsoft Dynamics CRM SDK, C\#, Visual Studio and Team Foundation Server.
* Full implementation lifecycle experience of Power Platform based programmes.
* Experience with Continuous Integration (CI) and Continuous Delivery (CD), ideally using Azure DevOps.
* A passion for delivering according to an agile methodology, planning projects and releases in sprints and writing Epics, Features and User Stories.
* You enjoy using your consulting skills:
	+ You form strong and lasting relationships with clients and colleagues.
	+ You have an ability to clearly articulate and present your ideas and solutions in line with the capabilities of Microsoft Dynamics 365 and the Power Platform.
	+ Flexible attitude, critical thinking and the ability to engage with stakeholders at every level – from c\-suite to end user.
	+ You can successfully translate business and customer needs into a great digital customer experience.

jobs.title: Multiphysics Simulations Engineer
jobs.description:
**Looking to race into your next role? Strap in, we're looking for a Multiphysics Simulation Engineer to join our unique mission!**

***About Formula E:***


Formula E, the world's fastest\-growing sport, is redefining motorsport with a bold focus on innovation and sustainability.


Hosting over 150 races in iconic cities globally and backed by top manufacturers like Porsche, Nissan and Jaguar, we feature elite drivers and cutting\-edge EV technology.
  

  

As the world's first certified B Corp sport and the first sport certified to the British Standards Institution (BSI) Net Zero Pathway. Formula E combines thrilling entertainment with a mission to advance sustainable progress, inspiring a global fanbase with our high\-performance brand new GEN4 car capable of hitting speeds of 335kph and reaching 200kph in just 4\.4 seconds. Currently achieving 0\-100 kmh in 1\.8 seconds.


Using the spectacle of sport, we are sending a powerful and meaningful message to help alter perceptions and speed\-up the switch to electric mobility.

***The Role:***


As our Multiphysics Simulation Engineer, you will turn complex physical problems into clear, practical recommendations to support the development of next\-generation all\-electric race cars and trackside technical systems.


Using COMSOL Multiphysics as your principal simulation platform, you will solve coupled electrical, electromagnetic, thermal, fluid, and structural challenges. Beyond component\-level modelling, you will connect subsystem models into comprehensive virtual representations of the car, laying the groundwork for Formula E’s future digital\-twin capabilities. You will collaborate closely with internal technical teams, the FIA, automotive manufacturers, technical partners, and test teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Multiphysics Modeling:** Develop, run, and interpret 3D simulation models in COMSOL Multiphysics across electrical, electromagnetic, thermal, CFD, and structural domains.
* **High\-Voltage \& Powertrain Analysis:** Model and investigate electric machines, battery packs, power electronics, EV charging systems, high\-voltage cabling, busbars, connectors, and sensors.
* **Thermal \& Fluid Dynamics:** Perform thermal and CFD analyses of cooling systems, internal/external airflow, pressure losses, and conjugate heat transfer.
* **Structural Mechanics:** Conduct structural analyses covering stress, deformation, stiffness, vibration, fatigue, and thermal loading.
* **Geometry \& Meshing:** Prepare and simplify CAD geometry and build computational meshes tailored for accurate numerical solving.
* **Test Data Correlation \& Optimisation:** Correlate virtual models with lab, rig, supplier, and track\-test data, running parametric and optimization studies to enhance performance, efficiency, safety, and reliability.
* **System Integration \& Digital Twins:** Connect component models into larger virtual representations of the race car, helping establish validation and configuration practices for digital\-twin development.
* **Technical Communication:** Clearly communicate simulation assumptions, solver settings, limitations, and actionable findings during technical reviews.

***What we're looking for in you:***

* Educational Background: An MEng or MSc in electrical, electronic, mechanical, automotive, aerospace, computational, or mechatronics engineering, applied physics, or a closely related discipline. (Electrical/electronic engineering combined with 3D CAE experience is highly preferred).
* Simulation Experience: At least 3 years of relevant physics\-based simulation experience in industry, applied research, or advanced engineering development. (5\+ years of experience is desirable).
* Technical Domain Expertise: Practical experience in 3D physics\-based modeling across electrical/electromagnetics, thermal management, CFD, or structural mechanics. Experience with EV high\-voltage systems or electric powertrains is a strong advantage.
* Tooling \& Numerical Methods: Solid understanding of numerical methods, boundary conditions, mesh quality, and solver convergence. COMSOL Multiphysics experience is advantageous, though experience with other major professional CAE tools is welcome.
* CAD \& Data Correlation: Experience preparing CAD geometry and correlating simulation models with physical test/telemetry data.
* Mindset \& Approach: Strong engineering judgment with the ability to translate numerical outputs into concrete design recommendations. Excellent written and verbal communication skills to present methods and findings clearly to technical stakeholders.

***What's in it for you?***

* 25 days' annual leave, Birthday day off and Wellbeing leave
* Opportunity to extend your stay if travelling for a race event
* Health Cash Plan and access to the Aviva Digital Workplace app
* Enhanced Parental Leave
* Flexible Bank Holidays
* Paid volunteer and carer's leave
* Cycle to Work and Electric Car Scheme
* Formula E store discount
* Regular social events and employee working groups

*This is a hybrid role and you'll be required to do 3 days a week in our Hammersmith London office*

***Application Process***


Think you’ve got what it takes to join our race to the future?


The closing date for this role is **14th October 2026**, however if we receive a high volume of applications we may close it early.


At Formula E, we are building a culture where every voice matters, every perspective accelerates progress, and every individual is empowered to rise, contribute boldly, and shape a better world \- together. We will provide equal opportunities regardless of an individuals' protected characteristics. We believe in attracting and retaining diverse talent to strengthen our global vision with a variety of experiences, backgrounds and perspectives.

**Our mission is clear. The message is simple. Whoever you are. However you live. Whatever you believe. Formula E. For the Future. For Everyone.**

**We’ll see you at the starting line!**

***¡VAMOS!***


If you require further assistance in accessing the application or require a different format of the application, please contact recruitment@fiaformulae.com


If this role isn’t quite for you but you want to join Formula E, why not ‘Connect’ with us here to be the first to know of new opportunities!

jobs.title: Marine Engineering Technician (Multi-Skilled)
jobs.description:
**Department:** Marine Engineering, Marine Operations  

**Reporting to:** Engineering Workshop Supervisor  

**Grade:** 7  

**Salary:** £47,001 per annum plus 10% Operational Allowance  

**Location:** Denton Wharf, Gravesend  

**Contract:** Full Time, 35 Hours per Week  

**Closing Date:** 16 October 2026

 **Who We Are**


We are the UK's biggest port, central to the country's economy and ambitions for growth. We connect the UK to the world, but we are much more than a conventional port.


We are driven by our purpose to protect and improve the 95\-mile stretch of the tidal River Thames, from Teddington Lock on the border of Surrey, through the heart of London, Kent and Essex, and out to the North Sea.

**The Role**


Working within the Marine Engineering team, the Marine Engineering Technician (Multi\-Skilled) will carry out mechanical and electrical maintenance, fault finding, repairs and refits across the PLA's fleet of workboats (up to 36m), together with associated shore facilities and piers.


This is a genuinely multi\-skilled role requiring the successful candidate to work across both mechanical and electrical disciplines. Responsibilities will include the maintenance, diagnosis and repair of diesel engines, propulsion systems, hydraulic systems, fuel systems, cooling systems, electrical distribution systems and vessel control systems.


In addition to day\-to\-day maintenance activities, the role will support planned and reactive maintenance programmes, vessel refits and installation projects. The postholder may be required to supervise contractors and technical staff and provide relief cover as Ship's Engineer aboard the Authority's Salvage Craft.


The successful candidate will also contribute to the development of apprentices and trainee engineers by sharing knowledge and supporting continuous improvement within the team.


Although based on a 35\-hour working week, the role will require occasional out\-of\-hours attendance and participation in call\-out arrangements to support operational and emergency requirements.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Carry out planned and reactive mechanical and electrical maintenance on PLA vessels and shore facilities.
* Diagnose and repair faults across a wide range of marine engineering systems.
* Maintain diesel engines, propulsion systems, hydraulic systems, fuel systems and cooling systems.
* Undertake electrical installations, repairs and fault finding on vessel distribution and control systems.
* Support vessel refits, equipment upgrades and installation projects.
* Assist with supervision of contractors and technical personnel when required.
* Provide relief cover as Ship's Engineer on the PLA Salvage Craft.
* Support apprentices and trainee engineers through mentoring and knowledge sharing.
* Maintain high standards of safety, housekeeping and compliance.
* Participate in emergency response and call\-out activities as required.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Completion of an Advanced Apprenticeship leading to an HNC, NVQ Level 3 or equivalent qualification in a relevant Mechanical or Electrical Engineering discipline.
* Demonstrable practical and theoretical experience in both mechanical and electrical maintenance, fault diagnosis and repair.
* Experience working on diesel engines and associated vessel mechanical systems, including fuel, cooling and propulsion systems.
* Experience working with vessel and industrial electrical distribution and control systems, including 12V/24V DC and 230V AC systems.
* Good understanding of fault finding and installation on electrical and electronic communication networks.
* Experience supporting vessel refits, planned maintenance and equipment installation projects.
* Competent IT skills, including the use of Computerised Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS).
* Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with colleagues, contractors and suppliers.
* Good understanding of marine safety and maintenance regulations, including:
* PUWER
* COSHH
* Relevant HSE and MCA requirements


We welcome applications from candidates with transferable skills and experience from marine, industrial, military, HGV, plant, agricultural or similar engineering environments.

**Desirable Experience**

* Diesel engine electronic control systems.
* Marine navigation equipment installation and fault finding.
* Welding and fabrication.
* Machining experience, including manual lathes and milling machines.

**In Addition, You Will**

* Hold a full UK manual driving licence.
* Be comfortable working afloat and climbing ladders.
* Be capable of working in confined spaces such as engine rooms and tank spaces.
* Be physically capable of carrying out manual handling and lifting activities.
* Be willing to undertake training and continuous professional development.
* Support the PLA's ambition to achieve Net Zero by 2040\.
* Be medically fit to obtain an ENG1 Medical Certificate or already hold an ML5 Certificate.

**In Return, We Offer a Competitive Benefits Package**

* 28 days annual leave (plus Bank Holidays)
* Medical Cash Plan (Westfield Health)
* Generous pension scheme
* Onsite parking with electric vehicle charging
* Access to Occupational Health, Mindfulness, Counselling and Physiotherapy services
* Cycle to Work Scheme
* Car Leasing Scheme (Tusker Cars)
* Access to MyGymDiscounts


To view the full job description click here

**Inclusion Statement**


The PLA are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace and welcome applications from all backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. Candidates will be assessed against the essential requirements for the role. Where candidates can demonstrate relevant transferable skills and experience, we encourage them to apply.

**The PLA are not registered with the UK Home Office and do not sponsor candidates who require a visa or work permit to work in the UK, therefore an offer of employment cannot be made unless you currently hold the rights to live and work in the UK.**

jobs.title: Technical Solutions Architect
jobs.description:
**Job title** : Technical Solutions Architect
  

**Location** : London, UK
  

**Job reference \#** : 33988
  

**Contract type** : Permanent
  

**Language requirements** : Fluent level of English


At **Eni** , we are looking for a **Technical Solutions Architect** within **Eni Trade \& Biofuels** (ETB) in **London** . You will be responsible for providing technical oversight of the local IT infrastructure and technology landscape, coordinating with Group IT teams and external providers, and supporting the delivery and evolution of effective technology solutions.


**About ETB**

ETB is the trading and shipping company of Eni, covering crude oil, refined oil products and biofuels as well as gas, power, LNG and emissions. We are a diverse and dynamic team of around 300 professionals distributed in four offices (London, Rome, Brussels and Singapore) with the addition in Houston of Eni Trading \& Shipping Inc. (ETS Inc) which handles marketing of oils and petroleum products for the US market. Our team is also involved in marketing Eni’s oil equity productions, sourcing hydrocarbons and bio feedstocks, and managing the output of our traditional and green refineries.


ETB is at the cutting edge of sustainability and innovation in the global energy market. As a dynamic force within the Eni group, which is a leader in the energy transition, at ETB we are rapidly establishing ourselves as a key player in the new energy landscape, with a sharp focus on biofuels trading. Our work with bio feedstock and bioproducts is central to our mission of shaping a sustainable future. When you join ETB, you become part of Eni – a leading global energy company with over 32,000 employees in 61 countries. Eni is at the forefront of the energy industry, specializing in exploration, production, transport, and marketing of oil, natural gas and biofuels.


**Main responsibilities**

The D\&IT Business Analyst will play a pivotal role in delivering and transforming the best possible systems for the trading and risk portfolio, partnering with wider D\&IT teams and external parties to contribute to:


* Maintain a broad understanding of the local technology landscape, including infrastructure, network, applications, cloud services, integrations, data flows and key external dependencies.
* Act as a key technical interface with Group IT teams, ensuring local technology needs and initiatives are aligned with Group architecture, cybersecurity standards and strategic direction.
* Contribute to the evolution and modernisation of the local technology landscape, identifying opportunities for simplification, automation, cloud adoption and improved integration.
* Translate business and operational needs into practical technical requirements and contribute to the assessment, design and implementation of appropriate technology solutions.
* Support the evaluation and adoption of new applications, cloud services, AI\-enabled solutions and other emerging technologies, considering technical feasibility, integration, security and operational impact.
* Support technology lifecycle activities, including upgrades, migrations, rationalisation and decommissioning, with a focus on reducing legacy complexity and enabling future capabilities.
* Coordinate technical activities with internal stakeholders and external technology providers, ensuring effective delivery, clear ownership and appropriate technical governance.
* Support incident and problem resolution where cross\-technology analysis is required, helping identify root causes, dependencies and longer\-term improvement opportunities.
* Maintain appropriate technical documentation, including architecture diagrams, solution documentation, inventories and technology roadmaps.

**Skills and experience required**

* A university degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering or related technical discipline.
* Prior experience in a role related to infrastructure, technical architecture, solution architecture or similar area.
* Experience working in complex IT environments and coordinating activities with central IT teams and external technology providers.
* Strong understanding of enterprise infrastructure, networking, cloud technologies, applications and system integrations.
  

Experience supporting technology implementations, infrastructure changes, upgrades, migrations and decommissioning activities.
* Familiarity with Microsoft enterprise technologies, including Microsoft 365 and Azure.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to understand technical dependencies across different technology areas.
* Strong communication and stakeholder\-management skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to combine a broad technical understanding with a pragmatic and hands\-on approach to IT operations and solution delivery.
* Fluent level of English.

**Why ETB?**

* **Impactful Work** : Join a team that plays a crucial role in Eni’s Net Zero 2050 strategy, benefiting from Eni’s strong trading position and global integration.
* **Collaborative Culture** : Experience a truly multicultural, supportive, and dynamic work environment.
* **Career Growth** : Rapid learning opportunities with potential for movement across teams and international roles.
* **Work\-Life Balance** : Enjoy a balanced lifestyle with a comprehensive benefits package that may include health, well\-being, and flexible working options.

**How to apply**

* Applications are only accepted through our online application system.
* Please upload your CV in English.

**About Eni**

Eni is a global energy company operating in 61 Countries, with over 30,000 employees. Originally an oil \& gas company, it has evolved into an integrated energy company, playing a key role in ensuring energy security and leading the energy transition. Eni's goal is to achieve carbon neutrality by 2050 through the decarbonization of its processes and of the products it sells to its customers. In line with this goal, Eni invests in the research and development of technologies that can accelerate the transition to increasingly sustainable energy. Renewable energy sources, bio\-refining, carbon capture and storage are only some examples of Eni's areas of activity and research. In addition, the company is exploring game\-changing technologies such as fusion energy – a technology based on the physical processes that power stars and that could generate safe, virtually limitless energy with zero emissions.


**Working at Eni**

At Eni we believe in enterprising people, capable of making a difference and making their contribution with passion and innovation, to respond to the global challenges of the energy transition. For us, the skills and attitudes of each individual, continuous training, and diversity and inclusion are fundamental. We promote flexible ways of working with particular attention to well\-being, welfare and work life\-balance. Eni will evaluate applications considering plurality and diversity as sources of enrichment. If your application is assessed to be among those most in line with the required profile, you will be contacted to continue the selection process. Whatever your ambition, at Eni you can find the tools to make it happen.

FTSE Russell, a leader in global indexing and analytics, is seeking a skilled and motivated **Software Engineer** and build robust, scalable applications that support trillions in assets. As the Software Engineer, you will be involved developing and supporting delivery of various engineering and automation initiatives.

  

  

You will be responsible for delivering high\-quality software on time, and fostering a culture of innovation and continuous improvement.

  

  

**WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING:**

As a Senior Engineer, you’ll **build with purpose** — solving real\-world problems with measurable impact.


* Design, build, and scale next\-gen index platforms used by global financial institutions.
