* Communicate with clarity, precision, and influence, presenting complex information in a clear and concise format that is appropriate for the audience
* Drive a culture of engineering excellence and promote standard methodologies in software design and development
  

  

**Tech Stack You’ll Work On**

  

* **Backend:** C\# .NET, tSQL, RESTful APIs, microservices
* **Frontend:** Angular, JavaScript, HTML5/CSS
* **Cloud:** AWS (EC2, Lambda, Glue, EKS, SQS, SNS)
* **Databases:** SQL Server, Sybase, PostgreSQL
* **Testing:** MSTest, tSQLt, BDD tools (Cucumber, Mocha)
* **CI/CD:** GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Terraform
  

  

**Experience we value:**

* Solid experience in UI development for business\-critical applications in Angular (8 and above), Java Script, HTML/CSS, C\#
* Exposure to AWS services
  

  

**Personal traits you should have:**

* Excellent attention to detail and an ability to think laterally to solve business problems.
* Ability to hit the ground running, learn quickly and work against tight deadlines.
* Creative, results driven, self\-motivated, and solutions oriented.
* Demonstrates a can\-do attitude, exhibits self\-confidence and has excellent interpersonal and time management skills
* Able to establish credibility quickly.
  

  

**WHAT YOU'LL BRING:**

  

Our engineers operate with a clear **"why"** — staying aligned to strategic outcomes while putting the customer at the centre of every decision.

  

  

You’ll thrive here if you:


* **Build with Purpose** : You understand the *why* behind every line of code and optimize for meaningful outcomes.
* **Customer Driven** : You translate complex requirements into elegant solutions that delight users.
* **Technically Courageous** : You step out of your comfort zone, challenge the status quo, and innovate with confidence.
* **Learn and be curious** : You seek feedback, explore new technologies, and stay curious.
* **Grow and Uplift Others** : You coach, mentor, and celebrate team wins.

* **Dive Deep** : You stay close to the details and act decisively when something’s off.
* **Build responsibly, deliver incrementally** : You embrace agile principles, delivering incrementally and improving through feedback.

Senior Associate

Interviews expected to take place w/c 2nd November

  


**Disclaimer:** While the closing date is set as mentioned, we reserve the right to close the application process earlier if necessary, depending on the unique circumstances of each role.

  


**At Cadent, we’re thrilled to be part of the future of UK energy!**

  



We have a clear roadmap to drive our performance to the forefront of our industry and support the UK government in achieving its net zero targets by 2050\.

  



We’re making a difference through innovation and new ways of working. Together, we’re shaping a cleaner, greener future for our 11 million customers, whom we put at the heart of everything we do.

  


**What’s In It for You**

  



Here at Cadent, we recognise that our people are truly unsung heroes. Quietly confident, delivering every day \- that’s why we’re committed to supporting our people to get the best out of themselves. For this role, we offer:

  


* **Annual bonus**
* **Pension Scheme double matched up to a total of 18% of salary**
* **25 days holiday, plus statutory days, and an option to buy more**
* **An extra day off each year to celebrate life’s special moments**
* **Career development with funded learning options**
* **Flexible working and strong ED\&I commitments**
* **Generous family policies and flexible benefits**
* **Retail discounts, gym access, and more**

**Diversity and Inclusion**

  



Don’t meet every requirement? No problem! If you’re excited about this opportunity but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification mentioned, we would still love for you to submit your application – you may just be the right person for this role or other opportunities at Cadent.



We value diversity and are committed to being an equitable employer. Our employee communities – Women in Cadent, Pride at Work (LGBTQ\+), Embrace (ethnicity and religion), Thrive! (disability), the Cadent Military Community, the Grief Awareness Community, and the Men's Engagement Network (M.E.N) – can’t wait to welcome you!

jobs.title: Contract Senior Typescript Engineer (Node.js, AWS Serverless)
jobs.description:
**Senior TypeScript Engineer (Node.js, AWS Serverless), FinTech**  



**Location:** London, Manchester, Leeds, Edinburgh or Bristol (flexible hybrid)
  

  

**Rate:** £600 per day. Inside IR35  

  

**Duration:** 6 months

 **About Codurance**


We're a software craftsmanship consultancy. We build software for clients, and we care about doing it properly: clean code, solid testing, sensible architecture, and teams that keep learning. Our engineers work embedded with client teams, so you get variety, real ownership, and the backing of a wider community of craftspeople who'll challenge you and help you grow.

 **The role**


We're looking for a senior contract engineer to work on a financial platform where correctness actually matters. You'll design, build, and run TypeScript and Node.js services on AWS serverless infrastructure. You'll work in a small, cross\-functional team alongside product, operations, and customer\-facing colleagues, and you'll be the person people go to when they're stuck. This is a build\-and\-run environment: if you build it, you own it in production.

 **What you'll do day to day**

* Design, build, and operate services within your domain, from architecture through to delivery
* Take accountability for the SLAs of what you ship, and keep improving it
* Write and maintain useful documentation for your services
* Mentor and guide other engineers
* Explain how the system works to non\-technical colleagues, without making them feel daft for asking
* Judge when "good enough for now" is the right call, and when it isn't
* Work openly with product and operations, and challenge ideas constructively

 **Requirements**  

Core skills:

* Strong commercial experience with Node.js and TypeScript
* Hands\-on AWS experience, including serverless (Lambda, SQS, EventBridge, API Gateway, S3, ECS)
* Strong experience with event\-driven architecture
* Experience with document databases, ideally MongoDB
* A track record of leading technical delivery in a build\-and\-run model
* Experience mentoring other engineers
* Experience with incident management
* Experience in a regulated industry, ideally financial services or FinTech

  

Also important:

* Solid experience designing, building, and running high\-quality workflow APIs, with a focus on testing, observability, and performance
* Comfort working with distributed systems and debugging through tracing and observability tooling
* Experience in a strongly, statically typed language
* The ability to turn business and customer problems into efficient, scalable solutions
* Curiosity about how investment and custody products work

  

Nice to have:

* Experience with multi\-region, multi\-currency or trading\-related systems
* Terraform, Serverless Framework and GitHub Actions
* Some exposure to C\#

 **How we work**


We care about engineering quality, pragmatic architecture, and continuous improvement. You'll have autonomy, and with it, full accountability. We'd rather you tell us something is wrong than nod along.

 **Benefits** *Everyone should have the right to bring their whole self to work and be celebrated for who they are. Our people are hired purely on their commitment to these values and their ambition to deliver outstanding results for our clients. Codurance is proud to be an Equal Opportunities Employer and is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace.*

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Asset Sales
jobs.description:
**Join our expanding engineering team!**


We're hiring a permanent Senior Backend Engineer to join our Asset Sales group as we scale one of the most important parts of M\-KOPA's FinTech platform. Build distributed, event\-driven microservices and help shape what AI\-native engineering looks like at M\-KOPA.

**The Impact**

Your code will directly power the systems that put smartphones and e\-motorbikes into the hands of Every Day Earners across Africa. We've already helped over 10 million customers access more than $2 billion in credit. It's your chance to be part of something that's literally transforming lives across an entire continent


**The Opportunity**


**Mission\-driven engineering**: Every service you build helps expand financial inclusion for under\-banked populations


**Global recognition**: Join a company named by the Financial Times as one of Africa's fastest\-growing companies for five consecutive years (2022–2026\)


**Scale challenges**: Build backend systems serving millions across multiple African markets


**AI\-native from day one**: We're actively embracing AI as part of the engineering craft, not bolting it on


**Fully distributed**: Work remotely with diverse teams across UK, Europe, and Africa

**What You'll Do**


At M\-KOPA, you'll build and operate distributed C\# and .NET microservices on Azure, working within an event\-driven architecture at significant scale. This is an outcomes\-driven role: we care far more about the value you create than where you sit or how many hours you're online. You'll own what you build end\-to\-end — from idea, through implementation and deployment, into production and iteration.

**Technical Environment**

* **Modern C\# stack**: Distributed C\# and .NET microservices
* **Cloud \& orchestration**: Hosted on Azure using Kubernetes
* **Architecture**: Event\-driven, supporting products used at significant scale
* **Observability**: Grafana, Azure Application Insights, logs, traces, and metrics
* **AI tooling**: Claude and other AI tools used throughout the engineering workflow — design exploration, code generation and review, test writing, incident investigation, and technical communication

**Our Engineering Approach**

* **AI\-native engineering**: We want engineers who tinker — experimenting with new tools, agents, and workflows, and sharing what works
* **Guardrails as we accelerate**: Automated tests, SLOs, alerting, observability, and deployment safeguards around everything we ship
* **Own it beyond the pull request**: Design for idempotency, retries, out\-of\-order events, and failure modes, and know how your services behave in production
* **The Campfire Rule**: Leave the systems you touch a little better than you found them
* **On\-call as feedback, not heroics**: Engineers who build our systems also help operate them, using incidents to make the platform more resilient

**What You Need**


We're looking for a senior engineer who's curious, autonomous, and highly trusted. You're comfortable owning the entire software stack — including supporting infrastructure — throughout its lifecycle, and you see production data, not just deployment, as the real measure of "done."

**Required Experience:**

* Strong grasp of C\# and .NET development
* Experience with event\-driven systems \- We use Azure Service Bus, but would love to hear from you if you have experience with similar messaging technology (Kafka, RabbitMQ, etc.)
* Microservices architecture experience, ideally on Azure and Kubernetes
* Experience using observability tooling (e.g. Grafana, Application Insights) to understand production behaviour
* Comfort using AI tools as part of a daily engineering workflow (design, code review, testing, incident investigation)
* DevOps culture mindset, including on\-call/production ownership
* Proven ability to collaborate effectively in distributed teams across time zones
* Continuous learning mindset and openness to feedback

**Location \& Benefits**

* Fully remote role, collaborating during core GMT working hours
* Work with diverse teams distributed across UK, Europe, and Africa
* Personalised training budget to support your development
* Home office setup budget
* Professional development programs and coaching partnerships
* Family\-friendly policies and flexible working arrangements
* Well\-being support and career growth opportunities

**Our Mission**

We create financial inclusion for the traditionally excluded through a fair, flexible, customer\-centric financing model. We strive to drive greater inclusion of women, youth, and low\-income communities.

**Our Impact**

Our technology has created measurable change:

* **Connected** : 2\.5 million first\-time smartphone users connected
* **Prosperous** : 70% of customers use M\-KOPA products for income generation, with 35,000 livelihoods created for agents
* **Green** : 2\.155 million tonnes of CO₂ avoided since 2010 through clean energy, refurbished devices, and e\-mobility

**Ready to build C\#/.NET systems — with AI as part of your craft — that create real\-world financial inclusion? Apply Now!**

**Why M\-KOPA?**
----------------


At M\-KOPA, we empower our people to own their careers through diverse development programs, coaching partnerships, and on\-the\-job training. We support individual journeys with family\-friendly policies, prioritize well\-being, and embrace flexibility.


Join us in shaping the future of M\-KOPA as we grow together. Explore more at **m\-kopa.com**.

*Recognized four times by the Financial Times as one Africa's fastest growing companies (2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026\), named on CNBC's World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025 \& 2026 and by TIME100 Most influential companies in the world 2023 and 2024 , we've served over 10 million customers, unlocking $2 billion in cumulative credit for the everyday earners across Africa, in addition to over 10,000 e\-bikes financed in Kenya.*

***Important Notice***  

  

*M\-KOPA is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer committed to assembling a diverse, broadly trained staff. Women, minorities, and people with disabilities are strongly encouraged to apply.*

*M\-KOPA explicitly prohibits the use of Forced or Child Labour and respects the rights of its employees to agree to terms and conditions of employment voluntarily, without coercion, and freely terminate their employment on appropriate notice. M\-KOPA shall ensure that its Employees are of legal working age and shall comply with local laws for youth employment or student work, such as internships or apprenticeships.*

*M\-KOPA does not collect/charge any money as a pre\-employment or post\-employment requirement. This means that we never ask for ‘recruitment fees’, ‘processing fees’, ‘interview fees’, or any other kind of money in exchange for offer letters or interviews at any time during the hiring process.*

*Applications for this position will be reviewed on a rolling basis. Shortlisting and interviews will take place at any stage during the recruitment process. We reserve the right to close the vacancy early if a suitable candidate is selected before the advertised closing date.*

*If your application is successful M\-KOPA undertakes pre\-employment background checks as part of its recruitment process, these include; criminal records, identification verification, academic qualifications, employment dates and employer references.*

jobs.company: King's College Hospital NHS Foundation Trust
jobs.title: Medical Engineering Technician
jobs.description:
The post holder will work as part of a diverse and multidisciplinary Medical Equipment Management Service team to ensure the safe use of medical devices across the Trust. The post holder will carry out acceptance testing, servicing and repair of complex medical equipment and devices. They will take part in workshop rotas and timetables and maintain records of all completed work timely and accurately on the comprehensive equipment management information technology system. Where necessary the post holder will undertake training to develop, upskill and fulfil the evolving needs of the role.
  
  

Technical
  
  

Following standard operating procedures, carry out the following on complex electrical and mechanical
  
  

**Medical equipment:**  

Formal acceptance tests
  
Performance tests
  
Planned Preventative Maintenance
  
Servicing / Routine maintenance
  
  

Under the supervision of senior technicians, analyse and diagnose faults in complex electrical and mechanical medical equipment and calibrate and operate test equipment correctly.
  
  

Carry out electrical safety testing of equipment.
  
  

The Trust provides a full range of local and specialist services across its five sites. In June 2026, we launched our new strategy for 2026\-31\. Our vision is to transform healthcare, and we have agreed six strategic ambitions to help us improve care for patients, and the working lives of our staff.
  
  

Our six strategic ambitions are delivering high\-quality patient care ; creating a great place to work ; leading pioneering research, innovation and education ; building strong and successful partnerships ; providing timely and efficient care ; and ensuring long\-term financial sustainability .
  
  

We have also agreed four new organisational values – Caring, Collaborative, Inclusive, Innovative – and these underpin everything we do, and how our teams interact with the patients under our care.
  
  

We are at a pivotal point in our history and we require individuals who are ready to join a highly professional team and make a real, lasting difference to our patients and our people.
  
  

King’s is committed to delivering Sustainable Healthcare for All via our Green Plan. In line with national Greener NHS ambitions, we have set net zero carbon targets of 2040 for our NHS Carbon Footprint and 2045 for our NHS Carbon Footprint Plus. Everyone’s contribution is required in order to meet the goals set out in our Green Plan and we encourage all staff to work responsibly, minimising their contributions to the Trust’s carbon emissions, waste and pollution wherever possible.
  
  

Communication
  
  

Provide technical information and feedback to clinical users on the service and repair of equipment.
  
Communicate with equipment suppliers and manufacturers regarding maintenance and repair of medical equipment.
  
Collaborate with other technical staff in the maintenance of medical equipment.
  
  

Clinical
  
  

Attend clinical areas to carry out routine maintenance of medical equipment, either alone or with colleagues
  
  

Quality Control
  
  

Adhere to the processes and procedures as described in the quality manual.
  
Comment on proposed changes to departmental policies and procedures.
  
  

Records
  
  

Accurately and clearly record work done on the medical equipment management database.
  
Check that information provided on equipment is correct, that procedures for adding and updating information is followed and any anomalies are reported to the team leader.
  
  

Time Management
  
  

Plans own workload and prioritises breakdown requests allocated to self.
  
Organises routine maintenance duties allocated to self.
  
  

Physical
  
  

Assist with the movement and transport of equipment and packages, of up to 20kgs, to and from clinical areas, and between MEMS sites.
  
Carry out repetitive equipment testing which may require working in awkward positions where testing carried out on\-site.

**Title: QA Automation Engineer**

**Salary: £39,000 \- £46,000**

**Location: Bristol, Future Space, UWE**

**Contract: Permanent, 37\.5 Hours Per week**

**At Everything Financial, the success of our business depends on the quality of the products we create.**

As a Quality Assurance Automation Engineer, you’ll be a vital first line of assurance, helping us make sure the things we build do what our stakeholders need them to do and that our products perform brilliantly every time.

You’ll combine hands\-on automation expertise with strong problem\-solving skills, taking ownership of testing across the delivery lifecycle and working closely with stakeholders and technical teams to continuously improve the quality of our products.

**A day in the life of a QA Automation Engineer will involve:**

* Developing and maintaining automated test suites for UI and API applications, helping ensure functionality, reliability and quality across releases.
* Planning, estimating, prioritising and coordinating testing activities, alongside creating comprehensive test strategies, test plans and well\-structured test cases.
* Developing and continuously improving our automation tools, frameworks and architecture, including CI/CD and DevOps, to make testing increasingly effective and efficient.
* Delivering functional testing across UI, APIs and databases, generating accurate test data that covers diverse scenarios, including edge cases and negative paths.
* Carrying out regression, cross\-browser and non\-functional testing, including load, performance, security, OAT and post\-deployment monitoring.
* Identifying, documenting and tracking bugs, keeping stakeholders informed of their impact, conducting root\-cause analysis and recommending workable solutions.
* Producing clear QA documentation, processes, requirements, specifications and technical design documents, while keeping test cases centrally maintained within Testmo.
* Working collaboratively with technical teams and stakeholders, providing technical guidance and contributing to post\-live assessments and continuous improvement.

**To be a successful QA Automation Engineer, you’ll need**

* Strong knowledge of software development, software testing and new product development principles and processes, with the ability to plan testing for complex systems.
* Strong knowledge of testing frameworks and techniques, including BDD, TDD and the Page Object Model.
* Strong knowledge of programming languages and formats such as C\#, JavaScript, TypeScript and JSON, alongside open\-source tools and platforms including Playwright, Git and Node.js.
* Solid understanding of backend testing, including REST or SOAP APIs, Postman and SQL database testing.
* Working knowledge of CI/CD, cloud platforms and DevOps, together with non\-functional testing approaches and tools such as JMeter, LoadRunner, penetration testing, security testing, OAT and UAT.
* Experience using tools to automate the testing of email and SMS journeys, including verifying delivery, content and timing within a test automation framework.
* Strong problem\-solving, analytical and decision\-making skills, with excellent attention to detail and the ability to manage competing priorities and delivery commitments.
* Strong communication and stakeholder\-management skills, with the ability to translate technical testing findings into practical improvements for business and consumer outcomes.

**In return for your skills and expertise, you'll get:**

* A salary between £39k and £46k, dependent on experience
* 30 days annual leave, plus bank holidays
* Access to our profit Related Pay bonus scheme
* An allowance towards the cost of your wifi for working from home, and gym membership.
* A pension through Nest

*At Everything Financial, we pride ourselves on our diverse workforce, and ensuring we have an inclusive environment for all our team members. We remain committed to ensuring our teams can bring their true selves to work without risk or fear of discrimination.*

Pay: £39,000\.00\-£46,000\.00 per year

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Bristol BS34 8RB

jobs.description:
**Job Description**
===================

**Process Design \& Development Engineer – MPD Process Development**

**Wotton under Edge**

**up to £40,000 depending on experience**

 **The purpose of the role**

  

Renishaw's Machine Tool Products Division (MPD) is looking for a Process Design \& Development Engineer to join the Process Software Team. This is a multidisciplinary engineering role focused on the development of automated assembly and test systems used throughout the product lifecycle, from early concept evaluation through to full production. Working within a focused and collaborative team, you will design, develop, validate and implement innovative test rigs, manufacturing processes and automation solutions, combining mechanical, electrical and software engineering disciplines to deliver robust and capable systems.

 **Responsibilities**

* Design and develop automated assembly and test systems for new and existing products.
* Work closely with product development teams from concept through to production to define process and test requirements.
* Design, prototype and validate test equipment, tooling, fixtures and manufacturing processes.
* Develop software solutions using technologies such as C\#, LabVIEW, PLC and SQL to control, monitor and analyse automated systems.
* Integrate sensors, instrumentation, motion control and data acquisition technologies into complex test environments.
* Analyse test and process data to validate performance, capability and measurement system effectiveness.
* Produce clear documentation including requirements specifications, design documentation, validation reports and handover information.
* Work with manufacturing, NPI, project teams and specialist engineering groups to ensure solutions are safe, robust, efficient and manufacturable.
* Investigate production and yield issues, identifying improvements to both products and processes.
* Support continuous improvement activities across assembly, test and manufacturing operations.
* Manage or support the sourcing, procurement and implementation of equipment and tooling required for new processes.

 **Key Requirements**

* Degree, HNC/HND or equivalent experience in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, Automation Engineering, Mechatronics, Software Engineering or a related discipline.
* Experience with software development (e.g. C\#, LabVIEW, PLC) for the design or support of automated test systems, manufacturing equipment, and production processes.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to analyse data and apply engineering judgement to drive decisions and improvements.
* Experience working within a structured engineering environment, including design reviews, validation activities and documentation.
* Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a multidisciplinary team.
* Desire to be hands on outside of the core day\-to\-day functions, debugging rig issues or satisfying customer orders where necessary (bespoke rig builds).

  



**Desirable Requirements**

* Understanding of precision assembly or manufacturing processes.
* Knowledge of statistical process control, Gauge R\&R, MSA, CpK and process capability analysis.
* Experience with CAD packages such as Siemens NX or equivalent.
* Understanding of electrical design, control systems or industrial communications.
* Familiarity with Azure DevOps or similar project management and software version control tools.
* Experience developing production test equipment or manufacturing automation solutions.
* Knowledge of DfM, DfA, Process FMEA or Six Sigma methodologies.

 **Person Specification**

  

The successful applicant will be a curious and proactive engineer who enjoys solving complex technical challenges. They will be comfortable working across multiple engineering disciplines and keen to develop new skills outside their primary area of expertise.


They will demonstrate:

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Clear communication skills with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Ownership and accountability for delivering high\-quality engineering solutions.
* Attention to detail and a methodical approach to engineering activities.
* A willingness to learn and collaborate with specialists from different disciplines.
* The ability to balance practical hands\-on work with engineering rigour and documentation.

 **Opportunities for Career Development and Training**

  

We are committed to supporting engineers in developing broad, multidisciplinary skill sets. The successful candidate will have opportunities to gain experience across software, electronics, mechanical design and systems engineering while contributing to real\-world automation and manufacturing challenges.

  

Training and development opportunities include:

* C\# and software development training.
* NI training and development programmes for LabVIEW.
* Siemens NX and mechanical design training.
* Mentoring and technical reviews from experienced software, electronics and mechanical engineers.
* Training in process validation, measurement systems analysis and manufacturing statistics.
* Exposure to full product lifecycle development, from concept through to production deployment.
* Internal professional development courses including presentation skills, report writing, project management and leadership.
* Opportunities to pursue additional technical or professional training aligned with business and personal development goals.

 **Benefits**

  

When you join Renishaw, we're committing to your future career. That's because we believe in developing our people's skills and promoting them internally. We also offer a benefits package that's highly desirable; including a 9% non\-contributory pension, discretionary annual bonus, \*subsidised onsite restaurants and \*coffee shops, free parking, \*car sharing scheme and \*24 hour fitness centres. ( not available at all sites).

  

We also want to promote a healthy work\-life balance as much as possible, so we have introduced a hybrid working policy which allows for a combination of home and office based working depending on the nature of your role. We also offer a variable working programme, 25 days holiday plus bank holidays, Life Assurance policy of 12 times annual salary, Cycle to Work scheme, enhanced maternity pay subject to qualifying criteria, Health Cash Plan, the option to join Renishaw Health Trust (Aviva) and an Employee Assistance Programme for employees and family.

  

Please click here for further information about our benefits.

  

At Renishaw we believe that our success is powered by welcoming a workforce of diverse and talented people. Through encouraging an inclusive culture, where all our employees are free to be themselves, we can achieve our core values: Innovation, Inspiration, Integrity, and Involvement.  

  

If you are excited about the role but feel as though you don’t meet all the requirements, we would encourage you still to apply. You might just be the right person for this role or another opportunity at Renishaw.  

  

We are committed to providing reasonable adjustments to make interviews and jobs more accessible. Should you have any difficulty during the recruitment process, or require any reasonable adjustments please contact the recruitment team on 01453 490384 or recruitment@renishaw.com.

* Analytical \& problem\-solving skills for solving complex software bugs and feature requests.
* Microsoft Azure including DevOps, APIs, Web Apps or equivalent.
* High knowledge of SQL, C\# and JavaScript (Typescript), JSON, XML, and PowerShell.
* Knowledge of Java, Python and VBA is desirable.
* Data analysis \& interpretation.
* Understands best practise design patterns in areas such as security, access control, and code maintainability.
* Web and integration technologies like RESTful and SOAP.
* Familiar with Agile and Waterfall development methodologies.
* Ability to learn new languages and technologies.
* IFS technical, PL/SQL within Oracle Databases, SQL Server is desirable.

**Qualifications**

* Educated to degree level or equivalent with at least 3 years work experience in a software developer type role.
* Demonstrable portfolio of commercial software development projects or publicly available Git or SVN repositories.
* Microsoft Certification in Azure Developer, Fundamentals and DevOps engineer is highly desirable.

jobs.title: Heat pump engineer/plumber
jobs.description:
Are you looking for the next step in your career and want to make a positive impact on the climate? Installio is on the hunt for an enthusiastic individual to join us as a Heat Pump Engineer, joining our experienced team ready to help tackle the UK’s net\-zero transition.


Installio is building the platform powering the next generation of clean energy installations across the UK.


Working with leading energy brands including **E.ON Next, Good Energy, Aira and So Energy**, we deliver heat pumps, solar and home electrification to homes across the country.

**Tasks**
---------


Working directly in customers’ homes, you will be an intrinsic member of our heat pump team, tackling reactive maintenance and call outs, and conducting annual services. Prior experience with heat pumps is a must and you already have the skills needed to fault find and support our installation engineers.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Support our heat pump team solve remedials and call outs
* Conduct annual services for heat pumps
* Support install teams where necessary (Fault finding, commissioning, etc)
* Ensure customer satisfaction through high\-quality service

**Your profile**
----------------

**Required**:

* NVQ level 2 or 3 in Plumbing
* G3 Unvented
* WRAS Water Regulations
* Experience fitting heat pumps
* Experience installing pipework (solder \& press) for unvented cylinders and radiators
* Experience decommissioning heating systems
* Valid driver's license with 6 points or less

**Desirable but not necessary**:

* Gas safe
* Level 3 heat pump qualifications

**Benefits**
------------

* Competitive salary of £42,000\+ OTE
* Pension plan
* Company vehicle and top\-of\-the\-range Milwaukee tools
* Modern and inspiring work environment
* 28 days of holidays per annum (incl. national holidays)
* Uniform and all PPE


Apply Today and Grow with Installio!

jobs.description:
Location
London, United Kingdom
Category
Engineering
Date Published
30/09/26
Status
Open
**About the job:**


Kent is looking for a Graduate Naval Architect Engineer to be based in London.


Are you looking for an opportunity to make a difference and engineer solutions that make not only the UK’s energy security stronger but actively impact the way in which the world drives towards a net zero future?


Our Naval Architecture teams across the UK operate globally in both the Offshore Wind and Oil \& Gas markets working towards reducing carbon emissions. As a graduate in one of our locations, you will be contributing to a variety of technically challenging and exciting projects, from designing new offshore wind farms, substations and floating concept designs, to supporting our clients through the range of consultancy services we offer, including feasibility studies, concept and sizing, and life extensions.


**About our Graduate Scheme**


Our people are our power. At Kent, diverse perspectives and talents are the backbone of our strength. We’re building an environment where everyone, from engineers to scientists, from all walks of life, can thrive and reach their full potential.


If you’re passionate about making an impact and pushing boundaries, Kent is where you belong. We are a future\-focused company, reimagining energy with ambition and innovation.


Our global graduate program offers hands\-on experience, mentorship from industry leaders, and the opportunity to grow as part of a diverse and driven team. We’re building the next generation of leaders in engineering, science, and technology, and we want you to be a part of it.


**Application Process**


As part of the application process, candidates will be required to provide confirmation of the academic modules completed during their university studies. This information will help us assess the relevance of your academic background to the role. Please ensure that confirmation of your completed modules is submitted alongside your CV as part of your application.


**Application Deadline**


All applications must be received by **Friday 23****rd** **October 2026**.


**Recruitment Timeline**


Shortlisting and pre\-screening of applications will commence in early November. Candidates selected to progress to the next stage will be invited to interview, with interviews scheduled to take place from late November to early December 2026\.


**Eligibility**


Please note that candidates must have the right to work in the UK to be considered for this opportunity.


**Hybrid Working**


We follow a hybrid working model that combines office and remote work, with a requirement to be in the offices three days a week. This approach supports the development of a strong and effective team dynamic.


**Power the future with us. Unleash your energy**


**Skills \& Responsibilities:**


You’ll be joining a team spread across various UK locations that actively encourage and foster innovative solutions and new approaches to our client’s problems. It should be highlighted that the majority of the Naval Architecture team are based in our London office and this would be our preferred location for graduate development. You will be joining a RINA accredited Graduate Scheme to help you towards chartership. Your work could involve the following:


* Design and analysis of floating and fixed offshore structures. This could be fixed and floating offshore wind turbines, semi\-submersibles, FPSO/FLNG vessels across the life of the asset, from concept study through to decommissioning.
* Analysis of vessels and offshore structures using techniques including: hydrodynamic analysis, mooring analysis, stability analysis, transportation analysis and structural assessments.
* Learning to use tools such as: DNV SESAM (inc. (inc. GeniE, HydroD, SIMA \& Riflex), Orcina Orcaflex, and Python.
* Interfacing directly with clients, representing our teams to discuss engineering solutions to complex problems.
* Supporting our external markets, business development and work winning activities.
In addition to the responsibilities listed herein, the employee may be required to perform other ad\-hoc tasks as needed or directed by the supervisor or management. These tasks will be within the reasonable scope of the employee's skills, capabilities, and role within the organization. The intent of this provision is to allow for flexibility and adaptability in meeting the dynamic needs of the organization, ensuring that operational requirements can be met efficiently. All such tasks will be assigned considering the employee's current workload and with respect to their professional development.


**Your knowledge/skills, education, and experience:**


* Master’s/MEng degree in Naval Architecture, Maritime Engineering or Ship Science.
**Communication:**


* Excellent command of the English language in both oral and written communication and skills.
**Behaviour/ Core Competencies:**


* A passion for working in a consultancy environment.
* Embracing equality, diversity and inclusion in everything you do.
* A desire to work collaboratively with a curious approach, challenging yourself to find new solutions.
* Enthusiasm and drive to develop your skillset and seek out development opportunities within a supportive team.
* Motivation to achieve professional accreditation (where applicable), making the most of the support given within Kent for gaining chartership.
* Comfortable to embrace agile ways of working and learning new technologies.
* We are looking for candidates who are due to graduate in 2027, or have graduated in the last 2 years.
**HSSEQ:**


The Employee shall observe the Health, Safety, Sustainability, Environment and Quality rules of the Company; it’s clients and the governing authorities of the host country.


We are committed to our diverse and inclusive community \- a place where we can all be ourselves, thrive and develop. From day one, we offer a range of family friendly, inclusive employment policies, flexible working arrangements, and employee networks to support staff from different backgrounds.


As an Equal Opportunities Employer, we value applications from all backgrounds, cultures, and abilities.


We’re a disability\-friendly employer and can make adjustments to support you to perform at your best during the recruitment process. Please contact us confidentially at recruitment.uk@kentplc.com to find out how we can support you.

**Power System Engineer**
=========================

  

National Grid is hiring a Power System Engineer \- This position is based from our Warwick office however we offer flexible hybrid working options.


You will develop into a highly capable transmission planning engineer, building expertise in strategic network assessment, system modelling, and Net Zero network development while contributing to some of the most significant transmission investment decisions in Great Britain.


### **Job Purpose**


As a Power System Engineer within the Net Zero Engineering team, you will contribute to the development of the future electricity transmission network by supporting strategic planning studies, network capability assessments, and engineering analysis that enable the delivery of Net Zero.


You will undertake a range of power system studies and analytical activities to assess network performance, identify future constraints, and support the development of network solutions for generation and demand growth.


Working alongside senior engineers and industry stakeholders, you will build expertise in transmission planning, system modelling, and strategic network development.


### **What You'll Do**


* Support strategic network planning and capability assessment studies.
* Carry out power system simulations and analysis to assess transmission network performance.
* Contribute to boundary capability studies and network transfer assessments.
* Assess the impact of future generation and demand developments on the transmission network.
* Support the development and evaluation of network reinforcement and non\-network solutions.
* Maintain and improve power system models used within planning studies.
* Support development of analytical tools, scripts, and automated workflows.
* Prepare technical reports, presentations, and study documentation.
* Contribute to innovation projects and emerging network planning methodologies.
* Support engagement with internal and external stakeholders.
* Ensure technical work is completed to appropriate engineering standards and governance requirements.
### **About You**


* Degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems Engineering, or related discipline.

Good understanding of:


* Power system fundamentals.
* Power system studies and modelling.
* Electricity transmission networks.
* Network planning principles.
* Experience of conducting power system analysis using PowerFactory, PSS®E, PSCAD, or similar tools.

Understanding of:


* Load flow studies.
* Fault level analysis.
* Network capability assessments.
* Dynamic performance studies.
* Ability to interpret technical requirements and deliver engineering analysis.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.

**Desirable**


Awareness of:


* NETS SQSS
* Grid Code
* CUSC
* Strategic network planning processes
* Experience with Python, DPL, Power BI, or similar analytical tools.
* Understanding of transmission planning processes such as ETYS, tCSNP, SSEP, or NOA.
* Experience in data analytics, modelling automation, or optimisation techniques.
* Experience within a transmission owner, system operator, consultancy, or power industry environment.
### **What You'll Get**


A competitive salary dependent on capability


Plus Market Suppliemnt Annual £4,500


As well as your base salary, you will receive a bonus based on personal and company performance and a competitive contributory pension scheme where we will double match your contribution to a maximum company contribution of 12%. You will also have access to a number of flexible benefits such as a share incentive plan, salary sacrifice car and technology schemes, support via employee assistance lines and matched charity giving to name a few.

  

The closing date for this vacancy is 14th October. However, we encourage candidates to submit their applications as early as possible and not to wait until the published closing date. National Grid’s recruitment periods can and may vary. We reserve the right to remove this advert or close it to further applications at any point during the recruitment process.


In NGET we are passionate about both operating our network safely and providing highly reliable quality of supply for our customers. At the heart of achieving these outcomes is the effective control and operation of our network.


To find out more , please follow the link below:


https://www.nationalgrid.com/electricity\-transmission/

At National Grid, we work towards the highest standards in everything we do, including how we support, value and develop our people. Our aim is to encourage and support employees to thrive and be the best they can be. We celebrate the difference people can bring into our organisation, and welcome and encourage applicants with diverse experiences and backgrounds, and offer flexible and tailored support, at home and in the office.


Our goal is to drive, develop and operate our business in a way that results in a more inclusive culture. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, the innovation from diverse teams \& perspectives and business need. We are committed to building a workforce so we can represent the communities we serve and have a working environment in which each individual feels valued, respected, fairly treated, and able to reach their full potential.

As such, applicants must have the legal right to work in the UK without requiring sponsorship now or in the future under the UK points\-based immigration system. However, in exceptional circumstances where there is a clear and demonstrable need for specialist skills that cannot be sourced from the local labour market, National Grid may consider offering sponsorship. All applications are welcome from candidates who meet these requirements, regardless of race, nationality, or ethnic origin.

 **Key responsibilities**

**Job Description**
-------------------


We are looking for a **Senior Software Engineer (Senior ServiceNow Developer)** to join the **Sopra Steria Polska** team and contribute to the projects for our clients.  

  

**Note that we can only offer cooperation to people who are located in Poland and have EU citizenship.**  

  

**Responsibilities:**

* Participate in ServiceNow implementation, enhancement, and optimization projects.
* Analyze business requirements and translate them into scalable ServiceNow solutions.
* Design, configure, and develop solutions on the ServiceNow platform, primarily within the ITSM module.
* Develop and maintain workflows, integrations, catalog items, business rules, script includes, and other custom platform components.
* Implement new functionalities and enhancements in accordance with business and technical requirements.
* Troubleshoot complex issues, perform root cause analysis, and implement long\-term solutions.
* Review, optimize, and refactor custom code to ensure performance, maintainability, and compliance with ServiceNow best practices.
* Support platform upgrades, patches, and releases, including testing and validation activities.
* Monitor and maintain integrations and APIs to ensure reliable platform operations.
* Maintain up\-to\-date technical documentation for configurations, integrations, and custom developments.
* Collaborate with stakeholders, consultants, and Agile teams to deliver high\-quality solutions.
* Recommend and implement continuous improvements to enhance platform functionality, performance, and user experience.
**Qualifications**
------------------

**We are looking for someone with:**

* Solid hands\-on ServiceNow development experience, ideally around 4–5 years.
* Good knowledge of ITSM and the ServiceNow platform in general.
* Practical experience with CMDB, CI classes, relationships and data imports.
* Experience with REST integrations, IntegrationHub, Import Sets/Transform Maps and scripting.
* Good ServiceNow scripting skills: Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, GlideRecord, Flow Designer, etc.
* Understanding of data modelling and ability to translate functional/data requirements into ServiceNow configurations.
* Ability to analyse existing solutions, troubleshoot issues and independently implement moderate\-complexity changes.
* Experience with upgrades, maintenance and day\-to\-day evolution of ServiceNow ITSM processes.
* Experience with Discovery, Identification and Reconciliation Engine (IRE), CSDM, Service Graph Connectors, Security Operations or ServiceNow instance consolidation would be an advantage, but is not required.

**Additional must Have Requirements:**

* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Fluent English B2/C1\.
* Strong communication skills to collaborate with cross\-functional teams.
* Proactive and detail\-oriented.
* Ability to document processes and share knowledge effectively.
* Being open to occasional business trips abroad and visits in our office in Katowice.
**Additional Information**
--------------------------


What we offer:

* BENEFITS (UoP): Luxmed, Medicover Sport, Worksmile, educational platforms, languages learning platform, referral bonus,\[copyrights, life insurance, certifications (paid by the company), conferences, Tech Lunches, possibility to join our Communities (Project Management, Architecture, Security, Process Management, Leadership, AI and Cloud), local kindergarten.
* DEVELOPMENT OPPORTUNITIES (B2B): Tech Lunches, Worksmile, possibility to join our Communities (Project Management, Architecture, Security, Process Management, Leadership, AI and Cloud).


ADDITION: free parking, fresh fruits, workation.  

In case of questions, please contact the HR team.


The recruitment process for this position consists of two stages:  

* a short phone call with a recruiter (30 min max)
* one\-hour long interview on Teams (with both general and technical questions)
**Salary range:**  

  

UOP: 12 000 \-16 000 PLN gross/month;  

B2B: 100\-140 PLN/h net \+ vat.

  

All information about salary range and its additional components will be provided during the 1st stage of recruitment process.

jobs.title: Software Developer
jobs.description:
Spektrum supports apex purchasers (NATO, UN, EU, and National Government and Defence) and their Tier 1 supplier ecosystem with a wide range of specialist services. We provide our clients with professional services, specialised aerospace and defence sales, delivery, and operational subject matter expertise. We are looking for personnel to join our team and support key client projects.



**Who we are supporting**



The NATO Communication and Information Agency (NCIA) is responsible for providing secure and effective communications and information technology (IT) services to NATO's member countries and its partners. The agency was established in 2012 and is headquartered in Brussels, Belgium.



The NCIA provides a wide range of services, including:


* Cyber Security: The NCIA provides advanced cybersecurity solutions to protect NATO's communication networks and information systems against cyber threats.
* Command and Control Systems: The NCIA develops and maintains the systems used by NATO's military commanders to plan and execute operations.
* Satellite Communications: The NCIA provides satellite communications services to enable secure and reliable communications between NATO forces.
* Electronic Warfare: The NCIA provides electronic warfare services to support NATO's mission to detect, deny, and defeat threats to its communication networks.
* Information Management: The NCIA manages NATO's information technology infrastructure, including its databases, applications, and servers.


Overall, the NCIA plays a critical role in ensuring the security and effectiveness of NATO's communication and information technology capabilities.


**The program**

**Assistance and Advisory Service (AAS)**



The NATO Communications and Information Agency (NCI Agency) is NATO's principal C3 capability deliverer and CIS service provider. It provides, maintains and defends the NATO enterprise\-wide information technology infrastructure to enable Allies to consult together under Article IV, and, when required, stand together in the face of attack under Article V.



To provide these critical services, in the modern evolving dynamic environment the NCI Agency needs to build and maintain high performance\-engaged workforce. The NCI Agency workforce strategically consists of three major categorise's: NATO International Civilians (NIC)'s, Military (Mil), and Interim Workforce Consultants (IWC)'s. The IWCs are a critical part of the overall NCI Agency workforce and make up approximately 15 percent of the total workforce.



### **Software Developer**


### **Role ID – NATOIS\-0049**


**Role Background**



NATO International Staff requires a **Software Developer – Expert Consultant** to support the **Defence Planning and Policy Division, Defence Planning Directorate, Data Analysis Section**.



The role focuses on developing and maintaining solutions for **data collection, analysis and visualisation**, particularly web applications and dashboards supporting defence\-planning data analysis.


**Role Duties and Responsibilities**


* Design, develop and deploy web\-based dashboards.
* Develop and configure web applications using modern web frameworks.
* Develop and test data\-collection solutions.
* Transform and integrate data from classified and unclassified sources into web\-based systems.
* Perform data conversion and preprocessing using **Python APIs and ETL tools**.
* Develop and improve data\-collection tools based on stakeholder requirements.
* Develop and maintain documentation for code, service endpoints and system architecture.
* Support security testing and approval activities.
* Test solutions with stakeholders and ensure requirements are met.
* Develop data\-driven dashboards for senior leadership using **Python and/or Power BI**.
* Support workshops and stakeholder engagements.
* Provide knowledge transfer and training materials.
* Report on progress and identify potential project/timeline risks.
* Brief NATO International Staff and leadership on project progress.


**Essential Skills**


* JavaScript and HTML.
* Modern web development frameworks such as **React, Vue.js or Angular**.
* **MS SQL**.
* **Python** for automation, ETL and data analysis.
* Python libraries including **pandas, NumPy and Matplotlib**.
* Development of data\-driven dashboards using **Python and/or Power BI**.
* Backend services and/or data\-processing pipelines.
* Data integration and preprocessing.
* Git/version control.
* Agile project management.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

  


**Desirable:**


* Practical **.NET** experience


**Experience**


* Minimum **5 years of web development experience** using JavaScript/HTML and frameworks such as React, Vue.js or Angular.
* Extensive MS SQL experience.
* Experience developing dashboards for senior stakeholders.
* Strong Python experience for automation, ETL and analysis.
* Experience building and maintaining backend services or processing pipelines.


**educations and Certifications**


* **Bachelor's Degree** in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Technology or a related field.
* Advanced English.


**Working Location**


**NATO HQ, Brussels, Belgium / Remote**



The contractor has flexibility to work remotely combined with some physical presence at NATO HQ.


**Working Policy**


**Hybrid / flexible remote working with some on\-site presence in Brussels.**



The contractor must be available for contact during approximately half of NATO's official working hours, taking time\-zone differences into account.


* Base period: **1 November – 31 December 2026**
* Base scope: **304 hours**
* Option 1: 2027 – **1,672 hours**
* Option 2: 1 January – 30 June 2028 – **836 hours**
* Travel to NATO HQ may occur **2–3 times during the performance period**, with travel costs included in the quoted price.
* Signed NDA required.


**Travel**


* Some travel to other NATO sites may be required

  


**Security Clearance**


* Valid National or NATO Secret personal security clearance

**About DHI**


DHI is a global and independent company dedicated to working on challenges within the fields of water and environment and sustainability. Within these fields, we provide a wide range of advisory, digital advisory, research and water governance services as well as providing leading edge technologies and products to the market. DHI is fund\-owned, meaning that profit goes to a purpose and not shareholders

You will work on delivering the MUSE application and doing a difference for endangered birds across the world.


You will be a part of a friendly and diverse team located both in Hørsholm and across Europe. Everyone is passionate about the product and striving to provide our clients with outstanding technical advice and customer service.


The main responsibilities and challenges in the job are:


* Develop the software application

jobs.title: Principal Solutions Architect
jobs.description:
N\-iX is looking for a Principal Software Architect to join a small team building a new ERP product for public\-sector customers in the US. The team uses AI coding agents for a large part of the development work. You'll own the product's architecture, help set up how the team builds with AI, and stay close to the engineering work.



This role is ideal for an architect who uses AI coding agents every day and has designed SaaS products with complex business logic. ERP or finance experience is a plus but not required, as domain experts are part of the team.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


* Own the architecture of a new multi\-tenant SaaS product, from the first design to production.
* Work with product managers and domain experts to turn business rules into a clear domain model.
* Make the key technical decisions and document them so the team and the client understand the reasons.
* Drive prototypes and reference implementations to test ideas early, and review the team's code.
* Set up how the team works with AI coding agents: coding standards, testing, and code review.
* Design for data accuracy, security, and auditability, which financial software requires.
* Plan integrations with the client's existing products and with third\-party systems.
* Present the architecture and progress to the client's product and technical leaders.

**Qualifications**
------------------


* Practical AI proficiency, and this is the part we weigh most. You use AI coding agents every day in real software work, you know their limits, and you've helped a team use them well.
* 10\+ years in software development, with 3\+ years as an architect.
* Strong experience with .NET and C\#.
* Experience designing and running production systems on AWS.
* Experience designing SaaS or enterprise products: distributed systems, multi\-tenancy, APIs, and event\-driven design.
* Experience with systems where data must always be correct, such as financial, billing, payment, or other calculation\-heavy systems.
* Able to learn a new business domain quickly and work closely with domain experts.
* Clear communication, written and spoken. You can explain technical decisions to non\-technical people.
* English: Advanced.

**Nice to Have**
----------------


* Readiness to write code yourself when needed, such as prototypes or reference implementations.
* Experience with ERP or accounting systems.
* Products for government or other regulated customers.

**We offer\*:**


* Flexible working format \- remote, office\-based or flexible
* A competitive salary and good compensation package
* Personalized career growth
* Professional development tools (mentorship program, tech talks and trainings, centers of excellence, and more)
* Active tech communities with regular knowledge sharing
* Education reimbursement
* Memorable anniversary presents
* Corporate events and team buildings
* Other location\-specific benefits


* not applicable for freelancers

As an R\&D Software Developer within the Grid Automation domain, you will help shape innovative solutions for the power systems of tomorrow.


You will work closely with global technology teams that bring niche expertise and cutting\-edge capabilities. Your work will directly support the development of real\-time software used in critical infrastructure worldwide software designed for long\-term reliability, high efficiency, and uncompromising security.

* Strong experience with multithreading, synchronization primitives, asynchronous I/O and real\-time system design.
* Proficiency with building systems (CMake, Visual Studio) and cross\-platform development for Windows and Linux.

* Demonstrated experience with performance profiling, optimization, and low\-latency systems.
* Understanding of software architecture principles and secure, scalable system design.
* Excellent problem\-solving skills and the ability to tackle complex technical challenges.
* Good understanding of unit and integration testing techniques and testing frameworks.
* Knowledge of non\-functional requirements (performance, scalability, security).

* Understanding of power grid operations and applicable standards.
* Experience with industrial automation systems (SCADA, IED, RTU) in plus.
* Experience with industrial protocols and standards (IEC 61850, IEC\-60870\-5\-104, DNP3, OPC UA, IEEE C37\.118\) in plus.
* Practical experience working directly with power grid industry clients and exposure to system integration, simulators, or lab environments.
* Proven ability to translate customer requirements into clear technical designs.
* Solid understanding of numerical methods, signal processing, and control fundamentals and ability to work with high‑frequency, time‑aligned time‑series data
* Good understanding of power system dynamics and the stability challenges introduced by high penetration of renewables
* Effective team player with strong communication skills and willingness to learn.

**Digital Technology Poland** to miejsce, w którym innowacje przemysłowe spotykają się z doświadczeniem. Nasze zespoły pracują w Zielonej Górze, **Cieszynie**, Poznaniu i w Warszawie.

* Wykształcenie wyższe: informatyka lub inne, pokrewne techniczne/ścisłe

Znajomość języka angielskiego pozwalająca na udział w spotkaniach technicznych z polsko\-niemieckim zespołem oraz rozumienie dokumentacji

#### **Plusem będzie**

* Znajomość obszaru elektrotechniki
* Umiejętność efektywnego stosowania narzędzi AI
* Znajomość MCP
* Znajomość Jenkinsa

  


### **Mamy dla Ciebie**


* Innowacyjne i długofalowe projekty w firmie produktowej, w dziedzinie Industry 4\.0
* Stabilne środowisko biznesowe w międzynarodowym otoczeniu
* Pracę, z której efektów korzysta tysiące inżynierów i klientów na całym świecie
* Rozwój \- kontakt z najnowszymi technologiami
* Pracę w zespole tworzącym mieszankę doświadczenia z młodością, który chętnie dzieli się wiedzą

Dostęp do platform e\-learningowych i innych form nauki

Lunche takie jak lubisz, na koszt firmy

* Elastyczny czas rozpoczęcia pracy (7\.00 \- 9\.00\)
* Krótszą pracę w piątki albo dodatkowy jeden wolny piątek w miesiącu (czyli nawet 12 dni dodatkowego urlopu!)

* Niekorporacyjną atmosferę i brak dress codu
* Wspólną celebrację sukcesów i innych wyjątkowych dni

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Credit & Fraud
jobs.description:
##### **What we do at Qliro**


At Qliro we deliver safe and simple payments. We are a dedicated partner to our merchants who serve their customers every day. We believe that if our merchants grow, we grow. We are a company of dedicated, friendly and highly competent people that together have redefined what Qliro and payments can be. We are now on a journey of scaling our business both here in Sweden and the Nordics.

##### **What your team does**


We are now looking for a **Software Engineer** to join Credit \& Fraud team, the team at the center of Qliro’s Pay Later platform. What we do here shapes whether customers can pay in a way that actually works for them, and whether we protect them from taking on debt they can’t handle. It’s a dual responsibility, and we take both sides seriously.


We’re rebuilding the next generation of this system from the ground up, designed to handle a significant increase in transaction volumes as we scale. Part of what you’ll lead is making this platform ready to operate beyond the Nordics, so the architectural decisions you make now will need to hold up across multiple markets. We’re in the early stages of exploring how AI can help us make better credit and fraud decisions, and we’re honest that this is genuinely complex territory. Credit is one of the most regulated areas when it comes to AI: explainability, fairness, and auditability aren’t optional. We want someone who finds that complexity interesting, not someone who pretends it isn’t there.

##### **Current focus for the team**

* Processing tens of thousands of credit and fraud checks every day
* Running a containerized microservices architecture with daily production deployments
* Tech stack: C\#, .NET, AWS, Docker \+ Swarm, Kubernetes, Microservices, Event Driven Architecture, RabbitMQ, Terraform, GitLab, MS SQL Server, DynamoDB, Redis, OpenTelemetry \+ Grafana, Kibana

##### **What we are looking for**

* **3\-5 years of professional experience with .NET**, with strong skills in C\#
* Comfortable using modern AI tooling such as **Windsurf**, **Claude**, or similar
* Experience in **modernizing and migrating legacy systems**
* Practical experience with agile engineering methods and solid software engineering best practices
* Strong understanding of system design, data structures, and API development
* A mindset that values **speed, correctness, and reliability**, especially in microservices and event‑driven architectures


It is beneficial if you have experience from:

* Working with **credit engines**, **credit decisioning**, or similar financial decision systems
* Working with AWS or other cloud providers
* Working in a team with full platform ownership — including monitoring, infrastructure, CI/CD, and production operations

###### **Does this sound like your next role? What are you waiting for \- apply now!**

*Qliro is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to gender, gender identity or expression, national origin, religion or other beliefs, disability, sexual* orientation *or age*.

jobs.title: Senior Back-end Developer
jobs.description:
**Senior Back\-end Developer – Electronic Access Control**

  

**Build the backend that connects the future of secure access.**

  

As a **Senior Back\-end Developer**, you will join our skilled, international team of developers based in Stockholm, dedicated to building next\-generation products and access control solutions that enable identity, authentication and access experiences for customers worldwide.


**Why this role matters**

  

At ASSA ABLOY, technology plays a direct role in creating safer, more open environments. Your work will help make sure different product components can communicate and work together reliably — turning individual technologies into complete access solutions.


This is a role for someone who enjoys more than simply implementing requirements. You’ll have the opportunity to contribute to architecture, solve challenging backend and integration problems, and continuously improve both the software and the way the team works.


**The role**

  

You’ll join a small and strongly connected team working in a highly self\-organised agile environment. The team values close collaboration, open discussion and learning from one another, with approaches such as pair programming and mob programming forming part of how you work together.


You’ll take ownership of backend development and integrations, from designing solutions through to implementation, testing and continuous improvement. You’ll also contribute to technical discussions and decisions, while having the independence to explore problems and find solutions before bringing others in.


**What you’ll work on**

  

* **Build and evolve backend services** — develop high\-quality software using Golang and modern software engineering practices, with a focus on distributed systems and product connectivity.
* **Develop APIs and integrations** — create and maintain REST APIs and modern integration patterns that connect different product components.
* **Shape technical solutions** — contribute to software architecture, object\-oriented design and decisions around scalable, maintainable solutions.
* **Strengthen software quality** — work with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing and code reviews to help deliver reliable software.
* **Solve complex problems** — troubleshoot and improve existing solutions while looking for practical ways to make the product and development process better.
* **Work closely with the team** — collaborate through pair and mob programming, share knowledge and contribute to a culture of continuous improvement.

**What will help you succeed**

  

* **5\+ years of backend software development experience**, including designing and delivering production\-grade applications.
* **Hands\-on experience with Golang as a programming language**, together with experience building distributed systems, APIs or backend services.
* **Solid understanding of software architecture and object\-oriented design**, including REST APIs and modern integration patterns.
* **Experience with modern development practices**, particularly CI/CD, automated testing and code reviews.
* **A collaborative and curious mindset** — you enjoy learning from others, sharing knowledge and remaining open to new ideas, technologies and perspectives. You see change as an opportunity to improve products, processes and team effectiveness.

  

**Nice to have:** Some experience with the .NET ecosystem.


**Why ASSA ABLOY**

  

You’ll join a global organisation where you can work on technology with a real\-world purpose, while having the trust and freedom to shape how you contribute. You’ll be part of a small team where collaboration is close, ideas are welcome and continuous improvement is part of everyday work.

  

* **Meaningful mission** — Build software that helps connect secure access solutions used in real\-world environments around the world.
* **Innovation \& scale** — Develop your expertise across distributed systems, backend services, integrations and modern software engineering within a global technology organisation.
* **Autonomy \& trust** — Work in a self\-organised team where you’re encouraged to take ownership, explore solutions and influence technical decisions.
* **Growth \& development** — Learn from experienced colleagues, contribute across the technology stack and continuously develop your technical and problem\-solving skills.
* **Work–life balance** — Work from Stockholm in a hybrid setup, within a Scandinavian culture built around collaboration, trust and sustainable ways of working.

**Ready to build the connections behind secure access?**

  

Apply today and join the team in shaping the backend and integrations behind the next generation of Electronic Access Control.


We review applications continuously and will be moving forward with suitable candidates throughout the process. To make sure your personal data is safe, we don't review applications sent by email or post. If you have any questions about the role or the process, please contact Léa Rein, Senior Talent Acquisition Business Partner.


Depending on the risk profile for the role, a background screening may need to be performed. Final candidates may therefore be subject to a background screening. The performance of a background check is subject to consent and based on our Applicant Privacy Notice.

  



**We are the ASSA ABLOY Group**
  

Our people have made us the global leader in access solutions. In return, we open doors for them wherever they go. With nearly 63,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries, we help billions of people experience a more open world. Our innovations make all sorts of spaces – physical and virtual – safer, more secure, and easier to access.


As an employer, we value results – not titles, or backgrounds. We empower our people to build their career around their aspirations and our ambitions – supporting them with regular feedback, training, and development opportunities. Our colleagues think broadly about where they can make the most impact, and we encourage them to grow their role locally, regionally, or even internationally.


As we welcome new people on board, it’s important to us to have diverse, inclusive teams, and we value different perspectives and experiences.

**Workplace type:**


\#LI\-Hybrid**Our values\-based culture connects to our purpose and empowers people to be their best, professionally and personally. jobs.title: Project Engineer – Process Water Treatment (Data Centre Sector)
jobs.description:
**About the Role:**

  

Due to continued growth and the award of multiple data centre utilitywater and processwater treatment projects, EPS Group is expanding its MEICA engineering team. We are seeking a Project Engineer with strong technical expertise in water treatment processes to support the delivery of critical process\-water systems in hyperscale and enterprise data centres across Ireland and Europe.


In this role, you will support the design, installation, integration and commissioning of advanced water treatment systems used in mission\-critical cooling, humidification, and process applications. You will work closely with multidisciplinary EPS teams, supply\-chain partners and major data centre operators to ensure the safe, timely and efficient delivery of highreliability process\-water infrastructure.


This is a varied role combining design coordination, project delivery, site engineering and commissioning support. Depending on project phase, it may be officebased, sitebased or hybrid.

 **Key Responsibilities:**

 **Project Engineering \& Delivery**

* Manage and support all mechanical, electrical and ICA aspects of process\-water treatment installations within data centres.
* Interpret and work from P\&IDs, technical drawings, design specifications and functional control narratives.
* Support the design team in developing innovative solutions using modern water\-treatment technologies (RO, UF, ion exchange, dosing, filtration).
* Coordinate procurement activities, including selection and ordering of pumps, skids, valves, instruments and control systems.
* Develop project schedules and ensure all interfaces\-from design through installation to commissioning\-are fully accounted for and delivered.

**Process Water Treatment Systems**

* Oversee installation, integration and performance validation of systems such as:
* Reverse Osmosis (RO)
* Ultrafiltration (UF)
* Softening and demineralisation
* Chemical dosing and disinfection
* Polishing and high\-purity systems
* Monitor process stability and water quality parameters to ensure system compliance with data centre operational requirements.

**Data Centre Integration \& Coordination**

* Work alongside M\&E contractors, BMS/SCADA teams and client representatives within live or construction\-stage data centre environments.
* Ensure water treatment systems integrate seamlessly with cooling towers, adiabatic coolers, chilled\-water loops and makeup water systems.
* Support commissioning teams in FAT/SAT, functional testing, start\-up, optimisation and handover.

**Safety, Documentation \& Reporting**

* Coordinate project safety requirements and liaise with the EPS HSQE team to ensure best\-in\-class safety practices.
* Prepare engineering documentation including method statements, risk assessments, O\&M manuals, commissioning schedules and progress reports.
* Manage site labour, subcontractors and daily installation activities while ensuring all work adheres to EPS and client safety standards.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Liaise and coordinate with clients, consultants, vendors and internal project teams to ensure smooth project delivery.
* Attend progress meetings, technical reviews and commissioning walkdowns.
* Support training and handover processes for client operations teams.

 **Key Competencies and Skills:**

* Proven experience in a Mechanical/Electrical/Process Engineering environment.
* Strong knowledge of water treatment technologies and associated mechanical/ICA equipment.
* Experience with PLC, SCADA or BMS\-controlled systems in industrial environments.
* Excellent analytical, diagnostic and problem\-solving abilities.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to work collaboratively.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks within time\-sensitive project schedules.
* Willingness to learn, innovate and deliver within the fast\-paced data centre sector.

 **Qualifications:**

* Third\-level qualification in Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical, Environmental or Automation Engineering.
* Equivalent relevant experience will be considered.
* Full EU/Irish driving licence.
* Additional industry certifications (IOSH/NEBOSH, water treatment, commissioning) are beneficial.

 **Compensation Package:**

* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Opportunities for professional development and career growth
* CPD accredited employer
* A collaborative and supportive work environment
* Laptop or desktop and work mobile phone provided
* Flexible working options, dependent on location and role requirements
* See company website for more information on the benefits of working in EPS Group

  

We welcome speculative applications from individuals of all levels.

If you need any reasonable adjustments or have an accessibility request during your recruitment journey, please let our recruiting team know.


Speak to our recruiting team on 022\-31200 or email jobs@epswater.com.

 **Equal Opportunity Statement** \- EPS Group is an equal opportunities employer.

 **Company Profile**

*Since 1968, we have grown from a modest electrical and pumping services business and developed into an innovative, internationally exporting product and service provider, now focused upon the water, wastewater and clean technology sectors, operating across the Republic of Ireland, the UK and Europe.*

*We are an international water infrastructure specialist, one of the few genuine end\-to\-end service providers in the global water sector, providing large scale employment, bringing market leading and ground breaking technologies to Ireland and working to improve the country's water infrastructure.*
