**Technical Environment**

* **Modern C\# stack**: Distributed C\# and .NET microservices
* **Cloud \& orchestration**: Hosted on Azure using Kubernetes
* **Architecture**: Event\-driven, supporting products used at significant scale
* **Observability**: Grafana, Azure Application Insights, logs, traces, and metrics
* **AI tooling**: Claude and other AI tools used throughout the engineering workflow — design exploration, code generation and review, test writing, incident investigation, and technical communication

**Our Engineering Approach**

* **AI\-native engineering**: We want engineers who tinker — experimenting with new tools, agents, and workflows, and sharing what works
* **Guardrails as we accelerate**: Automated tests, SLOs, alerting, observability, and deployment safeguards around everything we ship
* **Own it beyond the pull request**: Design for idempotency, retries, out\-of\-order events, and failure modes, and know how your services behave in production
* **The Campfire Rule**: Leave the systems you touch a little better than you found them
* **On\-call as feedback, not heroics**: Engineers who build our systems also help operate them, using incidents to make the platform more resilient

**What You Need**


We're looking for a senior engineer who's curious, autonomous, and highly trusted. You're comfortable owning the entire software stack — including supporting infrastructure — throughout its lifecycle, and you see production data, not just deployment, as the real measure of "done."

**Required Experience:**

* Strong grasp of C\# and .NET development
* Experience with event\-driven systems \- We use Azure Service Bus, but would love to hear from you if you have experience with similar messaging technology (Kafka, RabbitMQ, etc.)
* Microservices architecture experience, ideally on Azure and Kubernetes
* Experience using observability tooling (e.g. Grafana, Application Insights) to understand production behaviour
* Comfort using AI tools as part of a daily engineering workflow (design, code review, testing, incident investigation)
* DevOps culture mindset, including on\-call/production ownership
* Proven ability to collaborate effectively in distributed teams across time zones
* Continuous learning mindset and openness to feedback

**Location \& Benefits**

* Fully remote role, collaborating during core GMT working hours
* Work with diverse teams distributed across UK, Europe, and Africa
* Personalised training budget to support your development
* Home office setup budget
* Professional development programs and coaching partnerships
* Family\-friendly policies and flexible working arrangements
* Well\-being support and career growth opportunities

**Our Mission**

We create financial inclusion for the traditionally excluded through a fair, flexible, customer\-centric financing model. We strive to drive greater inclusion of women, youth, and low\-income communities.

**Our Impact**

Our technology has created measurable change:

* **Connected** : 2\.5 million first\-time smartphone users connected
* **Prosperous** : 70% of customers use M\-KOPA products for income generation, with 35,000 livelihoods created for agents
* **Green** : 2\.155 million tonnes of CO₂ avoided since 2010 through clean energy, refurbished devices, and e\-mobility

**Ready to build C\#/.NET systems — with AI as part of your craft — that create real\-world financial inclusion? Apply Now!**

**Why M\-KOPA?**
----------------


At M\-KOPA, we empower our people to own their careers through diverse development programs, coaching partnerships, and on\-the\-job training. We support individual journeys with family\-friendly policies, prioritize well\-being, and embrace flexibility.


Join us in shaping the future of M\-KOPA as we grow together. Explore more at **m\-kopa.com**.

*Recognized four times by the Financial Times as one Africa's fastest growing companies (2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026\), named on CNBC's World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025 \& 2026 and by TIME100 Most influential companies in the world 2023 and 2024 , we've served over 10 million customers, unlocking $2 billion in cumulative credit for the everyday earners across Africa, in addition to over 10,000 e\-bikes financed in Kenya.*

***Important Notice***  

  

*M\-KOPA is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer committed to assembling a diverse, broadly trained staff. Women, minorities, and people with disabilities are strongly encouraged to apply.*

*M\-KOPA explicitly prohibits the use of Forced or Child Labour and respects the rights of its employees to agree to terms and conditions of employment voluntarily, without coercion, and freely terminate their employment on appropriate notice. M\-KOPA shall ensure that its Employees are of legal working age and shall comply with local laws for youth employment or student work, such as internships or apprenticeships.*

*M\-KOPA does not collect/charge any money as a pre\-employment or post\-employment requirement. This means that we never ask for ‘recruitment fees’, ‘processing fees’, ‘interview fees’, or any other kind of money in exchange for offer letters or interviews at any time during the hiring process.*

*Applications for this position will be reviewed on a rolling basis. Shortlisting and interviews will take place at any stage during the recruitment process. We reserve the right to close the vacancy early if a suitable candidate is selected before the advertised closing date.*

**Job Description:**

**2027 Technology Internship \- AI\-Native Data Platform Engineering \- 6\-month Internship (January – July)**

TD Securities are offering an exceptional opportunity to join a diverse and dynamic team through our 6\-month Technology Internship on the AI\- Native Data Platform Engineering team.  



**Internship Overview**

* **Contract Type:** Full\-time, 6\-Month Internship
* **Dates:** January 2027 – July 2027
* **Location:**
	+ **Dublin Office** : 1 Molesworth Street
	Candidates must have an unrestricted right to work in Ireland throughout the entire duration of the internship.  
	+

  

**Team Overview:**

The TDS Data Platform Engineering team is building the next generation of data platforms where data products, AI agents, and self\-service analytics work together to help users discover, understand, and consume data more effectively.  



  

Our mission is to provide a scalable, secure, and AI\-ready data platform that empowers domain teams to build and own data products while enabling consumers to interact with data through modern experiences such as AI agents, natural language interfaces, and intelligent automation.  



  

As a Graduate Analyst or a 6\-month Intern, you will help shape how AI and data platforms converge. You will work on technologies such as Large Language Models (LLMs), Agentic AI, Model Context Protocol (MCP), data products, APIs, cloud\-native platforms, and analytics solutions. You will collaborate with domain owners, data engineers, application teams, and platform engineers to create innovative solutions that make data easier to discover, understand, and use.  



  

We are a highly collaborative team that values curiosity, experimentation, continuous learning, and delivering business value through simple, scalable, and user\-centric solutions.  



  

**How you will Contribute:**

* Help design and build AI\-ready data platform capabilities that enable self\-service data discovery and usage.
* Develop AI agents and MCP\-based integrations that allow users to interact with data products using natural language.
* Collaborate with domain owners to understand their data products and create intelligent experiences that simplify data consumption.
* Build APIs, services, and automation frameworks that expose data and business capabilities to AI agents and applications.
* Contribute to the development of Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions using enterprise data sources.
* Assist in building and maintaining scalable data pipelines and cloud\-native data services.
* Create proof\-of\-concepts exploring emerging technologies in AI, data engineering, and developer productivity.
* Partner with platform users to understand pain points and improve platform usability and adoption.
* Develop tools that help users discover datasets, understand lineage, definitions, ownership, and usage patterns.
* Support the implementation of governance, security, and access controls for AI\-enabled solutions.
* Participate in platform monitoring, troubleshooting, testing, and continuous improvement activities.
* Contribute to technical documentation, architecture reviews, and knowledge\-sharing initiatives.
* Apply engineering best practices including clean code, automated testing, CI/CD, and secure software development.
Continuously research emerging AI and data technologies and evaluate their relevance to the platform.  
* 

  

**Key Technologies:**

* The successful graduate will gain experience in:
* AI Agents, Agentic Workflows, and Model Context Protocol (MCP)
* Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), and Prompt Engineering
* Java (Spring Boot) for APIs and backend services
* Python for data engineering, automation, analytics, and AI solutions
* Apache Spark and Dremio for large\-scale data processing and data products
* Azure Data Platform Ecosystem including Databricks, AKS, ADLS, ADF, and Azure AI Services
* Vector Databases and Semantic Search technologies
* REST APIs, gRPC, and Event\-Driven Architectures
* Kafka for real\-time data movement
* GitHub, GitHub Actions, Jira, and Confluence
* Observability platforms such as Dynatrace and Datadog
Security, Governance, and Data Catalog technologies  
* 

  

**Who we are looking for:**

* Penultimate year student in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field. Bachelors or Masters programme.
* Passion for solving business problems using data and AI.
* Strong curiosity and willingness to explore emerging technologies.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment with a bias toward learning and experimentation.
* Interest in understanding both technology and business domains.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and debugging skills.
* Programming experience in one or more languages such as Java, Python, JavaScript, or C\#.
* Understanding of APIs and modern software development principles.
* Basic SQL and data modelling knowledge.
* Familiarity with Git and collaborative software development practices.
* Interest in AI, machine learning, large language models, or intelligent systems.
* Previous experience with the below considered an asset:
	+ Experience with Generative AI, LLMs, RAG, AI Agents, or MCP.
	+ Knowledge of data engineering concepts and distributed data processing.
	+ Exposure to cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.o Familiarity with Databricks, Spark, Dremio, or similar analytics platforms.
	+ Understanding of vector databases and semantic search concepts.
	+ Experience building APIs using Spring Boot, FastAPI, or similar frameworks.
	+ Knowledge of containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
	+ Passion for creating intuitive user experiences and self\-service platforms.
	+ Interest in Data Mesh, data products, data governance, and AI\-enabled analytics.
* **Please note, in order to be considered for the position you must be available for 6\-month internship placement, January – July 2027**

  

**How to Apply:**

**All applicants are required to submit their CV and a Cover Letter. Only complete applications will be accepted.**

**Please note that your application will not be considered complete without submitting your CV and Cover Letter. If during the application process your Cover Letter or CV was not uploaded, please send an email to** **dublinrecruitment@tdescurities.com** **titled “2027 Technology Intern \- Your First \& Last Name”.**

Headquartered in Toronto, Canada, with more than 85,000 employees in offices around the world, The Toronto\-Dominion Bank and its subsidiaries are collectively known as TD Bank Group (TD). TD offers a full range of financial products and services more than 25 million customers worldwide through three key business lines:


* Canadian Retail including TD Canada Trust, Business Banking, TD Auto Finance (Canada), TD Wealth (Canada), TD Direct Investing and TD Insurance

Wholesale Banking including TD Securities  
*

Operating in 30 cities across the globe, we combine deep industry knowledge, innovation and global connectivity to help clients achieve their ambitions.  



  

Through our offices in London, Dublin and Belfast, we support clients across the UK, Ireland and Europe while leveraging the strength of our global platform and expertise.

More than 95,000 TD colleagues bring their skills, talent, and creativity to foster deeper relationships, ensure disciplined execution, and build a simpler, faster banking experience. You’ll have regular career, development, and performance conversations with your manager, as well as access to an online learning platform and a variety of mentoring programs to help you unlock future opportunities.


If you’re passionate about helping clients and building deep, lasting relationships, TD offers diverse career paths where you can grow your expertise and make a meaningful impact.


We're committed to your success and foster a respectful workplace where diverse perspectives are valued, everyone has fair opportunities to grow, and you can unlock your full potential to achieve your career goals. Here at TD, we hire and develop the best.

jobs.title: Principal / Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Overview**  

With more than 45,000 employees and partners worldwide, the Customer Experience and Success (CE\&S) organization is on a mission to empower customers to accelerate business value through differentiated customer experiences that leverage Microsoft’s products and services, ignited by our people and culture. We drive cross\-company alignment and execution, ensuring that we consistently exceed customers’ expectations in every interaction, whether in\-product, digital, or human\-centered. CE\&S is responsible for all up services across the company, including consulting, customer success, and support across Microsoft’s portfolio of solutions and products. Join CE\&S and help us accelerate AI transformation for our customers and the world.


The Strategic Workload Acceleration Team (SWAT) is a highly technical team that accomplishes three strategic goals:


1\) Work directly with our most strategic customer projects worldwide to ensure they are successful on the platform


2\) Ensure our engineering teams fully understand the end\-to\-end technical details of their services through the eyes of our customers


3\) Share best practices with the larger Customer Success community worldwide.


The Principal / Senior Software Engineer role in Strategic Workload Acceleration Team (SWAT) will drive architectural and programmatic oversight for strategic initiatives, aligned with Microsoft’s priorities around AI innovation and enhancing platform resiliency. By providing depth of insight for architecture improvement and innovation, this role is critical in planning and driving execution of strategic programs that deliver on CE\&S mission and operational goals.


This is a hands\-on technical role spanning across design, build, and production deployment on customer projects with a focus on issue resolution to remove customer production blockers.


Candidates are expected to comfortably switch from a whiteboard to hands\-on engineering. The position location is in the United Kingdom / Ireland with a need to be in Redmond WA regularly to engage directly with the broader team and Azure engineering teams.


There will be up to 50% travel worldwide as this is a customer facing role expected to work directly with customers on site.

 **Responsibilities*** Drive innovation in AI and strategic technologies aligned with Microsoft’s priorities: Holds subject matter expertise in other tools inside and outside areas of expertise. Leads identification of internal tools and creation of new tools that will be useful for creating the product, determining if methods are still applicable for the current solution. Focuses on Commercial Success and platform/product adoption. Shares best practices and teaches others about new tools and strategies. Remains current by investing time and effort into staying abreast of current developments.
* Strengthen customer trust through enhanced platform resiliency and security: Partners with appropriate stakeholders (e.g., project manager, technical lead) to determine user requirements for one or more complex scenarios. Leverages a variety of feedback channels to incorporate insights into future designs or solution fixes. Leads incorporation of appropriate continuous feedback loops measuring customer value, usage patterns, and other actionable metrics of value. Determines additional critical metrics. Proactively seeks new knowledge and adapts to new trends, technical solutions, and patterns that will improve the availability, reliability, efficiency, observability, and performance of products while also driving consistency in monitoring and operations at scale and shares knowledge with other engineers.
* Drive strategic partnerships with a focus on customer experience: Partners with CxOs to identify, prioritize, and scope programs/projects to significantly improve customer value for Microsoft and collaboration with engineering and product teams. Leads incorporation of appropriate continuous feedback loops measuring customer value, usage patterns, and other actionable metrics of value. Determines additional critical metrics.

 **Qualifications**  

Required Qualifications:

* Bachelor's degree in computer science or related technical field AND extensive years of technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C\+\+, C\#, Java, JavaScript, or Python OR equivalent experience.
  

Preferred Qualifications:

* Master's degree in computer science or related technical field AND advanced years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C\+\+, C\#, Java, JavaScript, or Python OR equivalent experience.
* Possesses a breadth of knowledge across cloud computing topics and Azure, as well as specialist hands\-on depth expertise across GenAI and platform services.
* Demonstrated technical expertise in Microsoft Fabric, including secure, compliant end\-to\-end solution delivery (data integration through semantic model and reporting), with strong governance for regulated environments (IAM, encryption, monitoring, data governance), plus automation and optimization of pipelines/jobs for performance, cost, and BCDR, and integration with core Azure/Microsoft services; experience building data agents and ability to implement rigorous testing/observability and responsible AI controls.
  

The ability to meet Microsoft, customer, and / or government security screening requirements is required for this role. These requirements include but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings: Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud Background Check upon hire / transfer and every two years thereafter.


\#CES \#CXA

  

  

  

Software Engineering IC5 \- The typical base pay range for this role across United Kingdom is £ 93,500\.00 \- £ 161,800\.00 per year. Certain roles may be eligible for benefits and other compensation.


Find additional benefits and pay information here:  

https://careers.microsoft.com/v2/global/en/corporate\-pay/united\-kingdom\-corporate\-pay.html

  

Software Engineering IC5 \- The typical base pay range for this role across Ireland is € 99,800\.00 \- € 172,400\.00 per year. Certain roles may be eligible for benefits and other compensation.
Find additional benefits and pay information here:  

https://careers.microsoft.com/v2/global/en/corporate\-pay/ireland\-corporate\-pay.html


Software Engineering IC4 \- The typical base pay range for this role across Ireland is € 77,400\.00 \- € 130,000\.00 per year. Certain roles may be eligible for benefits and other compensation.


Find additional benefits and pay information here:  

https://careers.microsoft.com/v2/global/en/corporate\-pay/ireland\-corporate\-pay.html

jobs.title: Senior Software Utvikler / Arkitekt -- Systemkonfigurasjon (Studio)
jobs.description:
SEAM AS


Husøyvegen 31, 4262 Avaldsnes


**Om jobben**
-------------


Lagre favoritt


Type ansettelse
Fast, heltid 100%
Antall stillinger
1
Arbeidsspråk
Norsk eller engelsk  

Søk senest mandag 12\. oktober

  

Som seniorutvikler og arkitekt får du et sterkt teknisk medansvar for "Studio" \- vår egenutviklede systemkonfigurator for automasjonsplattformen e\-SEAMatic v4\. Applikasjonen er selve bindeleddet i plattformen vår, og brukes av ingeniørene til å designe skipsautomasjon (IAS/EPMS). Du vil inngå i et dedikert produktteam, sette deg inn i en eksisterende kodebase, og få et teknisk hovedansvar for utviklingen av applikasjonen.


#### **Arbeidsoppgaver**


* Teknisk utvikling: Videreutvikle og optimalisere Studio i.NET 8 og C\# med utstrakt bruk av MVVM\-arkitektur. Du evner å ta ufullstendige problemstillinger, spesifisere løsninger i tett dialog med produktteamet, og implementere disse med et ryddig forhold til kompleks versjonering og plattformavhengigheter.
* Integrasjoner og automatisering: Utvikle og drifte API\-er mot tredjepartssystemer (f.eks. ERP og CAD\-/tegneverktøy). Sentrale oppgaver inkluderer autogenerering av PLS\-kode (IEC 61131\-3\), og på sikt automatisering av systemdokumentasjon for produktleveranser.
* Testing og støtte: Teste egne og andres løsninger, utbedre feil og optimalisere ytelsen. Du vil også bistå med nødvendig teknisk dokumentasjon og fungere som en støttespiller for ingeniørene som bruker verktøyet.

#### **Kvalifikasjoner**


Vi ser etter deg med en solid teknisk grunnmur som fullstackutvikler, med tung erfaring innen i.NET/C\#, API\-design og arkitekturmønstre som MVVM. Du har erfaring med å sette deg inn i og drifte komplekse, eksisterende kodebaser, og har god kontroll på versjonskontroll (Git/Azure Repos). Erfaring med bruk av AI, både for kodeassistanse og som funksjonalitet i applikasjoner er en fordel. Du trenger ikke detaljkunnskap om PLS\-programmering (dette ivaretas av fageksperter), men du må evne å omsette tekniske krav til funksjonell software.


#### **Personlige egenskaper**


Du trives med å jobbe på tvers av teknologistakken. Siden Studio er et sentralt knutepunkt i vår arkitektur, kreves det gode kommunikasjonsevner for å samhandle på tvers av produktteamet. Du motiveres av å ta et sterkt teknisk ansvar for kodebasen, drive frem optimaliseringer og bygge smarte verktøy som forenkler kollegaers arbeidshverdag.


#### **Vi tilbyr**


* En hverdag der du får jobbe med inovative løsninger, der du vil bidra til utviklingen av løsninger som former fremtiden for maritim industri.
  

Hos oss vil den erfaringen du bidrar inn med til, bli satt stor pris på.
* Vi tror på kontinuerlig lærling, og vil utfordre deg til å lære nytt og utvikle deg videre i din karriere i ett av Hagalandets største utviklingsmiljøer.
* I SEAM verdsetter vi samarbeid og kunnskapsdeling. Du vil arbeide i et team av dyktige fagfolk. Sammen skaper vi en kultur preget av utvikling og tett dialog, alltid med et sterkt produkt\- og kundefokus
* For øvrig kan vi friste med gode kollegaer, hus i Spania, hytte på Hovden, en svært aktiv velferdslubb og et sprekt bedriftsidrettslag
* Konkurransedyktige lønns\-, pensjons\- og forsikringsordninger.

jobs.title: Software Engineer (Full Stack) .NET Core, Java
jobs.description:
Key Responsibilities
  
  

**Backend Development:**  

1\. Design, develop, and maintain microservices architecture using .NET Core,.NET 8 and Java.
  
  

2\. Implement event\-driven architecture to enable seamless communication between microservices.
  
  

3\. Utilize Entity Framework (EF) for efficient database interactions and management.
  
  

4\. Containerize applications using Docker for scalability and deployment flexibility.
  
  

5\. Apply Domain\-Driven Design (DDD) principles to ensure clean and modular code architecture.
  
  

6\. Implement OAuth for secure authentication and authorization.
  
  

7\. Develop and enforce security best practices to safeguard sensitive data and systems.
  
  

8\. Utilize AWS services such as S3, Lambda, API Gateway, RDS, etc., for backend development.
  
  

9\. Develop RESTful APIs endpoints to facilitate communication between the frontend and backend.
  
  

10\. Apply Spec Driven Development (SDD) concepts in development of code via Claude AI technologies.
  
  

11\. Support and maintain legacy .NET Framework (4\.x) applications, including migration pathways to modern .NET where applicable.
  
  

12\. Manage application hosting and deployment on IIS and Windows Server environments, including environment\-specific configuration management using config transformations.
  
  

**Frontend Development:**  

1\. Develop responsive and user\-friendly web applications using ASP.NET, including WebForm applications.
  
  

2\. Generate and review unit tests using generative AI to ensure code quality and reliability.
  
  

3\. Create reusable UI components and maintain a consistent design using Storybook.
  
  

4\. Collaborate closely with UX/UI designers to implement intuitive and visually appealing interfaces.
  
  

5\. Troubleshoot and debug issues across the stack, ensuring smooth application operation.
  
  

6\. Optimize application performance and scalability for a seamless user experience.
  
  

What we are looking for
  
  

Requirements
  
  

:
  
  

1\. Proven professional experience working on .NET Core stack.
  
  

2\. Strong proficiency in .NET Core, .NET 8, C\#, Java and related backend technologies.
  
  

3\. Experience building microservices architecture and implementing event\-driven design patterns.
  
  

4\. Proficiency in Entity Framework (EF) for database management.
  
  

5\. Familiarity with Docker and containerization principles.
  
  

6\. Knowledge of Domain\-Driven Design (DDD) principles and their application in backend development.
  
  

7\. Experience implementing OAuth for authentication and authorization.
  
  

8\. Understanding of security best practices and their application in backend development.
  
  

9\. Hands\-on experience with AWS services such as S3, Lambda, API Gateway, RDS, etc.
  
  

10\. Proficiency in frontend technologies such as HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, ASP.NET and WebForms.
  
  

11\. Experience writing unit tests and maintaining a design system with Storybook.
  
  

12\. Strong problem\-solving skills and attention to detail.
  
  

13\. Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  
  

14\. Knowledge and experience in utilizing generative AI to develop and review codes via Spec Driven Development (SDD).
  
  

15\. Hands\-on experience with legacy .NET Framework (4\.x) applications, including maintenance and incremental modernisation.
  
  

16\. Experience with Oracle databases, including query optimisation and integration with .NET applications.
  
  

17\. Proficiency in deploying and configuring applications on IIS and Windows Server, with working knowledge of Web config transformations for environment\-specific deployments.
  
  

18\. Hands\-on experience with Java Quarkus framework, including building and deploying cloud\-native microservices, with working knowledge of OpenTelemetry for distributed tracing and observability.
  
  

**Preferred Qualifications:**  

19\. Preferably more than 5 years of experience as a full stack software engineer.
  
  

20\. Experience working in both Unix and Windows operating environments are preferred.
  
  

21\. AWS certification (e.g., AWS Certified Developer, AWS Certified Solutions Architect).
  
  

22\. Experience with Node.js for server\-side development.
  
  

23\. Familiarity with RDS databases such as MSSQL.
  
  

24\. Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
  
  

25\. Understanding of Agile development methodologies.
  
  

26\. Experience with event\-driven development patterns and architectures, as well as frontend development using React or other Single Page Application (SPA) frameworks.
  
  

NTT Singapore Pte Ltd (NTTS)
  
  

is the regional headquarters of NTT Communications Corporation (NTT Com) for Asia Pacific Region.
  
  

Established in 1997, NTT Singapore has more than 10 years of expertise in providing information and communications technology (ICT) solutions worldwide.
  
  

NTT Singapore offers diverse high\-quality connectivity, data centre solutions, security services, IT management services, voice and conferencing solutions and solution integration services to its enterprise customers.

jobs.title: Computer Engineer
jobs.description:
WETEC is a leading solution provider specializing in measurement and monitoring systems for a wide range of sectors, including Hydropower Dams, MRT, Railways, Structural Buildings, Wastewater Treatment Plants, Groundwater, Monuments, Highways, Tunnels, Bridges, Landslides, Underground Structures, Airports, Harbours, Renewable Energy Farms, Mines, and Climate Change projects. We also focus on Water, Soil, Crops, Climate, Environmental, Waste, and Physical Survey applications.
  
  

Our aim is to be your total solution partner by sharing our knowledge and expertise to help clients select the most suitable products and solutions for their applications, while providing high\-quality scientific instruments, monitoring systems, and technical support services.
  
  

We are looking for a Computer \& Instrumentation Engineer to help bridge the gap between hardware and software. The successful candidate will assist in developing and supporting scalable applications that communicate with physical IoT devices, while also supporting instrumentation systems, data acquisition equipment, and monitoring solutions. This role offers the opportunity to work across the entire technology stack, from sensors and field instruments to cloud platforms, databases, and user dashboards.
  
  

Key ResponsibilitiesInstrumentation \& IoT Integration
  
  

Install, configure, calibrate, and maintain instrumentation, monitoring systems, sensors, and data loggers.
  
  

Assist in connecting data loggers and sensors to monitoring platforms using industrial communication protocols such as Modbus, RS\-485, MQTT, TCP/IP, and other telemetry technologies.
  
  

Support the deployment, testing, commissioning, and troubleshooting of monitoring systems at project sites.
  
  

Ensure the accuracy, reliability, and proper operation of field instrumentation and monitoring equipment.
  
  

Full\-Stack Development
  
  

Assist in building, maintaining, and enhancing web applications and user dashboards using React, Vue.js, or similar frontend technologies.
  
  

Support backend development using Python, Node.js, or related technologies.
  
  

Participate in the development of scalable applications for real\-time monitoring, data visualization, and reporting.
  
  

API \& Data Management
  
  

Support the design and development of RESTful APIs using frameworks such as FastAPI or Express.js.
  
  

Manage, process, and validate monitoring data from various instrumentation and IoT sources.
  
  

Work with SQL and NoSQL databases to store, retrieve, and analyze monitoring data.
  
  

Assist in developing automated reporting and alerting systems.
  
  

Computer Systems \& Networking
  
  

Configure and maintain computers, servers, network devices, and cloud\-based monitoring systems.
  
  

Troubleshoot hardware, software, networking, and communication issues.
  
  

Support remote monitoring infrastructure and ensure data integrity and security.
  
  

Collaboration \& Project Support
  
  

Work closely with senior engineers, developers, project managers, and stakeholders to troubleshoot issues, refactor code, and improve system performance.
  
  

Assist in equipment selection, technical documentation, and solution implementation.
  
  

Participate in site visits, inspections, and client support activities.
  
  

Prepare technical reports, calibration records, and project documentation.
  
  

Requirements
  
  

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Engineering, Instrumentation Engineering, Electrical \& Electronics Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, or a related field.
  
  

Fresh graduates are encouraged to apply; relevant working experience is an advantage.
  
  

Basic knowledge of instrumentation systems, sensors, data loggers, and monitoring equipment.
  
  

Familiarity with industrial communication protocols such as Modbus, RS\-485, MQTT, TCP/IP, or similar technologies.
  
  

Experience or interest in web development using React, Vue.js, Python, Node.js, or similar technologies.
  
  

Knowledge of SQL and NoSQL databases.
  
  

Familiarity with Git version control.
  
  

Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills.
  
  

Good communication and technical documentation skills.
  
  

Willingness to travel and work at project sites when required.
  
  

Preferred Skills
  
  

Experience with IoT platforms and cloud services.
  
  

Knowledge of SCADA, PLC, telemetry, and data acquisition systems.
  
  

Programming experience in Python, JavaScript, C\+\+, C\#, or similar languages.
  
  

Understanding of environmental, geotechnical, structural, or industrial monitoring systems.
  
  

Experience with Linux environments and network configuration.
  
  

AutoCAD and technical drawing interpretation skills.

jobs.title: Software Test Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Us**  

Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.


At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.


Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**


Information security is an integral part of Visa’s corporate culture. It is essential to maintaining our position as an industry leader in electronic payments, and it is the responsibility of each employee to safeguard information, protect it from unauthorized access, and ensure regulatory compliance. Information security has a significant effect on privacy, consumer confidence, external reputation, and/or the bottom line, and it is a priority on everyone’s agenda.

  

The successful candidate will be part of Visa’s Business\-to\-Business Identity \& Access Management team, which is part of the larger Cybersecurity organization. The B2B IAM team has a global focus and is responsive to an evolving threat landscape, regulatory compliance, IT security requirements, and technology architecture. The B2B IAM team is responsible for secure access to business portals and associated services.

  

The Software Test Engineer will support quality, security, release readiness, and platform stability for B2B IAM applications. This role requires test engineering experience, automation skills, full\-stack application testing exposure, security patch validation support, release validation support, and production\-like environment support experience.


Essential Functions:

* Support test planning, test design, execution, and automation for Java, .NET
* Core, Python, and full\-stack B2B IAM applications.
* Develop and maintain automated tests and scripts using Selenium, Playwright, Postman/Newman, JMeter, Java, Python, or similar tools.
* Perform functional, regression, integration, API, performance, smoke, sanity, and post\-deployment validation testing.
* Support full\-stack application testing and troubleshooting across front\-end, back\-end, database, API, middleware, and infrastructure layers.
* Support QA, staging, pre\-production, and production\-like environments by troubleshooting issues, validating configurations, and helping maintain stability.
* Assist with security patching, vulnerability remediation, dependency upgrades, certificate renewals, middleware updates, and patch validation.
* Assist with release management activities including release readiness, deployment validation, smoke testing, regression testing, release validation support, rollback support, and post\-release validation.
* Help improve platform stability through log analysis, defect investigation, root cause analysis, and collaboration with development, security, and operations teams.
* Conduct API and performance testing using tools such as Postman, SoapUI, OpenAPI/Swagger, JMeter, LoadRunner, or similar tools.
* Work with relational databases and directory services to validate data, write SQL queries, troubleshoot issues, and support IAM workflows.
* Collaborate with developers, product owners, QA engineers, security engineers, operations personnel, and system engineers to support secure and stable delivery.
* Ensure testing activities follow Visa Development Management Methodology, Visa Technical Security Requirements, SSDLC practices, and cybersecurity requirements.
* Use CI/CD, source control, code quality, and DevOps tools such as Jenkins, GitHub, Bitbucket, Artifactory, SonarQube, Checkmarx, Docker, Kubernetes, or similar tools.
* Contribute to test utilities, scripts, dashboards, and automation solutions using Java, Python, JavaScript, REST APIs, SQL, HTML5, CSS3, or similar technologies.
* Support the use of generative AI, agentic tools, and AI\-assisted automation to improve test generation, execution, failure analysis, release validation, and support workflows.
* Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies and create and maintain test cases, test plans, automation scripts, execution reports, and technical documentation.


Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

**Qualifications**


Basic Qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree OR 3\+ years of relevant work experience.

  

Preferred Qualifications:

* Bachelor's degree, OR 3\+ years of relevant work experience
* 2 or more years of work experience.
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, Engineering, or a related technical field is preferred.
* Experience in software quality engineering, test automation, application testing, release validation, or platform support.
* Experience with Java, Python, JavaScript, SQL, shell scripting, or similar programming languages.
* Experience testing Java, .NET Core, Python applications, RESTful services, microservices, and relational databases.
* Experience with automation, API, and performance testing tools such as Selenium, Playwright, Postman/Newman, REST Assured, SoapUI, JMeter, LoadRunner, PyTest, JUnit, TestNG, or Cucumber.
* Experience or familiarity with front\-end technologies such as JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, React, Angular, Node.js, Bootstrap, Webpack, or jQuery.
* Familiarity with JBoss Web Server, Apache Tomcat, Red Hat Linux, MS SQL Server, LDAP, Active Directory, and Windows environments.
* Experience or familiarity with security patching, vulnerability remediation, release validation, deployment support, platform stability, monitoring, log analysis, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis.
* Basic understanding of SSDLC, cybersecurity controls, vulnerability management, application security testing, and tools such as SonarQube, Checkmarx, FindBugs, Black Duck, Veracode, or Fortify.
* Familiarity with CI/CD, DevOps, source control, containerization, and Agile tools such as Jenkins, GitHub, Bitbucket, Artifactory, Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift, Jira, Confluence, Zephyr, or similar tools.
* Experience or familiarity with generative AI, prompt engineering, agentic tools, AI\-assisted automation, and emerging coding/testing practices.
* Strong analytical, debugging, troubleshooting, communication, collaboration, and problem\-solving skills.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**


Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

jobs.title: Programátor/ka Fullstack
jobs.description:
Fullstack u nás neznamená „umí trochu obojí”. Znamená to člověka, který dokáže sám protáhnout změnu celým řetězcem: nové pole v datovém modelu databázová migrace úprava API v živých verzích typy na frontendu formulář a tabulka v mikrofrontendu automatizovaný test. Pracujeme na portálu a katalogu digitálních služeb pro veřejnou správu v oblasti zdravotnictví.

* *Zároveň platí, že zakázky i produkty se u nás v čase mění, podle požadavků zákazníka. Není výjimkou, že se přejde na jiný produkt nebo do jiné domény — třeba z portálu veřejné správy na systém pro nemocnice nebo na energetiku. Popis níže proto ber jako to, co tě čeká na začátku, ne jako popis celé kariéry u nás. Stálé zůstává technologické jádro, velikost systémů, na kterých pracujeme.* ***A nabíráme zároveň na backend a fullstack, takže pokud máš přesah, reaguj klidně sem.***

  

**Co budeš dělat:**



	+ brát si na starost celou funkčnost od datového modelu po uživatelské rozhraní
	+ odhadovat dopad změny napříč systémem — rozpoznat, že úprava vypadající na jeden řádek se dotkne čtyř komponent a dvou verzí API
	+ dělat vlastní analýzu: zadání často dostaneš v podobě, ze které teprve musíš udělat technický návrh
	+ psát testy ke svým změnám na obou stranách**Co potřebuješ umět:**



	+ backend: C\# / .NET 10 a ASP.NET Core, EF Core \+ SQL Server, návrh a verzování REST API
	+ frontend: TypeScript, React 19, práce s daty a formuláři, lokalizace a design tokeny
	+ mikrofrontendy alespoň konceptuálně — jak se moduly skládají dohromady, proč se nasazují nezávisle, co znamená sdílená závislost
	+ silnější analytickou složku než u čistých rolí: doménový slovník, use cases, akceptační kritéria, odhad pracnosti
	+ češtinu na úrovni rodilého mluvčího*Schopnost samostatné IT analýzy — převést nejasný požadavek na zadání s use cases a akceptačními kritérii, zapsat, proč se něco rozhodlo tak a ne jinak, a nevracet se k tomu potřetí. Zákazníkem je veřejná správa, zadání přichází v různé kvalitě a část analytické práce dělá vývojář sám.*


**Buďme realističtí**


Nehledáme rovnoměrnou expertízu. Běžný profil je těžiště v jedné polovině, třeba backendové, plus doložená schopnost samostatně odvést práci i v té druhé.


**Výhodou bude:**


Kafka, cache a telemetrie na úrovni „vím, kdy to použít”, E2E testy, zkušenost s vedením menší funkčnosti napříč týmem.


**Nesedíš přesně do téhle škatulky?**


Nevadí. Tenhle inzerát je na frontend, ale nabíráme na víc rolí najednou — frontend, backend i fullstack. Pokud máš přesah do .NET nebo tě baví vidět věci až dolů do databáze, ozvi se.


**Co můžeme nabídnout:**



	+ 5 týdnů dovolené, relaxační centrum, vzdělávání, HomeOffice či stravenkový paušál. Více se dočtete na https://www.tescosw.cz/kariera/**V případě zájmu kontaktujte personální referentku Moniku Šnajdarovou na tel.: 587 333 555 či emailu** **vyberoverizeni@tescosw.cz****.**

jobs.description:
Spektrum supports apex purchasers (NATO, UN, EU, and National Government and Defence) and their Tier 1 supplier ecosystem with a wide range of specialist services. We provide our clients with professional services, specialised aerospace and defence sales, delivery, and operational subject matter expertise. We are looking for personnel to join our team and support key client projects.



**Who we are supporting**



The NATO Communication and Information Agency (NCIA) is responsible for providing secure and effective communications and information technology (IT) services to NATO's member countries and its partners. The agency was established in 2012 and is headquartered in Brussels, Belgium.



The NCIA provides a wide range of services, including:


* Cyber Security: The NCIA provides advanced cybersecurity solutions to protect NATO's communication networks and information systems against cyber threats.
* Command and Control Systems: The NCIA develops and maintains the systems used by NATO's military commanders to plan and execute operations.
* Satellite Communications: The NCIA provides satellite communications services to enable secure and reliable communications between NATO forces.
* Electronic Warfare: The NCIA provides electronic warfare services to support NATO's mission to detect, deny, and defeat threats to its communication networks.
* Information Management: The NCIA manages NATO's information technology infrastructure, including its databases, applications, and servers.


Overall, the NCIA plays a critical role in ensuring the security and effectiveness of NATO's communication and information technology capabilities.


**The program**

**Assistance and Advisory Service (AAS)**



The NATO Communications and Information Agency (NCI Agency) is NATO's principal C3 capability deliverer and CIS service provider. It provides, maintains and defends the NATO enterprise\-wide information technology infrastructure to enable Allies to consult together under Article IV, and, when required, stand together in the face of attack under Article V.



To provide these critical services, in the modern evolving dynamic environment the NCI Agency needs to build and maintain high performance\-engaged workforce. The NCI Agency workforce strategically consists of three major categorise's: NATO International Civilians (NIC)'s, Military (Mil), and Interim Workforce Consultants (IWC)'s. The IWCs are a critical part of the overall NCI Agency workforce and make up approximately 15 percent of the total workforce.



### **Software Developer**


### **Role ID – NATOIS\-0049**


**Role Background**



NATO International Staff requires a **Software Developer – Expert Consultant** to support the **Defence Planning and Policy Division, Defence Planning Directorate, Data Analysis Section**.



The role focuses on developing and maintaining solutions for **data collection, analysis and visualisation**, particularly web applications and dashboards supporting defence\-planning data analysis.


**Role Duties and Responsibilities**


* Design, develop and deploy web\-based dashboards.
* Develop and configure web applications using modern web frameworks.
* Develop and test data\-collection solutions.
* Transform and integrate data from classified and unclassified sources into web\-based systems.
* Perform data conversion and preprocessing using **Python APIs and ETL tools**.
* Develop and improve data\-collection tools based on stakeholder requirements.
* Develop and maintain documentation for code, service endpoints and system architecture.
* Support security testing and approval activities.
* Test solutions with stakeholders and ensure requirements are met.
* Develop data\-driven dashboards for senior leadership using **Python and/or Power BI**.
* Support workshops and stakeholder engagements.
* Provide knowledge transfer and training materials.
* Report on progress and identify potential project/timeline risks.
* Brief NATO International Staff and leadership on project progress.


**Essential Skills**


* JavaScript and HTML.
* Modern web development frameworks such as **React, Vue.js or Angular**.
* **MS SQL**.
* **Python** for automation, ETL and data analysis.
* Python libraries including **pandas, NumPy and Matplotlib**.
* Development of data\-driven dashboards using **Python and/or Power BI**.
* Backend services and/or data\-processing pipelines.
* Data integration and preprocessing.
* Git/version control.
* Agile project management.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

  


**Desirable:**


* Practical **.NET** experience


**Experience**


* Minimum **5 years of web development experience** using JavaScript/HTML and frameworks such as React, Vue.js or Angular.
* Extensive MS SQL experience.
* Experience developing dashboards for senior stakeholders.
* Strong Python experience for automation, ETL and analysis.
* Experience building and maintaining backend services or processing pipelines.


**educations and Certifications**


* **Bachelor's Degree** in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Technology or a related field.
* Advanced English.


**Working Location**


**NATO HQ, Brussels, Belgium / Remote**



The contractor has flexibility to work remotely combined with some physical presence at NATO HQ.


**Working Policy**


**Hybrid / flexible remote working with some on\-site presence in Brussels.**



The contractor must be available for contact during approximately half of NATO's official working hours, taking time\-zone differences into account.


* Base period: **1 November – 31 December 2026**
* Base scope: **304 hours**
* Option 1: 2027 – **1,672 hours**
* Option 2: 1 January – 30 June 2028 – **836 hours**
* Travel to NATO HQ may occur **2–3 times during the performance period**, with travel costs included in the quoted price.
* Signed NDA required.


**Travel**


* Some travel to other NATO sites may be required

  


**Security Clearance**


* Valid National or NATO Secret personal security clearance

jobs.title: IT Domain Architect
jobs.description:
#### **Vos missions**


Great assignments await you with our key account clients in rich and varied environments


We are looking for an experienced **IT Domain Architect** to lead the architecture of the **Corporate, AI and Market domain**, ensuring that the IT landscape remains coherent, secure, resilient, operable and future\-proof. The role acts as a strategic bridge between business and IT, translating business capabilities into actionable architecture roadmaps and technical blueprints while ensuring alignment with enterprise strategy, governance standards, regulatory obligations and operational requirements.


The architect will drive domain architecture governance, manage the application and platform portfolio, define long\-term roadmaps, support executive decision\-making through architectural trade\-off analyses, and ensure alignment across business, enterprise, solution, security, platform, data and information architecture disciplines. The position also requires expertise in AI architecture and governance, corporate business domains, integration architecture, SAP environments, and critical infrastructure contexts.


Your missions:


Domain Architecture \& Business Alignment


* Translate business capabilities into IT roadmaps in partnership with Business Architecture.
* Convert business processes into target architectures and implementation blueprints.
* Ensure alignment between business strategy, technology investments and enterprise objectives.
* Maintain a coherent and future\-proof IT landscape across the domain.

Architecture Governance \& Standards


* Define and enforce domain architecture principles, standards and reference architectures.
* Ensure compliance with local and group architecture guidelines.
* Present and defend architectural decisions before the Architectural Review Board (ARB).
* Maintain Architectural Decision Records (ADRs).
* Prevent architectural drift and control technical debt.
* Monitor SLA and OLA performance and report architecture\-related risks.

Portfolio Management


* Maintain the application and platform portfolio within the Enterprise Architecture Repository.
* Establish and maintain a single source of truth for architecture assets.
* Conduct portfolio assessments using methodologies such as Gartner TIME and 6R.
* Identify consolidation and reuse opportunities to reduce costs and technical debt.
* Ensure architecture viability throughout build, run, evolve and retire lifecycle phases.
* Collaborate with IT Application Managers and business stakeholders on portfolio evolution.

Strategic Advisory


* Perform trade\-off analyses covering cost, complexity, risk and business value.
* Support executive decision\-making with architecture recommendations.
* Develop and maintain long\-term domain roadmaps.
* Anticipate regulatory, technological and market evolution.
* Advise senior stakeholders on long\-term architectural impacts and strategic decisions.
* Review solution architectures to ensure domain consistency.

Data, Integration \& Information Architecture


* Govern data models, information architecture and integration patterns.
* Ensure interoperability across enterprise systems, operational systems and analytics platforms.
* Define and support data ownership principles.
* Ensure data quality and semantic consistency across the domain.
* Collaborate closely with Data, Solution, Platform and Enterprise Architects.

Security, Resilience \& Compliance


* Embed security, resilience, availability and compliance requirements into architectures.
* Ensure compliance with regulatory, safety and cyber\-security obligations.
* Define business continuity and disaster recovery architecture measures.
* Address operational risks and critical infrastructure constraints.
  

  

Your activities:  



* Collaborate with Business Architects to define architecture roadmaps.
* Design and maintain IT blueprints supporting business capabilities.
* Define architecture principles, standards and reference architectures.
* Prepare and present architecture reviews to governance boards.
* Create and maintain Architectural Decision Records (ADRs).
* Conduct portfolio assessments using Gartner TIME and 6R frameworks.
* Maintain architecture repositories and application inventories.
* Monitor SLA and OLA performance indicators.
* Identify and manage technical debt risks.
* Perform architecture trade\-off analyses and impact assessments.
* Execute peer reviews of Solution Architecture deliverables.

jobs.title: Software Developer
jobs.description:
Spektrum supports apex purchasers (NATO, UN, EU, and National Government and Defence) and their Tier 1 supplier ecosystem with a wide range of specialist services. We provide our clients with professional services, specialised aerospace and defence sales, delivery, and operational subject matter expertise. We are looking for personnel to join our team and support key client projects.



**Who we are supporting**



The NATO Communication and Information Agency (NCIA) is responsible for providing secure and effective communications and information technology (IT) services to NATO's member countries and its partners. The agency was established in 2012 and is headquartered in Brussels, Belgium.



The NCIA provides a wide range of services, including:


* Cyber Security: The NCIA provides advanced cybersecurity solutions to protect NATO's communication networks and information systems against cyber threats.
* Command and Control Systems: The NCIA develops and maintains the systems used by NATO's military commanders to plan and execute operations.
* Satellite Communications: The NCIA provides satellite communications services to enable secure and reliable communications between NATO forces.
* Electronic Warfare: The NCIA provides electronic warfare services to support NATO's mission to detect, deny, and defeat threats to its communication networks.
* Information Management: The NCIA manages NATO's information technology infrastructure, including its databases, applications, and servers.


Overall, the NCIA plays a critical role in ensuring the security and effectiveness of NATO's communication and information technology capabilities.


**The program**

**Assistance and Advisory Service (AAS)**



The NATO Communications and Information Agency (NCI Agency) is NATO's principal C3 capability deliverer and CIS service provider. It provides, maintains and defends the NATO enterprise\-wide information technology infrastructure to enable Allies to consult together under Article IV, and, when required, stand together in the face of attack under Article V.



To provide these critical services, in the modern evolving dynamic environment the NCI Agency needs to build and maintain high performance\-engaged workforce. The NCI Agency workforce strategically consists of three major categorise's: NATO International Civilians (NIC)'s, Military (Mil), and Interim Workforce Consultants (IWC)'s. The IWCs are a critical part of the overall NCI Agency workforce and make up approximately 15 percent of the total workforce.



### **Software Developer**


### **Role ID – NATOIS\-0049**


**Role Background**



NATO International Staff requires a **Software Developer – Expert Consultant** to support the **Defence Planning and Policy Division, Defence Planning Directorate, Data Analysis Section**.



The role focuses on developing and maintaining solutions for **data collection, analysis and visualisation**, particularly web applications and dashboards supporting defence\-planning data analysis.


**Role Duties and Responsibilities**


* Design, develop and deploy web\-based dashboards.
* Develop and configure web applications using modern web frameworks.
* Develop and test data\-collection solutions.
* Transform and integrate data from classified and unclassified sources into web\-based systems.
* Perform data conversion and preprocessing using **Python APIs and ETL tools**.
* Develop and improve data\-collection tools based on stakeholder requirements.
* Develop and maintain documentation for code, service endpoints and system architecture.
* Support security testing and approval activities.
* Test solutions with stakeholders and ensure requirements are met.
* Develop data\-driven dashboards for senior leadership using **Python and/or Power BI**.
* Support workshops and stakeholder engagements.
* Provide knowledge transfer and training materials.
* Report on progress and identify potential project/timeline risks.
* Brief NATO International Staff and leadership on project progress.


**Essential Skills**


* JavaScript and HTML.
* Modern web development frameworks such as **React, Vue.js or Angular**.
* **MS SQL**.
* **Python** for automation, ETL and data analysis.
* Python libraries including **pandas, NumPy and Matplotlib**.
* Development of data\-driven dashboards using **Python and/or Power BI**.
* Backend services and/or data\-processing pipelines.
* Data integration and preprocessing.
* Git/version control.
* Agile project management.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

  


**Desirable:**


* Practical **.NET** experience


**Experience**


* Minimum **5 years of web development experience** using JavaScript/HTML and frameworks such as React, Vue.js or Angular.
* Extensive MS SQL experience.
* Experience developing dashboards for senior stakeholders.
* Strong Python experience for automation, ETL and analysis.
* Experience building and maintaining backend services or processing pipelines.


**educations and Certifications**


* **Bachelor's Degree** in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Technology or a related field.
* Advanced English.


**Working Location**


**NATO HQ, Brussels, Belgium / Remote**



The contractor has flexibility to work remotely combined with some physical presence at NATO HQ.


**Working Policy**


**Hybrid / flexible remote working with some on\-site presence in Brussels.**



The contractor must be available for contact during approximately half of NATO's official working hours, taking time\-zone differences into account.


* Base period: **1 November – 31 December 2026**
* Base scope: **304 hours**
* Option 1: 2027 – **1,672 hours**
* Option 2: 1 January – 30 June 2028 – **836 hours**

**Travel**


* Some travel to other NATO sites may be required

  


**Security Clearance**

jobs.title: Project Engineer HVAC
jobs.description:
**WE ARE BENTON**
=================


Benton is een toonaangevend, multidisciplinair technisch bureau, gespecialiseerd in Engineering\-, Construction\- en Maintenance\-opdrachten. Als marktleider streven wij naar operationele excellentie door onze ‘yes we can’\-mentaliteit te vervlechten met een buitengewone synergie tussen onze Bentoneers en onze klanten.


…


Oké, genoeg corporate bla\-bla. Dat zijn we dus NIET.


Wat we wél zijn? Een **dynamisch en ambitieus** technisch bureau waar mensen centraal staan. Waar **humor en no\-nonsense** hand in hand gaan met expertise en groei. In plaats van de gebaande paden te volgen, denken we graag twee stappen zijwaarts om het beste in iedereen naar boven te halen. Want **als onze Bentoneers groeien, groeien wij met ze mee.**


Ben jij een **Projectingenieur HVAC** die warmloopt voor duurzame technieken? Voor een speler binnen de HVAC\-sector in **regio Waasland** zoeken we iemand die projecten van ontwerp tot oplevering in goede banen leidt. Je combineert technische kennis met coördinatie en houdt daarbij klanten, leveranciers, planning én budget op dezelfde temperatuur.


**JOBOMSCHRIJVING**
===================


* **Engineering \& ontwerp** – Je stelt uitvoeringsdossiers op aan de hand van ontwerpberekeningen en werkt hydraulische, aerolische en elektrische schema’s verder uit.
* **Technische afstemming** – Je overlegt met klanten en leveranciers, vertaalt technische vragen naar concrete oplossingen en vraagt de nodige offertes op.
* **AutoCAD \& BIM** – Je maakt uitvoeringstekeningen in AutoCAD en zet waar nodig BIM\-toepassingen in om het project technisch tot in de puntjes voor te bereiden.
* **Projectcoördinatie** – Je plaatst bestellingen, coördineert leveringen en volgt de installatie van HVAC\-systemen op van voorbereiding tot uitvoering.
* **Werfopvolging** – Je begeleidt de montage op de werf, bewaakt de kwaliteit van de uitvoering en houdt overzicht over planning en budget.
* **Opstart \& oplevering** – Je optimaliseert en start installaties op, verzorgt de overdracht naar de klant en rondt het project administratief, financieel en met een volledig as\-built dossier af.

**PROFIEL**
===========


* Een **bachelor\- of masterdiploma** binnen HVAC\-techniek of een relevante technische richting.
* Relevante **ervaring met HVAC\-installaties**, van ontwerp en realisatie tot opstart en optimalisatie.
* Goede kennis van **AutoCAD** en bij voorkeur ervaring met **BIM\-toepassingen**.
* Een **oplossingsgerichte en nauwkeurige** aanpak, gecombineerd met sterke communicatieve skills en het vermogen om het hoofd koel te houden wanneer een project wat warmer wordt.
* Basiskennis van **Nederlands, Frans en Engels** is een plus, net als een sterke aandacht voor **mens en milieu**.

**ONZE MEERWAARDE VOOR JOU**
============================


* Buiten het **aantrekkelijk salarispakket**, krijg je ook nog tal van **extralegale voordelen** zoals je eerste bedrijfswagen, tankkaart, groeps\- en hospitalisatieverzekering, netto onkostenvergoeding, …
* Als Bentoneer kan je blijven leren en groeien. Je krijgt van ons **persoonlijke begeleiding, professionele opleidingen** en een **jaarlijks opleidingsbudget**.
* Met **gespecialiseerde trainingen** en onze eigen **Benton Academy** ontwikkel je je als Projectingenieur HVAC. Ontdek nieuwe domeinen, verbreed je kennis en ontketen je verborgen talenten!
* Via Benton krijg je de kans om jouw **cv te verrijken** met **projecten bij grote spelers**. Spelers die tot de klantenportefeuille van Benton behoren en waar we jou met alle plezier voorstellen.
* Door mee te gaan in onze geheime formule voor succes en plezier, zal je ook deel uit maken van een **warm nest** waar we passionately personal omgaan met elkaar, waardoor we samen de organisatie laten groeien.
* We geloven sterk in de kracht van **zelfontwikkeling** en het **ondernemen** van kansen in je carrière. Samen zorgen we ervoor dat jouw talent goed wordt benut door je aan te moedigen om je **talenten** te **ontplooien**.

jobs.title: Go-to-Market Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Predikt**
-----------------


‍


Predikt is a dynamic Swiss\-Belgian deeptech company at the forefront of innovation, developing cutting\-edge AI\-driven technology. We are an AI\-driven cost \& margin intelligence platform built for enterprise procurement and finance teams, providing unmatched visibility into external cost drivers and their impact on margins. We empower organizations to navigate market volatility, proactively manage risks, protect profitability and make confident, data\-driven decisions. As an early\-stage startup, we are fueled by a strong sense of mission and enthusiasm, striving to make cost intelligence accessible to every procurement and finance leader across the globe.


‍


At Predikt, we are defined by our core values and high ambitions. We are a company that champions integrity, innovation and excellence, creating an environment where everyone supports each other and works collaboratively towards common goals. Our customer\-centric approach ensures we deliver exceptional value and service, while fostering a culture of mutual respect, open communication, and continuous improvement.


‍


Join us on this exciting journey as we transform the way procurement and finance teams understand and act on cost and create a future where volatility is no longer a threat, but a challenge every organization is equipped to face with confidence.


Predikt turns market volatility into structured, forward\-looking cost and margin intelligence for procurement, finance and commercial teams at global CPG and Food \& Beverage enterprises. Our product is live with enterprise customers, and we're now building our commercial team.


Our buyers are a few hundred large enterprises. Deals are significant, sales cycles are long, and decisions involve procurement, finance and the C\-suite. That means go\-to\-market here is about precision, not volume: knowing exactly which accounts and people matter, finding the warmest way in, reaching them at the right moment, and making sure nothing falls through the cracks.


As our Go\-to\-Market Engineer, you build the engine that turns our target account list into pipeline: the data, systems and automation behind it. You'll work side by side with the founders, who lead our enterprise sales today, and with the Marketing Manager and Account Executive we're adding to the team.


This role sits at the intersection of marketing, sales and engineering. You won't write product code with our core engineering team, and you're not an SDR chasing call volume. You own the machine that makes our commercial team faster and sharper, and you'll run parts of it yourself while we build it.

**What you'll do**

* Build and maintain our target account data: our priority accounts, their buying committees (procurement, finance, C\-suite) and the signals that tell us when to engage, such as leadership changes, input cost pressure, relevant hiring or tooling renewals.
* Map warm routes into those accounts through our network, investors, partners and existing customers, and make them usable for the team.
* Design and run signal\-based outreach that reaches several people per account with messages that are relevant to what just changed for them, across email, LinkedIn and events.
* Own our CRM and GTM stack: clean data, clear pipeline stages, and workflows the team actually uses.
* Support account\-based campaigns and events together with Marketing: targeting, audiences, follow\-up flows and measuring what works.
* Help us grow inside existing customers by mapping the next business units, categories and use cases where Predikt can add value.
* Build tools and AI workflows that help the team research, qualify and follow up faster, for example account briefs before meetings, a reusable library for RFP answers and first drafts of proposals.
* Bring the data on what actually converts into our positioning, messaging and ideal customer profile, together with the founders, Marketing, Sales and Product.
* Continuously test and improve how we generate and qualify pipeline, and fix what's broken without waiting to be asked.

**What success looks like**


After 90 days:

* Our priority accounts and their buying committees are mapped and live in HubSpot, with warm routes identified.
* A first signal\-based outreach flow is running and booking meetings.


After one year:

* A clean, reliable view of our priority accounts and a CRM the whole team trusts.
* A repeatable engine that consistently books qualified meetings with decision\-makers at our target accounts, with the founders spending far less time on prospecting.
* Clear pipeline reporting: where opportunities come from, how they move, and what we should do more (or less) of.

**Our current stack**

* **HubSpot** as our CRM and single source of truth
* **lemlist** for sequencing and outreach
* **LinkedIn Sales Navigator** for account and people research
* **Notion** for call recording and meeting notes
* **Notion** for documentation, account plans and internal knowledge
* **Claude** and other AI tools for research, drafting and automation


This is where we are today, not a fixed list. If you know a better tool for the job, we're open to it. You'll have a real say in how the stack evolves.

**What you bring**

* Experience in B2B go\-to\-market, growth, RevOps or demand generation, ideally in a start\-up or scale\-up selling software to enterprises.
* A technical, hands\-on streak: you can script, automate, work with APIs and data, and you enjoy building your own tools.
* Hands\-on experience with modern GTM tooling such as HubSpot or Salesforce, Clay or similar enrichment platforms, and sequencing tools, plus a curiosity for how AI can make them smarter.
* An analytical mind: comfortable with data and dashboards, and with turning numbers into decisions.
* Strong commercial instinct and the ability to understand enterprise software well enough to speak about it credibly with senior buyers.
* An entrepreneurial, "get it done" mentality: comfortable starting from a blank page, iterating fast and shipping something that works rather than perfecting it in theory.
* Fluent in English. Dutch, French or German is a plus.

**What we offer**
-----------------


**Pay \& perks**

* A competitive salary and a stock option plan, so you share in the growth you help create.
* Meal vouchers of €8 per working day.
* Eco vouchers worth €250 per year.
* A net allowance of €175 per month for working from home and using your own equipment.


**Getting around**

* Mobility budget or company car via Lizy: you choose what fits your life.
* Bike lease option.
* Our Leuven office is a 2\-minute walk from the train station.


**Health**

* Hospitalisation insurance via Alan.


**Flexibility**

* Hybrid work, split between our Leuven office and home.
* Work from abroad for up to 3 weeks a year.
* Bring your own device: work with the tools you know best.
* A flexible reward plan is planned for 2027, so you can shape part of your package yourself.


**Team \& culture**

* A yearly offsite, sometimes in the Swiss Alps, sometimes closer to home.
* Plenty of moments together throughout the year: drinks, our Christmas dinner and other team activities.
* A culture of radical transparency, where open and honest communication is the norm.
* An early\-stage startup that's growing fast, with room to take on more if you want it.

jobs.title: System Engineer (m/v/x)
jobs.description:
**System Engineer (m/v/x)**

Gabitasoft is een full\-service IT\-integrator uit Kapellen met een sterke focus op de dentale sector. Onze missie is om klanten dagelijks te ontzorgen van hun IT\-werkzaamheden zodat zij zich volop kunnen focussen op hun kernactiviteiten. Met meer dan 20 jaar ervaring zijn wij uitgegroeid tot een gevestigde waarde met een groot aantal tevreden klanten.

**Functieomschrijving**

Door de snelle groei van ons bedrijf zijn we op zoek naar een enthousiaste System Engineer.

Als System Engineer ben je de technische spil op kantoor. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de volledige technische voorbereiding van IT\-installaties: je configureert en test hardware\- en softwareomgevingen, zodat onze IT Engineers deze vlot en efficiënt bij de klant kunnen implementeren. Daarnaast ben je het aanspreekpunt voor de Service Desk bij complexe technische problemen (third line support).

**Volgende zaken behoren tot jouw takenpakket:**

* Je bereidt IT\-installaties volledig voor op kantoor (servers, netwerken, firewalls, werkstations en softwareconfiguraties).
* Je stelt duidelijke documentatie en installatieprocedures op en maakt waar nodig technische handleidingen, zodat collega’s er ook in de toekomst op kunnen terugvallen.
* Je registreert je activiteiten nauwkeurig en zorgt voor correcte technische documentatie in het ticketsysteem.
* Je fungeert als third line support: je neemt complexe tickets over van de Service Desk, zoekt de oorzaak en zorgt voor een structurele oplossing.
* Je deelt je kennis met de Service Desk, zodat zij steeds meer zelfstandig kunnen oplossen.
* Je denkt mee over de standaardisatie en automatisatie van onze installaties en processen.
* Je rapporteert aan de Project Manager en werkt nauw samen met de IT Engineers binnen het projectteam.
* Je werkt voornamelijk vanuit ons kantoor in Kapellen.

**Profiel**

* Je hebt een sterke interesse in IT en houdt je graag op de hoogte van nieuwe technologieën.
* Je hebt minstens 2 jaar relevante werkervaring als system engineer, IT engineer of in een vergelijkbare technische functie.
* Microsoft Windows en Microsoft 365 zijn voor jou geen onbekende.
* Je hebt ervaring in meerdere van volgende domeinen: serverbeheer (zoals Windows Server, Active Directory, GPO’s), virtualisatie (bv. Hyper\-V), firewalls, camera\- en toegangssystemen, netwerkbeheer (LAN, WLAN, switches, routering, VLAN’s, DHCP, …).
* Kennis van scripting (zoals PowerShell of Python) is een pluspunt, gezien onze toenemende focus op automatisatie.
* Ervaring met algemene clouddiensten zoals Microsoft Azure en Amazon Web Services is een voordeel, net als kennis van Entra ID, Intune en VoIP\-telefonie.
* Certificeringen (bv. Microsoft, netwerk of security) zijn een plus.
* Ervaring in de dentale sector is niet vereist: wij leiden je op in de specifieke software en toestellen.
* Je werkt gestructureerd en nauwkeurig.
* Je denkt analytisch en probleemoplossend en gaat bij complexe problemen op zoek naar de echte oorzaak.
* Je haalt voldoening uit het technisch correct voorbereiden en optimaliseren van IT\-omgevingen.
* Je werkt graag in teamverband en deelt je kennis met collega’s.
* Je spreekt en schrijft vlot Nederlands en hebt een goede kennis van het Engels.
* Je hebt rijbewijs B.

**Aanbod**

* Je maakt deel uit van een hartelijk en familiaal team met een open werksfeer én een hart voor mensen.
