jobs.title: Vacuum / Thin film coating Technical Engineer (TE-VSC-SCC-2026-234-GRAE)
jobs.description:
**Job Description**  

Are you an enthusiastic and curious Technical Engineer looking for a challenging professional experience? If so, joining CERN's ORIGIN programme may be the perfect opportunity for you.


As a Technical Engineer in the surface coating and chemistry team, you will contribute to the production of thin films for CERN's accelerator complex. All necessary training on the specific coating set ups and instrumentation will be given.

**Your responsibilities**

* Operate Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD) coating setups (sputtering): including assembly, vacuum pumping, bakeout, deposition processing, and disassembly.
* Measure the thickness and composition of thin films using an X\-Ray Fluorescence spectrometer.
* Perform validation and quality control of the performance of Non\-Evaporable Getter coatings (NEG).
* Prepare technical documentation, including reports and procedures.
* Contribute to the design, procurement, and assembly of tooling for the coating setups.

**Your profile**

* Experience in the areas of vacuum technology and the use of vacuum instrumentation, including vacuum pumps.
* Experience in materials for vacuum.
* Basic knowledge in materials properties and characterisation.
* Practical experience in thin films coating is an advantage.
* Familiarity with surface treatments and their execution/preparation is an advantage.
* Experience in Ultra\-high vacuum is an advantage.


Skills

* Ability to work in groups and actively participate in team activities.
* Ability to work independently and communicate progress, priorities and challenges in your work.
* Knowledge and use of Excel and Word, Labview is a plus.
* Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.


Eligibility criteria:

* You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State.
* **By the application deadline,** you have a **maximum of two years of professional experience since graduation** in Vacuum and Material Sciences (or a related field) **and** **your highest educational qualification is either a Bachelor's or Master's degree**.
* You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.
* Applicants without University degree are not eligible.
* Applicants with a PhD are not eligible.

  

**Additional Information**  

Job closing date: **21\.10\.2026 at 23:59 CEST.**


Contract duration: 24 months, with a possible extension up to 36 months maximum.


Working hours: 40 hours per week


Job flexibility: Fully Onsite


Target start date: 01\-January\-2027


This position involves:

* Work in Radiation Areas.
* Interventions in underground installations.
* Work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organization.


Job reference: TE\-VSC\-SCC\-2026\-234\-GRAE


Field of work: Chemical, Materials \& Process Engineering


Benchmark job: 301180 \- Material Science/Chemical Technical Engineer

**Global Benefits**

* A monthly net stipend of either 5266 or 5793 Swiss Francs per month depending on your degree.
* 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.
* Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.
* Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.
* A relocation package (installation grant and travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.
* Possibility to extend your contract up to 36 months.
* On\-the\-job and formal training including language classes.

**Overview of CERN \- Discover a world where the impossible is made possible!**


At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.


Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting\-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success.


If you are ready to be part of a dynamic, inclusive community pushing the boundaries of knowledge, CERN is the place where your curiosity and skills can thrive. Be part of our mission to uncover what lies at the heart of the universe! **TAKE PART!**

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Asset Sales
jobs.description:
**Join our expanding engineering team!**


We're hiring a permanent Senior Backend Engineer to join our Asset Sales group as we scale one of the most important parts of M\-KOPA's FinTech platform. Build distributed, event\-driven microservices and help shape what AI\-native engineering looks like at M\-KOPA.

**The Impact**

Your code will directly power the systems that put smartphones and e\-motorbikes into the hands of Every Day Earners across Africa. We've already helped over 10 million customers access more than $2 billion in credit. It's your chance to be part of something that's literally transforming lives across an entire continent


**The Opportunity**


**Mission\-driven engineering**: Every service you build helps expand financial inclusion for under\-banked populations


**Global recognition**: Join a company named by the Financial Times as one of Africa's fastest\-growing companies for five consecutive years (2022–2026\)


**Scale challenges**: Build backend systems serving millions across multiple African markets


**AI\-native from day one**: We're actively embracing AI as part of the engineering craft, not bolting it on


**Fully distributed**: Work remotely with diverse teams across UK, Europe, and Africa

**What You'll Do**


At M\-KOPA, you'll build and operate distributed C\# and .NET microservices on Azure, working within an event\-driven architecture at significant scale. This is an outcomes\-driven role: we care far more about the value you create than where you sit or how many hours you're online. You'll own what you build end\-to\-end — from idea, through implementation and deployment, into production and iteration.

**Technical Environment**

* **Modern C\# stack**: Distributed C\# and .NET microservices
* **Cloud \& orchestration**: Hosted on Azure using Kubernetes
* **Architecture**: Event\-driven, supporting products used at significant scale
* **Observability**: Grafana, Azure Application Insights, logs, traces, and metrics
* **AI tooling**: Claude and other AI tools used throughout the engineering workflow — design exploration, code generation and review, test writing, incident investigation, and technical communication

**Our Engineering Approach**

* **AI\-native engineering**: We want engineers who tinker — experimenting with new tools, agents, and workflows, and sharing what works
* **Guardrails as we accelerate**: Automated tests, SLOs, alerting, observability, and deployment safeguards around everything we ship
* **Own it beyond the pull request**: Design for idempotency, retries, out\-of\-order events, and failure modes, and know how your services behave in production
* **The Campfire Rule**: Leave the systems you touch a little better than you found them
* **On\-call as feedback, not heroics**: Engineers who build our systems also help operate them, using incidents to make the platform more resilient

**What You Need**


We're looking for a senior engineer who's curious, autonomous, and highly trusted. You're comfortable owning the entire software stack — including supporting infrastructure — throughout its lifecycle, and you see production data, not just deployment, as the real measure of "done."

**Required Experience:**

* Strong grasp of C\# and .NET development
* Experience with event\-driven systems \- We use Azure Service Bus, but would love to hear from you if you have experience with similar messaging technology (Kafka, RabbitMQ, etc.)
* Microservices architecture experience, ideally on Azure and Kubernetes
* Experience using observability tooling (e.g. Grafana, Application Insights) to understand production behaviour
* Comfort using AI tools as part of a daily engineering workflow (design, code review, testing, incident investigation)
* DevOps culture mindset, including on\-call/production ownership
* Proven ability to collaborate effectively in distributed teams across time zones
* Continuous learning mindset and openness to feedback

**Location \& Benefits**

* Fully remote role, collaborating during core GMT working hours
* Work with diverse teams distributed across UK, Europe, and Africa
* Personalised training budget to support your development
* Home office setup budget
* Professional development programs and coaching partnerships
* Family\-friendly policies and flexible working arrangements
* Well\-being support and career growth opportunities

**Our Mission**

We create financial inclusion for the traditionally excluded through a fair, flexible, customer\-centric financing model. We strive to drive greater inclusion of women, youth, and low\-income communities.

**Our Impact**

Our technology has created measurable change:

* **Connected** : 2\.5 million first\-time smartphone users connected
* **Prosperous** : 70% of customers use M\-KOPA products for income generation, with 35,000 livelihoods created for agents
* **Green** : 2\.155 million tonnes of CO₂ avoided since 2010 through clean energy, refurbished devices, and e\-mobility

**Ready to build C\#/.NET systems — with AI as part of your craft — that create real\-world financial inclusion? Apply Now!**

**Why M\-KOPA?**
----------------


At M\-KOPA, we empower our people to own their careers through diverse development programs, coaching partnerships, and on\-the\-job training. We support individual journeys with family\-friendly policies, prioritize well\-being, and embrace flexibility.


Join us in shaping the future of M\-KOPA as we grow together. Explore more at **m\-kopa.com**.

*Recognized four times by the Financial Times as one Africa's fastest growing companies (2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026\), named on CNBC's World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025 \& 2026 and by TIME100 Most influential companies in the world 2023 and 2024 , we've served over 10 million customers, unlocking $2 billion in cumulative credit for the everyday earners across Africa, in addition to over 10,000 e\-bikes financed in Kenya.*

***Important Notice***  

  

*M\-KOPA is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer committed to assembling a diverse, broadly trained staff. Women, minorities, and people with disabilities are strongly encouraged to apply.*

*M\-KOPA explicitly prohibits the use of Forced or Child Labour and respects the rights of its employees to agree to terms and conditions of employment voluntarily, without coercion, and freely terminate their employment on appropriate notice. M\-KOPA shall ensure that its Employees are of legal working age and shall comply with local laws for youth employment or student work, such as internships or apprenticeships.*

*M\-KOPA does not collect/charge any money as a pre\-employment or post\-employment requirement. This means that we never ask for ‘recruitment fees’, ‘processing fees’, ‘interview fees’, or any other kind of money in exchange for offer letters or interviews at any time during the hiring process.*

*Applications for this position will be reviewed on a rolling basis. Shortlisting and interviews will take place at any stage during the recruitment process. We reserve the right to close the vacancy early if a suitable candidate is selected before the advertised closing date.*

*If your application is successful M\-KOPA undertakes pre\-employment background checks as part of its recruitment process, these include; criminal records, identification verification, academic qualifications, employment dates and employer references.*

jobs.description:
Location:
Szekesfehervar \- Fejer, Hungary \- Holland
Job Family:
Quality
Worker Type Reference:
Regular \- Permanent

Salary

R\-55746\-2026
  
### **Description \& Requirements**


**Introduction: A Career at HARMAN Automotive**


We’re a global, multi\-disciplinary team that’s putting the innovative power of technology to work and transforming tomorrow. At HARMAN Automotive, we give you the keys to fast\-track your career.


* Engineer audio systems and integrated technology platforms that augment the driving experience
* Combine ingenuity, in\-depth research, and a spirit of collaboration with design and engineering excellence
* Advance in\-vehicle infotainment, safety, efficiency, and enjoyment
  

  

**What You’ll Be Part Of**


We are seeking a quality\-focused professional to lead and drive Development Quality Activities for local OEMs. This role also involves overseeing sample builds, conducting process audits, and ensuring adherence to high\-quality standards throughout hardware product development. The ideal candidate will support DFMEA reviews and collaborate with cross\-functional teams to define and enforce quality standards. Additionally, the role includes managing customer audits, resolving quality issues, and ensuring release readiness in the pilot factory.
  

  

**How You’ll Make An Impact**


* **Lead customer audits during development**, ensuring full compliance with quality criteria, documentation, and customer requirements.
* Oversee and ensure high\-quality sample builds during development phases in the pilot factory, ensuring all builds meet required specifications and customer expectations.
* **Serve as the primary quality contact** during the development stage for local OEMs, managing product quality status, customer milestones (ML reviews), and resolving any quality concerns.
* **Lead and drive Development Quality Activities** for local OEMs, ensuring the highest quality standards are maintained throughout the entire product development lifecycle.
* **Apply core automotive quality tools** (APQP, PPAP, ASPICE, FMEA) to ensure consistent quality throughout hardware product development, leading DFMEA reviews and FBA sessions.
* **Conduct comprehensive process audits** during design sample builds, identifying potential risks early and implementing corrective actions to maintain top\-tier quality.
* **Drive continuous improvement initiatives** to enhance the overall quality and reliability of hardware products, integrating DFMEA and PLM best practices.
* **Investigate and resolve hardware\-related issues** reported by customers or internal teams using structured problem\-solving methods (e.g., 8D, A3\).
* **Collaborate with cross\-functional teams** (design, AME, manufacturing, supply chain) to define, implement, and enforce robust quality standards for hardware products.
* **Maintain a lessons\-learned database**, transferring valuable insights from past projects to new initiatives, and ensuring continuous improvement across projects.
* **Partner with hardware designers** to proactively identify and resolve potential quality issues early in the design phase, offering actionable quality feedback during design reviews.
* **Ensure release readiness in the pilot factory**, track project development KPIs, and implement risk assessments and preventative quality measures throughout the design process.
* **Provide guidance and training to team members** on HARMAN BMS Process (IATF 16949, ISO9001, ASPICE, etc.), EU customer quality requirements, automotive core tools, PLM gate processes, DFMEA, and problem\-solving methodologies.
  

  

**What Makes You A Strong Fit**


* Degree in Electronics \& Communications, electrical engineering, Mechanical/Automotive Engineering preferred.
* 5\-8 years of experience in hardware development and quality assurance, preferably in the automotive industry.
* Strong knowledge of automotive core tools including APQP, PPAP, and FMEA, ASPICE, VDA6\.3
* Experience with PLM gate processes and product lifecycle management systems.
* Demonstrated expertise in problem\-solving methodologies such as 8D, A3, or similar.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in cross\-functional teams.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance the overall quality and reliability of hardware products, integrating DFMEA and PLM best practices.
  

  

**Bonus Points if You Have**


* Experience with automotive industry standards such as ISO 9001, IATF 16949, ASPICE, and VDA 6\.3\.
* Thorough understanding of the hardware product development lifecycle, gate reviews, etc.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to interact effectively across teams and with customers.
* Experience in managing customer audits and addressing complex quality\-related issues.
* Proficiency in advanced problem\-solving tools like 8D, A3, and Fishbone Diagrams.
  

  

**What Makes You Eligible**


* Strong knowledge of automotive core tools including APQP, PPAP, and FMEA
* Be willing to collaborate with global cross\-functional teams.
* Be willing to travel up to 15%, including international travel
  

  

**What You Can Expect**


* A hybrid work environment that balances flexibility with in\-person collaboration, with most office\-based roles onsite three days a week.
* Access to employee discounts on HARMAN and Samsung products (including JBL, Harman / Kardon, AKG, and others)
* Learning and development opportunities through our award\-winning HARMAN University programs
* Wellness benefits designed to support your overall well\-being
* Tuition reimbursement support
* Access to the HARMAN campus fitness center and cafeteria, where available
* An inclusive and diverse work environment that supports both your professional and personal development
  

  

\#LI\-DP3

  

  

**Pay Transparency**
Ft 9,270,000 \- Ft 13,596,000
The above represents the annual gross base salary range for this role.  

  

**Variable compensation and allowances:** Dependent on the position offered, other forms of compensation may also be available, such as quarterly or annual bonus pay, commission payments, long term incentive compensation, or certain allowances. Further details will be made available as part of the recruitment process.  

  

**How we set pay:** The pay posted is a reasonable estimate of the wage range anticipated for this position. Pay is determined using objective, job\-related criteria such as relevant experience, skills, role scope/responsibilities, and location\-based market factors (where applicable). In appropriate circumstances, based on objective, job\-related factors, the final determination on pay may deviate from the posted range.  

  

**Pay history:** Please do not include current or past pay information in your application. We do not request pay history as part of our recruitment process.  

  

**Benefits:** HARMAN is interested in supporting the health and wellbeing of employees and offers a range of benefits. Offerings vary by country and employment arrangement and reflect a combination of statutory requirements and company\-provided programs. These may include paid time off and holidays, sick and family leave, as well as health and wellbeing support and retirement or savings plans where applicable, along with other locally relevant benefits. Further details will be made available as part of the recruitment process.  

  

**About HARMAN: Where Innovation Unleashes Next\-Level Technology**
Ever since the 1920s, we’ve been amplifying the sense of sound. Today, that legacy endures, with integrated technology platforms that make the world smarter, safer, and more connected.  

  

Across automotive, lifestyle, and digital transformation solutions, we create innovative technologies that turn ordinary moments into extraordinary experiences. Our renowned automotive and lifestyle solutions can be found everywhere, from the music we play in our cars and homes to venues that feature today’s most sought\-after performers, while our digital transformation solutions serve humanity by addressing the world’s ever\-evolving needs and demands. Marketing our award\-winning portfolio under 16 iconic brands, such as JBL, Mark Levinson, and Revel, we set ourselves apart by exceeding the highest engineering and design standards for our customers, our partners and each other.  

  

If you’re ready to innovate and do work that makes a lasting impact, join our talent community today!  

  

**Important Notice: Recruitment Scams**
Please be aware that HARMAN recruiters will always communicate with you from an '@harman.com', ‘@careers.harman.com’ or ‘@harmanglobal.avature.net’ email address. We will never ask for payments, banking, credit card, personal financial information or access to your LinkedIn/email account during the screening, interview, or recruitment process. If you are asked for such information or receive communication from an email address not ending in one of the above email domains about a job with HARMAN, please cease communication immediately and report the incident to us through: harmancareers@harman.com.  

  

**You Belong Here**
HARMAN is committed to making every employee feel welcomed, valued, and empowered. No matter what role you play, we encourage you to share your ideas, voice your distinct perspective, and bring your whole self with you – all within a support\-minded culture that celebrates what makes each of us unique. We also recognize that learning is a lifelong pursuit and want you to flourish. We proudly offer added opportunities for training, development, and continuing education, further empowering you to live the career you want.  

  

HARMAN is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. HARMAN strives to hire the best qualified candidates and is committed to building a workforce representative of the diverse marketplaces and communities of our global colleagues and customers. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. HARMAN attracts, hires, and develops employees based on merit, qualifications and job\-related performance.(www.harman.com)  

  

HARMAN is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance or an accommodation during the application process, please contact us at harmancareers@harman.com. Requests will be considered on a case\-by\-case basis in accordance with applicable law.

jobs.title: Full Stack Developer
jobs.description:
Miért az SMP?
  

  

Nagy létszámú nemzetközi csapatunk négy kontinensen, szakismerettel és készséggel dolgozik közös célunkon, hogy minőségi alkatrészeket készítsünk prémium kategóriás autókhoz.
  

  

A kecskeméti SMP gyár a Samvardhana Motherson Group fontos részeként működik, amely a világ 26 legnagyobb autóipari beszállítója közé tartozik.
  

  

Munkatársaink csapatban dolgoznak, támogatják egymást és mindig készek arra, hogy valami újat tanuljanak.
  

  

Büszkék vagyunk arra, hogy munkánk eredménye részese a világ piacvezető autómárkáinak!
  

  

Folyamatosan fejlesztjük munkafolyamatainkat és törekszünk termékeink tökéletesítésére.
  

  

Ehhez szükségünk van Rád, hiszen tehetséged jelentős tovább lépést biztosít számunkra is!
  

  

Versenyképes juttatási csomagot kínálunk, mely felelősségteljes, önálló munkával párosul. Az autóipar világa érdekes és kihívásokkal teli, mindemellett családias kultúra jellemzi vállalatunkat. Fejlődési és továbblépési lehetőséget biztosítunk Számodra, egy gyorsan növekvő globális vállalatnál.
  
**Full Stack Developer**
========================


A Motherson Group a világ 21\. legnagyobb és leggyorsabban növekvő globális autóipari cégcsoportja, amely több további iparágat, például járműipart, repülőgépipart, orvostudományt, informatikát és logisztikát szolgál ki, és több mint 135 000 alkalmazottal rendelkezik Világszerte 41 országban vagyunk jelen. Az elnök európai irodája (COE) vállalati funkciókkal és szolgáltatásokkal támogatja és koordinálja működési egységeinket, K \+ F központjainkat és képviseleteinket Európa szerte. Gyors növekedésünk miatt folyamatosan keresünk tehetséges új kollégákat, hogy részeseivé váljanak csapatunknak.
### **Feladatok:**


* Own assigned applications, modules, or projects end to end, including planning, estimation, design, development, testing,
* release, and post\-go\-live support.
* Develop responsive, maintainable, and user\-friendly web interfaces using Angular, TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS.
* Design and develop secure backend services and REST APIs using C\#, .NET / .NET Core, ASP.NET Core, and Entity
* Framework Core or Dapper.
* Design relational data models and write efficient T\-SQL, stored procedures, functions, views, and database objects in
* Microsoft SQL Server.
* Diagnose and resolve performance issues across the frontend, API, and database layers, including query optimization,
* indexing, and root\-cause analysis.
* Translate business requirements into practical technical solutions and communicate progress, risks, dependencies, and
* trade\-offs to stakeholders.
* Integrate applications with enterprise systems and third\-party services using APIs, scheduled jobs, files, or messaging
* interfaces.
* Write unit and integration tests, participate in code reviews, and maintain clean, reusable, secure, and well\-documented
* code.
* Use Git\-based source control and support build, release, and CI/CD processes through tools such as Azure DevOps or
* equivalent platforms.
* Provide production support for business\-critical applications, document recurring issues, and implement permanent
* corrective actions.

### **Elvárások:**


* Minimum 5 years of professional full stack software development experience.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Angular and TypeScript in production applications.
* Strong hands\-on experience with C\#, .NET / .NET Core, ASP.NET Core, Web API, and object\-oriented programming.
* Advanced Microsoft SQL Server and T\-SQL skills, including schema design, complex joins, stored procedures, indexing,
* execution plans, and performance tuning.
* Demonstrated experience independently delivering at least one substantial application or project from requirements to
* production support.
* Solid understanding of RESTful API design, authentication and authorization, error handling, logging, and secure coding
* practices.
* Experience with Git, branching and pull\-request workflows, debugging, code review, and standard software development
* lifecycle practices.
* Ability to troubleshoot complex issues across the full technology stack and work effectively with limited supervision.
* Good written and spoken English, with the ability to work directly with technical and business stakeholders.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

### **Előny:**


* Experience with manufacturing systems, MES, ERP, WMS, traceability, production reporting, or other business\-critical
* enterprise applications.
* Experience with Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, cloud services, microservices, or messaging technologies.
* Experience with SSRS, Power BI, background services, scheduled jobs, or enterprise system integrations.
* Working knowledge of software architecture principles, SOLID, design patterns, automated testing, OWASP guidance, and
* Agile delivery.
* Experience supporting high\-availability production systems and conducting structured incident investigation and root\-cause
* analysis.

### **Amit kínálunk:**


* Opportunity to work across the complete solution lifecycle and influence technical decisions.
* Collaboration with operational, business, and IT stakeholders in an enterprise environment.

### **Munkavégzés helye:**


Kecskemét

* Formáld a járműbe épített tájékoztatás, szórakoztatás, biztonság és élmény jövőjét.

**A pozícióról:**


Ebben a feladatkörben az elektronikai hibaanalízissel kapcsolatos folyamatok támogatásáért leszel felelős. Te biztosítod az új technológiák és berendezések bevezetését a gyártósori analízis osztályok számára.


Ez a lehetőség ideális lehet számodra, ha érdekel az elektronikai gyártás világa, szereted a gyakorlati problémamegoldást, és motivál, hogy hatásod legyen a gyártási minőségre és teljesítményre.


**Feladatok:**


* Elektronikai analízis módszerek fejlesztése, új metódusok kidolgozása
* Analízis specialisták és technikusok támogatása komplexebb hibaanalízisek során
* Analízis specialisták és technikusok oktatása új eszközökről, technikákról
* Gyártósori analízishez használt berendezések, mérőeszközök, módszerek fejlesztése
* Részvétel probléma megoldásokban, kapcsolat tartása a HW és SW mérnökséggel a műszaki problémamegoldás elősegítéséért
* Új projekteknél becsatlakozás az első minták gyártásától kezdődően, tudásbázis építése az új termékekről
* Új termékekről összegyűjtött információk rendszerezése, implementálás a széria gyártósori analízis folyamatokba
* Induló projekteknél analízis állomásokhoz szükséges berendezések meghatározása, összeállítása

**Szükséges:**


* Angol nyelvismeret
* Linux, Android és Windows rendszerek ismerete, magabiztos parancssori ismeretek
* Mérőműszerek felhasználói ismerete (oszcilloszkóp, spektrum analizátor, LCR mérő)
* Tapasztalat gyártósori analízis folyamatokban
* Automotive buszok ismerete (CAN, LIN, ethernet)

**Előnyt jelent:**


* programozási ismeretek (C\#, NI LabVIEW, Python)
* beágyazott rendszerek ismerete (SOC, uC)
* autókban használt RF rendszerek ismerete (FM, GPS, BT, Wi\-Fi, V2X)
* programozó és datalogger eszközök ismerete (UART, I2C, SPI, stb.)

**Introduction: Career at HARMAN Automotive**


At HARMAN Automotive, we are shaping the future of connected vehicles by bringing innovative technologies from development into high\-volume manufacturing. As part of the Advanced Manufacturing Engineering Test organization, you will help implement and industrialize automotive electronics products such as Infotainment Systems, Audio Amplifiers, Telematics Control Units (TCUs), and other connected vehicle platforms.


* **Develop and implement** manufacturing test solutions that enable the successful launch of complex automotive electronics products.
* **Partner with global teams** across engineering, quality, suppliers, and manufacturing to deliver robust and efficient production processes.
* **Advance manufacturing excellence** through automation, standardization, and continuous improvement of test technologies and methodologies.
* **Support the future of mobility** by ensuring the quality and reliability of connected, intelligent, and customer\-focused automotive systems.

**What You’ll Be Part Of**


As a Regional AME Test Engineer, you will play a key role in shaping the test strategy and manufacturing test infrastructure for next\-generation automotive products. Working as an individual contributor, you will partner with cross\-functional teams across engineering, quality, manufacturing, suppliers, and global technology organizations to develop reliable, efficient, and standardized test solutions. Your work will directly impact product quality, production efficiency, and the successful launch of new technologies into manufacturing. This position is a strong fit for engineers who enjoy technical ownership, continuous improvement, and delivering innovative test solutions in a global environment.


**How You’ll Make An Impact**


* Develop manufacturing test concepts, specifications, and validation strategies that ensure product quality and support successful product launches.
* Lead the development and implementation of hardware and software solutions for test equipment, enabling reliable and efficient testing throughout the product lifecycle.
* Collaborate with product development, quality, manufacturing, and supplier teams to deliver robust test systems that meet customer, regulatory, and production requirements.
* Optimize test processes, cycle times, and test coverage to improve manufacturing efficiency, reduce quality risks, and lower operational costs.
* Drive continuous improvement by introducing new test technologies, measurement methods, and industry best practices into manufacturing operations.
* Coordinate test equipment deployment from concept through commissioning, ensuring systems are ready for prototype builds, industrialization, and serial production.
* Contribute to global engineering standards, knowledge sharing, and lessons learned activities to strengthen test engineering capabilities across HARMAN locations.

* Ability to design, develop, and troubleshoot test equipment hardware and software in a manufacturing environment.

* Experience with automotive electronics manufacturing and end\-of\-line test systems.

* Knowledge of statistical methods such as MSA, capability analysis, or process performance evaluation.
* Experience working with international suppliers and global engineering teams.

BDO Luxembourg is looking for a Full\-Stack Developer (Angular/.Net)!

**Who are we?**

  

BDO is present in over 169 countries and we offer an extensive range of services in the areas of Audit, Tax, Advisory, Accounting, Business Services and Outsourcing. At BDO Luxembourg, our mission is to provide our clients with the expertise of our global network tailored to the unique needs of the Luxembourgish market, delivering personalized services and building valued relationships. * Design, develop, and maintain full\-stack web applications using Angular on the frontend and .NET (C\#) on the backend within an NX monorepo architecture
* Develop and maintain Backend applications and RESTful APIs using .NET/C\#, with Entity Framework Core and SQL databases

You’ll learn about our global business from the inside – working on meaningful projects in areas including:


* Application development.
* Embedded IT for our commercial business such as trading of energy commodities, freight and logistics, commercial asset optimisation or sales and origination.
* Enterprise Integration focus on the transport layer within RWEST’s application landscape and works closely together with other IT and business teams to optimise the systems.
* Market Data Solutions are the fuel for decision\-making, automated trading, and fundamental analysis within the Energy Trading industry.
* Central Services are positioned in middle layer (Integration) applications connecting to various other departments like BackOffice, Risk and Front Office etc. involving incident management, automated standard service requests, working with concepts of DevOps and Squad model and migration of application to cloud based infrastructure.
* IT projects with business attention such as “Lead in Data” or “Lead in Cloud”.

Digital technologies, including AI\-enabled tools, are becoming an integral part of how we work at RWE. Throughout the programme, you will have opportunities to use these tools responsibly to enhance productivity, support decision\-making, foster innovation and improve ways of working, always in line with RWE policies and responsible use principles.


Whichever team you join, you’ll be welcomed as an equal. Your perspective will be valued. You’ll be trusted to deliver the work you’re given. And with each new rotation, you’ll develop the skills and knowledge you need to become an industry expert.

  

  

**Job requirements and experiences**

Are you passionate about IT, digital technologies, and innovative solutions? Committed to building a career in the energy industry? Keen to learn, grow and take ownership and accountability? Then you could be just the kind of exceptional person we’re looking for. Some relevant work experience would be an advantage but is not essential.

  

  

As well as a keen interest in the energy industry and the readiness to explore our markets and our business, you’ll need:


* A degree (BSc, MSc or PhD) in IT or a similar statistical or numerate subject such as Mathematics, Engineering or Economics.
* Knowledge of at least one of the following programming languages \- C\#, Java or Python.
* Passion for IT development and working in a DevOps environment.
* Interest in AI, Automation, and other emerging technologies.
* A positive, team\-oriented approach to work.
* Motivation to take on new challenges.
* A commercial and analytical mindset.
* Adaptability and the ability to learn quickly.
* Enthusiasm for developing your skills and exploring new opportunities.
* Fluent English.
  

  

**From here, you’ll have a community of support**


While you’re on our graduate journey, we’re committed to providing you with a range of opportunities to grow and develop your skills. Alongside job rotations and technical training, you’ll be provided with comprehensive behavioural skills training with our expert partner, Cappfinity. This will enable you to harness your strengths from day one and identify new ways to utilise the key Skills That Build Skills. This will support you to reach your potential and goals, shaping your career path. The behavioural skills training is immersive, including interactive sessions where you can learn from our facilitators and your own peers, and self\-led elements to support your application of learning back in your day\-to\-day role.


Our graduate programmes have been designed to give you the chance to shape your own career path and personal development, with the support you need to succeed. You’ll have access to a graduate buddy and a senior mentor within your field who can advise you on rotations and introduce you to key people within the business.


RWE is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment – we value your passion, your willingness to learn and your desire to thrive. Even if you don't have all the above skills, need flexible working arrangements or other adjustments not yet listed here, we'd love to hear from you.

  

  

**Your benefits**


At RWE, we’ll do everything we can to support you in fulfilling your potential. Our benefits include:


* Competitive salary plus annual discretionary bonus.
* Company pension and discounted employee share scheme.
* 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays, with the option to buy 5 extra days.
* Two paid annual volunteer days for a charity or initiative of your choice.
* International rotations with financial support for relocation.
* Enhanced family\-friendly policies, including maternity support.
* Free on\-site healthcare and access to AXA Private Healthcare Scheme.
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with confidential support for work, health, or life matters.
* Access to modern offices, state\-of\-the\-art IT and diverse employee networks.
* Flexible benefits, including retail discounts.

new_jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Senior ServiceNow Developer)
new_jobs.description:
**Company Description**
-----------------------

**Sopra Steria** is one of the largest players in the tech industry in Europe, known for its consulting, digital services and software development. We operate in nearly 30 countries in the world, hiring more than 55,000 employees.  

The Polish branch, as the Global Delivery Center, operates in Katowice since 2007 and has been growing ever since. Currently, our team consists of around 1,000 specialists.


Within the Digital Platform Services department, our teams specialize in areas such as cloud, operating systems, virtualization, databases, backup or storage, as well as networking and security. We also have 1st line support consultants who speak French and English, but also Italian, Spanish, Portuguese and German.


The Application Services department is responsible for areas such as software development, data engineering, testing services, CRM, ITSM and ERP platform integrations, as well as application management for customers in Scandinavia, Benelux, France, Germany, Switzerland and the UK.

**Job Description**
-------------------


We are looking for a **Senior Software Engineer (Senior ServiceNow Developer)** to join the **Sopra Steria Polska** team and contribute to the projects for our clients.  

  

**Note that we can only offer cooperation to people who are located in Poland and have EU citizenship.**  

  

**Responsibilities:**

* Participate in ServiceNow implementation, enhancement, and optimization projects.
* Analyze business requirements and translate them into scalable ServiceNow solutions.
* Design, configure, and develop solutions on the ServiceNow platform, primarily within the ITSM module.
* Develop and maintain workflows, integrations, catalog items, business rules, script includes, and other custom platform components.
* Implement new functionalities and enhancements in accordance with business and technical requirements.
* Troubleshoot complex issues, perform root cause analysis, and implement long\-term solutions.
* Review, optimize, and refactor custom code to ensure performance, maintainability, and compliance with ServiceNow best practices.
* Support platform upgrades, patches, and releases, including testing and validation activities.
* Monitor and maintain integrations and APIs to ensure reliable platform operations.
* Maintain up\-to\-date technical documentation for configurations, integrations, and custom developments.
* Collaborate with stakeholders, consultants, and Agile teams to deliver high\-quality solutions.
* Recommend and implement continuous improvements to enhance platform functionality, performance, and user experience.
**Qualifications**
------------------

**We are looking for someone with:**

* Solid hands\-on ServiceNow development experience, ideally around 4–5 years.
* Good knowledge of ITSM and the ServiceNow platform in general.
* Practical experience with CMDB, CI classes, relationships and data imports.
* Experience with REST integrations, IntegrationHub, Import Sets/Transform Maps and scripting.
* Good ServiceNow scripting skills: Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, GlideRecord, Flow Designer, etc.
* Understanding of data modelling and ability to translate functional/data requirements into ServiceNow configurations.
* Ability to analyse existing solutions, troubleshoot issues and independently implement moderate\-complexity changes.
* Experience with upgrades, maintenance and day\-to\-day evolution of ServiceNow ITSM processes.
* Experience with Discovery, Identification and Reconciliation Engine (IRE), CSDM, Service Graph Connectors, Security Operations or ServiceNow instance consolidation would be an advantage, but is not required.

**Additional must Have Requirements:**

* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Fluent English B2/C1\.
* Strong communication skills to collaborate with cross\-functional teams.
* Proactive and detail\-oriented.
* Ability to document processes and share knowledge effectively.
* Being open to occasional business trips abroad and visits in our office in Katowice.
**Additional Information**
--------------------------


What we offer:

* BENEFITS (UoP): Luxmed, Medicover Sport, Worksmile, educational platforms, languages learning platform, referral bonus,\[copyrights, life insurance, certifications (paid by the company), conferences, Tech Lunches, possibility to join our Communities (Project Management, Architecture, Security, Process Management, Leadership, AI and Cloud), local kindergarten.
* DEVELOPMENT OPPORTUNITIES (B2B): Tech Lunches, Worksmile, possibility to join our Communities (Project Management, Architecture, Security, Process Management, Leadership, AI and Cloud).


ADDITION: free parking, fresh fruits, workation.  

In case of questions, please contact the HR team.


The recruitment process for this position consists of two stages:  

* a short phone call with a recruiter (30 min max)
* one\-hour long interview on Teams (with both general and technical questions)
**Salary range:**  

  

UOP: 12 000 \-16 000 PLN gross/month;  

B2B: 100\-140 PLN/h net \+ vat.

  

All information about salary range and its additional components will be provided during the 1st stage of recruitment process.


At our organization, we are committed to fighting against all forms of discrimination. We foster a work environment that is inclusive and respectful of all differences.

Mid Software Engineer (.NET)
  
  

**Únete a Luckia:** solidez empresarial y transformación tecnológica
  
  

Luckia es un grupo internacional de entretenimiento con presencia en varios países y una clara apuesta por el canal digital. Con más de 2\.900 profesionales, combinamos la experiencia de una compañía consolidada con la ambición y agilidad de una organización en plena evolución tecnológica.
  
  

Estamos reforzando nuestro equipo de Producto y Tecnología para impulsar la siguiente fase de crecimiento de nuestra plataforma digital propia, con foco en escalabilidad, rendimiento, datos y experiencia de usuario.
  
  

**Este es un momento clave:** la tecnología es estratégica para el negocio y queremos seguir construyendo uno de los equipos de referencia en Galicia.
  
  

El rol
  
  

Buscamos un/a Mid Software Engineer .NET con criterio técnico, visión de arquitectura y capacidad para influir en las decisiones que marcarán la evolución de nuestra plataforma.
  
  

No es un puesto de mantenimiento. Es un rol para construir, evolucionar y liderar técnicamente.
  
  

Lo que harás
  
  

Diseñar y evolucionar soluciones en .NET en un entorno de alta disponibilidad.
  
Participar en decisiones de arquitectura orientadas a escalabilidad y rendimiento.
  
Participar técnicamente en iniciativas clave del roadmap.
  
Impulsar buenas prácticas, calidad y testing automatizado.
  
Colaborar con Producto, Data y equipos multidisciplinares.
  
  

Lo que te hará destacar
  
  

De 4 a 7 años de experiencia sólida en desarrollo con .NET.
  
Experiencia en diseño de arquitectura y sistemas de cierta complejidad.
  
Buen dominio de principios de diseño limpio, testing y CI/CD.
  
Mentalidad orientada a negocio y a impacto real.
  
Capacidad de autonomía y responsabilidad técnica.
  
Residencia en A Coruña o entorno.
  
  

Lo que ofrecemos
  
  

Proyecto sólido, estable y con visión a largo plazo.
  
Participación directa en una transformación tecnológica real.
  
Autonomía en la toma de decisiones técnicas.
  
**Rango salarial orientativo:** 40\.000 50\.000 fijo \+ variable por objetivos.
  
Seguro médico privado y paquete de beneficios flexibles.
  
**Nuevas oficinas inauguradas en marzo:** espacio diseñado para el alto rendimiento y la colaboración, con comedor, gimnasio, bar social y campus propio de formación.
  
**Un entorno donde la tecnología no es soporte:** es motor estratégico del crecimiento internacional.
  
  

Si buscas estabilidad sin renunciar al reto técnico, y quieres formar parte de una empresa consolidada que está dando un salto tecnológico relevante, queremos conocerte.
